title: AI Automation Engineer
description:
Wentwood Capital is a Miami-based private real estate lender. We are a team of rockstar A+ performers from top companies, driven by a culture of hard work and teamwork! 



Here's a glimpse of our last company meetup in Vietnam: 

www.
/share/r/1E4jcnmm2P/ 



We are looking for an AI Automation Engineer to help us build and deploy AI agents, automations, and system integrations across our business. This role reports directly to the CEO. 



Our teams already operate using documented SOPs, workflows, and resource centers, and we run the business across a stack of third-party platforms including our CRM, servicing platform, communications systems, Microsoft 365, Notion, Excel, Hootsuite, and other business systems.  



You will work alongside our AI Workflow Analyst, who documents processes and builds playbooks. Your job is to connect those systems into a thin, Wentwood-controlled integration and automation layer and build the technology on top of it, so data moves where it needs to, we can see what is happening across the business, and AI agents can work across functions instead of inside one tool. You will use the systems that already work, preserve clear systems of record, and avoid creating unnecessary duplicate infrastructure or databases. 



This is not a machine learning or data science role. We are looking for a builder. 



What You’ll Do:



- Build and operate the technical foundation for company-wide automation and AI, including integrations, service identities, permissions, secrets, logging, monitoring, exception handling, deployment, and rollback procedures 

-Build AI agents that can use tools, interact with company systems, and complete multi-step workflows 

-Build cross-functional agents that can pull information from one system, take action in another, and hand off to a person when judgment or approval is required 

-Turn documented SOPs and playbooks into working automations and agentic workflows 

- Connect our third-party platforms through APIs and webhooks as the default integration approach, using Power Automate, Zapier, Make, n8n, custom code, and controlled agent tools such as MCP where appropriate 

- Define and maintain cross-system record mappings, field ownership, sync direction, and reliable identity matching so systems do not create duplicate or conflicting records 

-Build the infrastructure around automations and agents, including permissions, human approval gates, guardrails, retries, logging, alerts, evaluations, and human review 

-Write Python or JavaScript when no-code tools are not enough 

-Build agents for QC, document review, drafting, data extraction, research, reporting, and task execution 

-Monitor automations and agents, identify failures, and improve reliability 

-Test new AI models, agent frameworks, and automation tools and determine what is actually useful in production 

-Document what you build so systems can be maintained and improved over time 

-Ensure production code, repositories, service accounts, credentials, and documentation remain under Wentwood-controlled accounts rather than depending on an individual employee or contractor 



What We’re Looking For:



- 2+ years of experience building automations, integrations, internal tools, or software 

- Hands-on experience building and deploying AI agents and agentic workflows 

- Experience with tool calling, multi-step execution, structured outputs, context management, and human-in-the-loop workflows 

- Experience connecting multiple systems so agents and automations can operate across platforms 

- Strong knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication, and third-party integrations 

- Experience designing reliable production integrations with retries, idempotency, logging, monitoring, and exception handling 

- Understanding of service accounts, API permissions, secrets management, and least-privilege access 

- Working knowledge of Python and/or JavaScript 

- Experience with Zapier, Make, n8n, Power Automate, or similar tools 

- Familiarity with MCP, agent frameworks, RAG, databases, and AI evaluations 

- Ability to read API documentation and build integrations without significant hand-holding 

- Someone who keeps up with AI because they genuinely enjoy it 



If your AI experience is primarily prompting ChatGPT or building basic automations, this is not the right role. 



Goal: Take documented business processes and turn them into reliable AI agents, automations, and connected systems that can operate across business functions, reduce manual work, and help our team operate at a significantly higher level while maintaining clear systems of record, human approval boundaries, production controls, and Wentwood ownership of the underlying infrastructure. 



Hiring Process:



- Application 

- Intro Call 

- Phase I: Architecture & Agent Design 

- Phase II: Technical Build 

- Final Interview with Leadership Team 

- Offer 



Benefits:



- Competitive salary 

- Annual performance-based bonus 

- Paid time off 

- Full HMO coverage through Maxicare 

- All-expense-paid annual company trip + annual Philippines team meet-up 

- 6-month maternity leave

This is not a traditional Chief of Staff or Executive Assistant role. You will not become a gatekeeper between the CEO and the people he already works with. You will review how recurring work currently happens, document it, improve it, build playbooks and prompts, create practical AI agents and automations, and work with our AI Automation Engineer and other technical team members when deeper technical development is required. 



We are looking for an operator who combines strong judgment, organization, process thinking, and practical AI ability. You should be comfortable taking an unclear recurring problem, understanding how it works, designing a better system, building what you reasonably can yourself, and coordinating with others when needed. 



What You'll Do:



- Own the ongoing development and operation of AbbasOS, the CEO's personal operating system 

- Review how the CEO currently manages
, calendar, scheduling, follow-ups, executive workflows, personal administration, household and family logistics, vendors, travel, research, and other recurring responsibilities 

- Identify where the CEO's time and attention are being consumed and prioritize recurring problems that can return the most time or reduce the most cognitive load

 operating model that can triage and prioritize messages, summarize what matters, identify required actions, prepare drafts where appropriate, route work to the right person, and track follow-up 

- Improve calendar and scheduling workflows so commitments, preparation requirements, conflicts, priorities, reminders, and follow-ups are handled systematically 

- Create systems that convert conversations,
s, meetings, decisions, and commitments into clear actions and make sure those actions are tracked through completion 

- Build systems around recurring household, family, vendor, travel, document, renewal, and personal administration workflows without replacing the people already responsible for those areas 

- Determine what should be handled by AI, automation, the AI Chief of Staff, an existing team member, an outside resource, or the CEO 

- Personally build useful first versions of simpler AI workflows and agents without waiting on an engineer for every improvement 

- Work with our AI Automation Engineer and other technical team members when a workflow requires deeper technical development or more sophisticated automation 

- Test workflows in real use, identify where they fail, and continuously improve them 

- Maintain clear documentation so AbbasOS remains organized, repeatable, and not dependent on one individual 



What We're Looking For:



- 2-4 years of real hands-on experience in business operations, founder or executive support, chief of staff work, AI automation, systems operations, or a similar role 

- Strong practical experience using AI to improve real workflows, not just using ChatGPT for drafting or research 

- Hands-on experience personally building AI agents, automations, or multi-step workflows

- Strong process thinking and the judgment to determine what should be automated, delegated, standardized, or kept human

- Exceptional organization, follow-through, attention to detail, and ability to keep track of multiple open loops without losing control

If your AI experience is primarily prompting ChatGPT, drafting content, or experimenting with tools but you have not personally built working agents, automations, or repeatable workflows, this is not the right role. 



Goal: Build and continuously improve AbbasOS so information, requests, commitments, and recurring responsibilities are converted into automated execution, delegated action, organized follow-up, or concise decisions requiring the CEO's judgment. title: telemarketing job for HVAC/roofing/foundation company
description:
U.S. Home Services — HVAC, Roofing and Foundation



Compensation: $6–$8 USD per hour, based on experience, plus performance bonuses

Hours: 10 hours per week to start

Schedule: Must be available during U.S. Central Time

Location: Remote



ABOUT US



You First Trade Group is a growing Texas home-services marketing company. We help homeowners connect with dependable HVAC, roofing and foundation professionals.



We will provide you with a database containing homeowner names and telephone numbers. Your job will be to call each prospect, ask a short series of qualifying questions and organize the database into unqualified, warm and hot leads for our local sales team.



This is an appointment-setting and lead-qualification position. You will not be expected to close the final sale.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



Make live outbound calls using our approved script and calling system

Confirm that you are speaking with the homeowner or decision-maker

Ask friendly questions about the homeowner’s HVAC system, roof or foundation

Identify current problems, future needs and planned projects

Determine the homeowner’s level of interest and expected timeline

Schedule appointments for qualified homeowners

Enter accurate notes and update every record in our CRM

Categorize each contact as unqualified, warm or hot

Follow all calling-hour, Do-Not-Call and company compliance requirements

Respect anyone who asks not to be contacted again

Submit a daily report showing calls, conversations, qualified leads and appointments



HOW WE CLASSIFY LEADS



Unqualified Lead:



Wrong or disconnected telephone number

Renter rather than homeowner

No relevant service need

Not interested

Requested no additional calls



Warm Lead:



Confirmed homeowner or decision-maker

Has an older HVAC system, roof or possible foundation concern

May need service within the next 3–12 months

Is willing to receive additional information or a future follow-up call

Has provided enough information for our local team to continue the conversation



Hot Lead:



Confirmed homeowner or decision-maker

Has an active HVAC, roofing or foundation problem

Is planning work within approximately 90 days

Has requested an estimate, inspection or consultation

Has agreed to a specific appointment date and time



REQUIREMENTS



Excellent spoken and written English

Clear, friendly and confident telephone voice

Previous U.S. cold-calling, appointment-setting or customer-service experience

Home-services experience is strongly preferred

Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls

Able to follow a script while still sounding natural

Strong listening and note-taking skills

Reliable high-speed internet connection

Quality noise-canceling headset

Quiet and professional workspace

Comfortable working during U.S. Central Time

Honest and accurate when classifying leads

Experience using a CRM or calling platform is preferred



COMPENSATION



$6–$8 USD per hour, depending on experience

Performance bonuses for qualified appointments that are confirmed and attended

Additional opportunities for increased hours and long-term advancement

Consistent work for candidates who produce accurate, high-quality results



We value lead quality more than inflated call numbers. Applicants who inaccurately label prospects as warm or hot will not be a good fit. We want honest qualification, complete notes and homeowners who genuinely want to speak with our local team.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following:



A short description of your telemarketing or appointment-setting experience

The types of U.S. campaigns you have previously worked on

Your desired hourly rate

Your availability in U.S. Central Time

A screenshot of your current internet-speed test

The CRM and calling systems you have used

A 60–90 second voice recording reading the sample script below



SAMPLE VOICE RECORDING SCRIPT



“Hello, may I speak with [Homeowner Name]? My name is [Your Name], and I’m calling on behalf of You First Trade Group here in Texas. We are reaching out to homeowners in your area regarding HVAC, roofing and foundation services. I just have two quick questions to determine whether any of these services might be helpful for your property. Are you currently experiencing any concerns with your air-conditioning system, roof or foundation?”



Please begin your application with the words “YOU FIRST” so we know you read the complete job posting.



Selected applicants will be invited to complete a paid trial involving script practice, role-playing and supervised calling.

title: PART-TIME SALES DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE (SDR) – U.S. BUSINESS OUTREACH
description:
PART-TIME SALES DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE (SDR) – U.S. BUSINESS OUTREACH 



$300 USD/Month Base + Performance Bonuses 

Expected On-Target Earnings: Approximately $400 USD/Month 

Uncapped Bonus Potential 

Part-Time | 10 Hours/Week | Monday–Friday | 8:00–10:00 AM U.S. Eastern Time | Remote 



About THRRIVE 



THRRIVE is a U.S.-based training and professional development company. We help companies build high-performing sales, management, and leadership teams through training, coaching, and proven development systems. 



We are looking for a confident, dependable, and results-oriented Sales Development Representative (SDR) to connect with qualified U.S. business owners and decision-makers and invite them to THRRIVE workshops. 



This is a prospecting and performance-focused position. Your primary responsibility will be making outbound calls, speaking with qualified prospects, inviting appropriate decision-makers to our workshops, completing follow-up, and accurately recording activity in our CRM. 



Work Schedule 



This position has a set calling schedule: 



Monday through Friday 

8:00–10:00 AM U.S. Eastern Time 

2 hours per day | 10 hours per week 



You must be available and ready to make outbound calls consistently during this scheduled calling block. 



What You'll Do 



Make outbound calls to U.S. business owners, CEOs, Presidents, sales leaders, and other qualified decision-makers. 

Use provided prospect lists, scripts, and talk tracks. 

Speak professionally with prospects about their business and sales challenges. 

Invite qualified prospects to upcoming THRRIVE workshops. 

Follow up with interested prospects and registered attendees. 

Complete confirmation and reminder outreach to help maximize attendance. 

Accurately record calls, conversations, registrations, and follow-up activity in the CRM. 

Participate in coaching and call-review sessions as needed. 

Weekly Performance Expectations 



Performance is reviewed weekly, not just at the end of the month. 



Required Weekly Activity 



Work the scheduled 8:00–10:00 AM U.S. Eastern Time calling block, Monday through Friday 

Make a minimum of 60 outbound calls per day 

Make a minimum of 300 outbound calls per week 

Accurately record 100% of prospecting activity in the CRM 

Complete 100% of assigned follow-up and confirmation activities 

Weekly Performance Targets 



20+ qualified live conversations per week 

8 qualified workshop registrations per week 

Consistent completion of required prospecting activity is an essential part of this position. 



Results can vary from week to week, so performance will be evaluated based on both consistent activity and results. 



Consistent failure to complete required prospecting activity, maintain accurate records, or make progress toward performance targets may result in the engagement ending. 



Monthly Performance Target 



The primary monthly performance target is: 



20 new qualified prospects personally sourced by the SDR who actually attend a THRRIVE workshop. 



Registrations alone do not count toward the attendee bonus. The qualified prospect must actually attend the workshop. 



Compensation 



Base Salary: $300 USD per month 



In addition to the base salary, you will earn a $5 USD performance bonus for every new qualified prospect you personally source who actually attends their first THRRIVE workshop. 



The monthly performance target is 20 qualified attendees. 



At target performance: 



$300 base salary + $100 performance bonus = approximately $400 USD per month. 



Performance bonuses are uncapped. There is no maximum amount you can earn in bonuses. If you bring more qualified prospects into THRRIVE workshops, you earn more. 



For example, 30 qualified attendees would result in $450 total monthly compensation, and 40 qualified attendees would result in $500 total monthly compensation. 



Who We're Looking For 



You may be a great fit if you: 



Have previous cold-calling, appointment-setting, telemarketing, SDR, or outbound sales experience. 

Have experience calling U.S. businesses or U.S. prospects. 

Speak clear, conversational English. 

Have a confident, pleasant, and professional phone presence. 

Are comfortable speaking with business owners and senior executives. 

Can make 60 outbound calls during a 2-hour calling block. 

Are comfortable hearing "no" and moving on to the next call. 

Can follow a script without sounding robotic. 

Are comfortable asking questions and having real conversations rather than simply reading a script. 

Are coachable and willing to practice. 

Can accurately document calls and notes in a CRM. 

Are organized and consistent with follow-up. 

Are dependable and punctual. 

Have reliable internet and a quiet working environment. 

Previous Experience 



Previous experience with U.S. B2B cold calling is strongly preferred. 



Experience in any of the following roles may be helpful: 



Sales Development Representative (SDR) 

Business Development Representative (BDR) 

Cold Caller 

Appointment Setter 

Telemarketer 

Lead Generation Specialist 

Outbound Sales Representative 

How to Apply 



Please answer all of the following questions with your application: 



Tell us about your previous outbound cold-calling or appointment-setting experience. 

Have you previously called U.S. businesses? If yes, what types of businesses and decision-makers did you call? 

Approximately how many outbound calls did you make per day in your previous calling position? 

Are you comfortable making a minimum of 60 outbound calls during each 2-hour calling block and 300 outbound calls per week? 

Tell us what you would do if a prospect answers the phone and immediately says, "I'm not interested." 

Are you comfortable speaking directly with business owners, CEOs, Presidents, and sales leaders? 

Are you comfortable being coached, participating in call reviews, and having your performance reviewed weekly? 

Are you available to work consistently Monday through Friday from 8:00–10:00 AM U.S. Eastern Time? 

This position pays a $300 USD monthly base salary plus a $5 performance bonus for each new qualified prospect you personally source who actually attends their first THRRIVE workshop. The monthly target is 20 qualified attendees, resulting in expected on-target earnings of approximately $400 USD per month, with uncapped bonus potential. Are you comfortable with this compensation and performance structure? 

This position has specific weekly activity and performance expectations, including 300 outbound calls, 20+ qualified conversations, and a target of 8 qualified workshop registrations per week. Are you comfortable being held accountable to weekly performance expectations? 

Voice Recording Required 



Please include a 30–60 second voice recording with your application. 



In the recording: 



Introduce yourself. 

Briefly describe your cold-calling experience. 

Tell us why you are comfortable speaking with U.S. business owners and executives. 

Please speak naturally. We are not looking for a professionally produced recording. 



We want to hear your natural communication style, English proficiency, confidence, and phone presence. 



Important 



Applications that do not include the requested information and voice recording may not be considered. 



This is not a passive virtual assistant position. It is an outbound business development role with clear, measurable expectations. 



You will know exactly what is expected of you each week, and performance will be reviewed regularly. 



For someone who enjoys prospecting and performs well, this position offers uncapped performance bonuses and the opportunity for increased responsibility and compensation as THRRIVE grows.

title: URGENT: Content & Creative Associate
description:
# Content & Creative Associate



## About Us



We are a fast-growing digital company looking for a talented Content & Creative Associate to join our marketing team.



This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys creating content, designing marketing assets, working with social media, using AI tools, and turning ideas into polished content that people actually want to engage with.



Unlike an agency environment where you may manage many unrelated clients, this role will primarily focus on two businesses, allowing you to learn the brands deeply and continually improve the quality of the work.



You'll work alongside specialists focused on paid advertising, SEO, conversion optimization, analytics, and outreach. Your primary focus will be turning marketing ideas and opportunities into high-quality content and creative assets.



## Work Schedule & Compensation



**Hours:** Full-time, Monday through Friday



**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, approximately 2:00 PM–12:00 AM Philippine Time, with some flexibility in working hours. The later portion of the schedule provides regular overlap with our U.S.-based team.



**Workweek:** Approximately 40 hours of core work plus 5 hours of dedicated innovation, research, and learning time each week.



**Paid Lunch:** 1 hour per day



**Breaks:** Reasonable short breaks throughout the day as needed



**Innovation Time:** Approximately 5 paid hours per week dedicated to learning, experimenting with new tools, improving creative processes, and testing new content ideas



**Compensation:** $750 USD per month



**PTO:** 12 paid time-off days annually



**Location:** Remote – Philippines



This is intended to be a long-term position with opportunities for increased compensation and responsibility based on performance and company growth.



## Role Overview



You will help run our day-to-day content and creative production across our marketing channels.



Your work may include blog content, organic social media, graphics, paid advertising assets, short-form videos, website visuals, and repurposing existing content into new formats.



You will also work closely with our Paid Growth Specialist to create new advertising assets and variations based on campaign performance and new ideas we want to test.



We use AI heavily throughout our business, so we're looking for someone who is comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT and other AI platforms to improve research, writing, design, ideation, and production speed.



AI should help you create better work faster — but you will still be responsible for ensuring the final output is accurate, polished, natural, useful, and consistent with our brands.



## Key Responsibilities



### Content Production



* Create, edit, format, and publish blog posts and other website content



* Turn content ideas and briefs into clear, useful, engaging articles



* Add appropriate images, graphics, headings, links, calls-to-action, and formatting before publishing



* Help maintain and improve existing website content when needed



* Repurpose strong articles and ideas into additional marketing content



### Organic Social Media



* Create and publish content for platforms such as Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and other relevant social channels



* Develop graphics, carousels, educational posts, captions, and other platform-appropriate content



* Maintain an organized content calendar and publishing schedule



* Repurpose articles, customer questions, marketing insights, and successful campaign ideas into social content



### Paid Advertising Creative



* Work closely with our Paid Growth Specialist to create assets for Google Performance Max, Meta, Instagram, Reddit, and other paid advertising channels



* Create multiple meaningful creative variations for testing different ideas, hooks, audiences, and formats



* Develop static graphics, simple videos, product visuals, educational creatives, comparison graphics, and other advertising assets



* Use advertising performance feedback to improve future creative



### Graphic Design & Video



* Create professional marketing graphics using tools such as Canva and/or Figma



* Create and edit short-form videos for social media and advertising



* Develop reusable templates that allow the team to create high-quality content efficiently



* Help improve graphics, visual sections, icons, comparison tables, and other elements across websites and landing pages



### Content Repurposing



* Turn one strong piece of content into multiple useful assets



For example:



Blog article → social posts → carousel → short video → paid advertising creative →
 graphic



* Identify opportunities to reuse strong topics, visuals, hooks, and creative concepts across multiple marketing channels



### Organization & Brand Quality



* Maintain an organized library of brand assets, templates, graphics, videos, and source files



* Follow established brand standards while continuously helping improve the quality of our creative



* Review your work carefully for spelling, formatting, design issues, accuracy, broken links, and other quality problems before publishing



* Keep source files organized so creative can easily be updated and reused



### Collaboration



* Work closely with our Paid Growth Specialist to support advertising campaigns with new creative



* Work with our future SEO/CRO specialist on content briefs, website improvements, and new content opportunities



* Work with our marketing supervisor as the team grows



* Participate in regular team meetings



* Communicate clearly when you need additional information, feedback, or clarification to complete a project



## Requirements



* Experience creating digital marketing content



* Strong writing and editing skills in English



* Experience creating graphics using Canva, Figma, or similar tools



* Experience creating content for social media



* Comfortable creating and editing basic short-form video content



* Strong attention to detail



* Good visual judgment and an understanding of what makes content look professional



* Comfortable learning and using AI tools such as ChatGPT



* Able to work independently and manage multiple assignments



* Organized and dependable



* Willing to learn from performance data and improve creative based on what is actually working



* Reliable internet connection and ability to work remotely



## Experience That Is a Plus



* WordPress



* Canva



* Figma



* CapCut or other video editing tools



* Instagram /
 content creation



* Short-form video creation



* Blogging or editorial content



* Basic SEO knowledge



* Google Performance Max creative assets



* Meta advertising creative



*
 marketing creative



* Landing page design



* AI-assisted writing, image creation, video creation, or creative workflows



## Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who enjoys creating.



You should be the type of person who can receive an idea or brief and figure out how to turn it into something polished and useful without needing every small detail explained.



We value someone who is creative but also organized and dependable.



We don't expect you to be an expert at everything on day one. We care more about having strong fundamentals, good judgment, attention to detail, curiosity, and a willingness to continually learn and improve.



Most importantly, we're looking for someone who understands that producing more content isn't the goal by itself.



The goal is to create **better content and creative that helps our brands grow**.

title: Outbound Financial Services Appointment Setter
description:
We are hiring a confident, professional, and dependable Outbound Appointment Setter to contact prospective clients in the United States and schedule introductory calls with a financial advisor.



You will receive organized prospect lists, an approved calling script, training, and access to the systems needed to complete your work. Your primary responsibility is to create respectful conversations, identify interest, handle basic objections, and book qualified appointments directly on the advisor’s calendar.



This is not a customer-service or data-entry position. You must be comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls and speaking with professionals, executives, business owners, and higher-income households.



Your Responsibilities



* Make outbound calls to cold prospects from provided lists.

* Follow approved scripts and communication guidelines.

* Introduce the financial advisor and explain the purpose of the introductory call.

* Ask simple, approved questions to determine interest.

* Handle common objections professionally without becoming aggressive.

* Schedule qualified prospects directly on the advisor’s calendar.

* Send approved follow-up
s or text messages when required.

* Accurately record every call, conversation, appointment, callback and opt-out.

* Keep the CRM and prospect-tracking system updated.

* Attend training, coaching and performance-review meetings.

* Protect prospect information and follow all confidentiality requirements.

* Follow all company, regulatory and Do Not Call procedures.



What You Will Not Do



You will not provide financial advice, recommend investments, explain financial products, collect sensitive financial information or attempt to close a sale.



Your responsibility is to create interest and schedule an introductory conversation with the financial advisor.



Required Qualifications



* At least two years of outbound cold-calling or appointment-setting experience.

* Experience speaking with U.S.-based prospects.

* Clear, natural and professional spoken English.

* A calm, confident and trustworthy phone presence.

* Strong listening and objection-handling skills.

* Comfortable making repeated calls without becoming discouraged.

* Strong attention to detail and accurate recordkeeping.

* Reliable high-speed internet, computer, headset and quiet workspace.

* Ability to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

* Willingness to follow an approved script rather than improvising.

* Dependable attendance and consistent communication.



Preferred Experience



Preference will be given to applicants with experience in:



* Financial services

* Insurance

* Mortgage services

* Banking

* Real estate

* Professional services

* Business-to-consumer appointment setting

* Calling executives, professionals or business owners

* CRM systems, dialers and calendar-booking tools



Performance Expectations



You will be measured on:



* Calls completed

* Live conversations

* Qualified appointments scheduled

* Appointment attendance rate

* Accuracy of CRM records

* Script and compliance adherence

* Professionalism and reliability



Appointment quality is more important than filling the calendar with people who are not genuinely interested.



Training and Support



You will receive:



* An approved calling script

* Objection-handling guidance

* Prospect lists

* Calendar-booking instructions

* CRM training

* Regular coaching and call reviews

* Clear performance expectations



How to Apply



Please submit:



1. A brief introduction explaining your outbound-calling experience.

2. The industries and types of prospects you have called.

3. Your average number of outbound calls per day.

4. Your average number of appointments scheduled per week.

5. The CRMs, dialers and calendar tools you have used.

6. Your availability during U.S. Eastern Time.

7. A 60-second audio recording introducing yourself as an appointment setter.

8. A short response to this objection:

    “I already have a financial advisor, so I am not interested.”



Applications without an audio recording will not be considered.



Attention-to-Detail Requirement



To confirm that you read the complete job description, include the following phrase in the subject line of your application:



The color blue

title: Brand Manager, Personal Brand (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
Company: Ryan Rivard / BSPKN

Location: Remote, Philippines (metro area strongly preferred)

Type: Full-Time, dedicated to personal brand operations

Compensation: TBD on experience (below) | Experienced level (High)

Start Date: Immediate, with 2-week paid trial period



About Ryan Rivard

Ryan Rivard is an executive coach, endurance athlete, and content creator with 226,000 Instagram followers and a growing TikTok audience of 14,000. He summited Mount Everest in May 2024, completed Ironman Madison and the Leadville 100 MTB, and coaches high-performing founders and executives through The Dodek Method. Ryan partners with leading performance, recovery, and wellness brands including Ten Thousand, Omorpho, Fjord Cold Plunge, Dottir, Icon Meals, and others. His personal brand generates over 332,000 organic views per month and is actively scaling its brand partnership revenue.



The Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented, organized, and proactive Brand Manager to run the day-to-day operations of Ryan's personal brand. This is not a generic virtual assistant role. You will be the operational backbone of a growing personal brand and content business. You will manage Instagram, coordinate with brand partners, organize content assets, track deliverables, send invoices, and ensure everything runs smoothly so Ryan can focus on filming and closing partnerships.

This role is ideal for someone who takes pride in building something meaningful, is genuinely excited about the fitness, wellness, and endurance space, and wants to grow alongside a brand that is scaling rapidly.



Responsibilities

Manage and post content to Ryan's Instagram account (Reels, Stories, static posts, carousels) on a consistent schedule using provided content calendars and brand guidelines.



Research trending Reels, audio, and content formats. Identify opportunities to repurpose existing footage into new content. When Ryan sends a Reel he likes, adapt it for his brand and audience.



Communicate with brand partners in dedicated Slack channels. Track what has been delivered to each brand, what is outstanding, and what is coming up.



Send invoices to brand partners on schedule. Track payments received and flag overdue accounts.

Organize the B-roll folder system in Google Drive. When Ryan or his family uploads raw footage, sort it into the correct category (Running, Cycling, Gym, Family, Events, etc.).



Manage affiliate links and tracking codes for brand partnerships. Ensure correct links are used in bios, captions, and Stories.

Conduct outreach to potential brand partners using provided templates and the media kit. Warm up leads before Ryan engages directly.



Maintain the content strategy folder including brand voice document, social typography, mood board, and brand kit.

Provide weekly status updates covering content posted, brand deliverables completed, invoices sent, engagement highlights, and upcoming deadlines.



Requirements

Minimum 1 year of experience managing social media for a personal brand, influencer, or content creator (not just a business page).

Strong understanding of Instagram including Reels, Stories, engagement strategy, hashtag research, and posting timing.

Proficiency with Canva for basic graphic creation and content formatting.

Experience with Google Drive, Slack, and basic project management tools.

Excellent written English. You will be writing captions, responding to brand partners, and drafting outreach messages.

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive. You do not wait to be told what to do. You see what needs to happen and you do it.



Available during US Central Time with a minimum of 3 to 4 hours of overlap per day.



Preferred but Not Required

Experience in fitness, wellness, endurance, or lifestyle brand content.

Familiarity with influencer marketing, brand partnerships, white-listing, and UGC content.

Experience with TikTok, YouTube Shorts, or cross-platform content.

Basic understanding of paid media metrics such as impressions, click-through rate, and ROAS.



Tools You Will Use

Instagram Creator Studio and Meta Business Suite. Slack. Google Drive. Canva. Invoicing software (Stripe or QuickBooks). AI tools, including Claude.ai, Higgsfield, Heygen and/or Popy AI



What Success Looks Like

30 days: Instagram posting is consistent, the B-roll folder is organized, and you are managing at least 2 brand partner Slack channels independently.

60 days: You are proactively researching content ideas, managing all invoicing, and Ryan is spending less than 30 minutes per day on brand admin.

90 days: You are conducting warm outreach to new brand partners, managing 4 to 6 active brand relationships, and the content pipeline runs without daily direction from Ryan.



How to Apply

Submit the following with your application.

Your resume or portfolio showing social media management experience.

A brief paragraph of 3 to 5 sentences explaining why you are a good fit and what excites you about working with a personal brand in the fitness and coaching space.

A link to one Instagram account you currently manage or have managed, with permission to share.

A 60-second video introduction of yourself via Loom, Google Drive, or YouTube unlisted. Show us one Instagram account you manage, walk us through one post you are proud of, and tell us why it performed well. This is required.



IMPORTANT: To confirm you have read this entire job description, please title your application "morning summit." Applications without this exact title will not be reviewed.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
Senior Graphic Designer

Childcare Marketing Group | Remote-First | Full-Time







Position Overview



We are looking for a Senior Graphic Designer who can turn strategy into visual impact.

At Childcare Marketing Group, we help childcare centers and early education businesses attract more families, strengthen their brands, and grow. Our creative work is not decoration — it is a critical part of how our clients communicate, compete, and generate results.



As our Senior Graphic Designer, you will take ownership of visual execution across a diverse portfolio of clients. You will work from concept through completion, translating marketing strategies and campaign objectives into creative that is compelling, commercially-minded, and built to perform.



This is not a role for someone who simply waits for a brief and follows instructions.

We want a designer who can think, challenge, create, refine, and raise the creative standard. Someone who understands that great design combines creativity with strategy, knows how to work at speed without sacrificing quality, and has the confidence to own projects from beginning to end.



You will work across multiple projects, brands, and formats while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and consistently delivering work that clients are proud to put their name behind.





Compensation



Competitive Compensation: Based on experience and level of expertise.

Performance Bonuses: Additional earning potential may be available based on performance and company programs.





Why You Should Work Here



? Work That Matters: You help transform lives by supporting the marketing of businesses that care for and educate children. Your creative work helps childcare providers connect with more families who need their services.

? Recession-Proof Growth: Childcare is an essential industry, and our clients need effective marketing to continue attracting families, filling places, and growing their businesses.

? Leadership That Has Your Back: You’ll work with a supportive, attentive, and motivated leadership team that wants you to succeed and gives you the support to keep developing.

? An Owner Who Shows Up: Our owner is actively involved in the business and invested in building a high-performing company and team.

? Small-Team Feel: You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where your ideas are visible, your work matters, and you’re treated as a person rather than a headcount.

? Remote-First Flexibility: Work from anywhere with a reliable internet connection while staying closely connected to a collaborative international team.

? Top-of-Market Opportunity: We want exceptional people and believe strong talent should have the opportunity to grow with the company.

? Train to Be the Best: Extensive initial and ongoing training, courses, and professional development designed to help you become exceptionally strong at what you do.

? A Workspace That Feels 
 Our remote environment is designed to keep the team connected, collaborative, and engaged even when we're working from different parts of the world.

? Quarterly Town Halls: Regular company-wide updates so you understand what is happening across the business and where we are heading.

? The Dream-On Program: Our CEO grants multiple wishes each year pulled directly from team members' dream boards.

? 25 Days Off: A full 25 paid days off per year, because great work requires time to recharge and have a life outside work.

? Paid Days to Give Back: 4 paid days each year to volunteer with a charity of your choice.





What Success Looks Like



Within your first 90 days, you will understand our creative standards, clients, workflows, and brand requirements and begin taking full ownership of your design projects.

Ongoing, you will be measured on:

? Creative Quality: Consistently producing polished, original, high-quality creative that meets or exceeds professional agency standards.

? Creative Ownership: Taking projects from initial concept through final delivery with minimal supervision and strong judgment at every stage.

? Brand Consistency: Ensuring every asset reflects the client's brand, audience, positioning, and campaign objectives.

? Strategic Design: Creating visuals that do more than look good — they communicate clearly, support marketing objectives, and contribute to measurable campaign outcomes.

? Speed & Reliability: Managing multiple projects and deadlines without sacrificing quality or allowing important details to slip through the cracks.

? Attention to Detail: Catching inconsistencies, errors, spacing issues, formatting problems, and other details before work reaches the client.

? Collaboration: Working effectively with marketers, strategists, copywriters, account managers, and other creative team members to produce stronger work.

? Client Impact: Creating work that clients value, approve confidently, and can use effectively across their marketing.





A Typical Week Might Include



? Reviewing creative briefs and marketing objectives before translating them into visual concepts.

? Developing concepts, layouts, graphics, advertisements, social media creative, presentations, and other marketing assets.

? Taking a project from rough concept through design, revision, approval, and final delivery.

? Collaborating with Account Managers, Marketing Strategists, copywriters, and other internal specialists.

? Reviewing existing client creative and identifying opportunities to improve visual consistency and effectiveness.

? Managing multiple projects simultaneously while prioritizing deadlines and maintaining quality.

? Presenting creative concepts and explaining the strategic thinking behind your design decisions.

? Responding to feedback, refining creative, and knowing when to push an idea further versus when to move forward.

? Staying current with design trends, creative technology, AI tools, and evolving visual communication practices.





Key Competencies



? Creative Thinker: You generate original ideas rather than simply replicating what already exists.

? Exceptional Attention to Detail: You notice the small things that separate good design from outstanding design.

? Strategic Designer: You understand that design needs to serve an audience, communicate a message, and support a business objective.

? High Standards: You hold your own work to a professional standard and are not satisfied with "good enough."

? Excellent Communicator: You can explain creative decisions clearly and confidently to both internal teammates and professional clients.

? Problem Solver: You can work through unclear briefs, creative challenges, competing priorities, and tight deadlines without becoming stuck.

? Adaptable: You can move between different brands, industries, audiences, and creative requirements without losing quality.

? Time Management Master: You know how to manage your workload, prioritize competing deadlines, and deliver consistently.

? Collaborative: You know when to lead creatively, when to listen, and how to make the people around you better.

? Resilient & Self-Confident: You are comfortable receiving feedback, defending a strong creative idea when appropriate, and continually improving your work.





This Role Is Not for You If



? You need someone to give you exact instructions for every design decision.

? You are primarily interested in making things look attractive without considering the marketing objective behind them.

? You struggle to manage multiple projects or deadlines simultaneously.

? You take creative feedback personally or resist revisions.

? You regularly miss small details that affect the quality of finished work.

? You are uncomfortable working in a fast-moving agency environment where priorities can change.

? You need constant supervision to stay productive.

? You are not interested in continuing to develop your creative skills and staying current with new design tools and trends.









Skills and Experience Required



? 5+ years of professional graphic design experience, with a strong track record of producing commercial, marketing-focused creative in an agency, in-house marketing, advertising, or similarly fast-paced environment. 

? A strong portfolio demonstrating high-level commercial and marketing design work across multiple formats and industries.

? Thorough understanding of graphic design principles, including typography, layout, composition, hierarchy, colour, visual storytelling, and brand consistency.

? Demonstrated ability to take a project from concept through final execution.

? Advanced proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.

? Strong understanding of designing for digital marketing, including social media, paid advertising, web,
, and other digital channels.

? Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.

? Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

? Strong attention to detail and quality control.

? A reliable remote work setup and ability to work independently.





Preferred Skills and Experience



? Previous experience working in a digital marketing or creative agency.

? Experience designing creative specifically for paid advertising and conversion-focused campaigns.

? Experience working across multiple client brands simultaneously.

? Experience with motion graphics, video editing, animation, or other multimedia design.

? Experience with Figma, Canva, or similar collaborative design platforms.

? Familiarity with AI-assisted creative and design tools.

? Experience designing for childcare, education, franchise, healthcare, or other multi-location businesses.

? Experience presenting creative concepts to clients or senior stakeholders.

? Understanding of marketing performance and how creativity can influence engagement, conversion, and acquisition.





Work Environment 

This is a full-time, remote-first position.





About Childcare Marketing Group 

Childcare Marketing Group helps child care centers, day nurseries, and early education businesses attract more families, retain enrollment, and grow with smarter marketing. We are a fast-growing, remote-first marketing company serving clients across the U.S., U.K., and beyond.

title: Real Estate Lead List Builder & Data Research VA – PropStream / DealMachine
description:
We are a growing roofing and restoration company in Colorado looking for a highly detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to build, clean, and maintain targeted homeowner lead lists for our outbound sales team.

This is NOT a cold calling position.



Your responsibility will be to make sure our cold callers are working from accurate, high-quality data instead of wasting time calling bad, duplicate, disconnected, or irrelevant numbers.

You will work primarily with PropStream and DealMachine to identify homeowners within specific geographic areas that we provide.



Responsibilities include:

• Building targeted homeowner lists using PropStream and DealMachine

• Searching specific neighborhoods, ZIP codes, addresses, and geographic target areas

• Identifying appropriate residential properties and property owners

• Skip tracing property owners to obtain contact information

• Cleaning and organizing raw lead data

• Removing duplicate records

• Identifying and removing obviously incorrect or unusable phone numbers

• Separating mobile, landline, and potentially invalid numbers when possible

• Cross-referencing records between multiple data sources

• Maintaining organized Google Sheets/CSV lead databases

• Tracking where each lead and phone number came from

• Preparing clean calling lists for a separate cold calling team



Accuracy is more important than simply producing a large number of records.

We recently tested outbound calling with lists where too many phone numbers were disconnected, invalid, or associated with the wrong person. The person hired for this position will be responsible for significantly improving the quality of the data before it ever reaches our callers.



Ideal candidate:

• Previous PropStream experience strongly preferred

• Previous DealMachine experience strongly preferred

• Experience with real estate lead generation or property research

• Experience with skip tracing and phone-number verification

• Strong Google Sheets / Excel skills

• Extremely detail-oriented

• Understands deduplication and database cleanup

• Comfortable researching individual properties when information conflicts

• Able to follow detailed targeting criteria without adding irrelevant properties



Roofing experience is NOT required. Real estate/property-data experience is much more important.



Performance will be measured by:

• Percentage of records containing usable contact information

• Low duplicate rate

• Low wrong-number/disconnected-number rate

• Accuracy of property-owner information

• Ability to follow geographic/property targeting criteria

• Number of clean, call-ready records produced



When applying, please answer the following:



-How long have you used PropStream?

-How long have you used DealMachine?

-What skip-tracing tools have you used?



Describe how you would verify whether a phone number belongs to the correct property owner.

-If I gave you 1,000 raw property records, what steps would you take before handing the list to a cold caller?

-Approximately how many clean, verified homeowner records could you prepare in a 4-hour shift?



Please start your application with the words “CLEAN DATA” so I know you read the entire posting.

Candidates who perform well will have the opportunity for increased hours and long-term work.

title: Recruiter
description:

Childcare Marketing | Remote-First | Full-Time





Position Overview

We are looking for a Recruiter who can identify exceptional talent, build strong candidate relationships, and help Childcare Marketing and our clients build high-performing teams.



The Recruiter owns the full recruitment lifecycle - from sourcing and attracting candidates to conducting interviews, managing communication, and supporting successful hires. This role requires someone who understands that great recruiting is not about collecting resumes; it is about finding the right people who align with the opportunity, culture, and long-term goals.



You will partner closely with hiring managers to understand their needs, create effective sourcing strategies, and deliver a seamless hiring experience for both candidates and internal stakeholders.





Why You Should Work Here 



Work That Matters: You transform lives by connecting families who need quality child care with the providers who serve them. 



Recession-Proof Growth: An established, fast-growing company that continues to thrive while many competitors struggle. 



Leadership That Has Your Back: A supportive, attentive team that answers your questions and helps you grow, professionally and personally. 



An Owner Who Shows Up: Our owner is actively involved in the business - not just a name on the door. 



Small-Team Feel: A friendly, tight-knit environment where you are a person, not a headcount. 



Remote-First Flexibility: Work remotely while staying connected to a fast-moving, collaborative team. Buffalo-area candidates may also have opportunities for occasional in-person meetings, strategy sessions, or team gatherings. 



Top-of-Market Pay: We pay above market because we hire the best and want to keep them. 



Train to Be the Best: Access $100K+ in training, courses, and materials - enough to make you more knowledgeable than 99.9% of the account managers our competitors employ. 



A Workspace That Feels 
 Working from home can get lonely, so our virtual Sims-like office keeps the team connected day to day. 



Quarterly Town Halls: Every quarter, you get a full state-of-the-company update, so you are never guessing where things stand. 



The Dream-On Program: Each year, our CEO grants multiple wishes pulled straight from tea
mbers' dream boards.

What Success Looks Like

Reviewing recruitment metrics and identifying opportunities to improve sourcing strategies, candidate quality, and hiring efficiency.

title: Senior Full-Stack Accountant (NetSuite & QBO Expert)
description:
The Role:

We are a US-based fractional CFO and accounting firm looking for an elite, highly skilled Senior Accountant.



Let’s be clear: We are not looking for a manager, a "player-coach," or someone who wants to delegate tasks to a junior team. We are looking for a highly capable individual contributor who is a master of their craft. You must be just as comfortable doing manual PDF data entry, bank feeds, and receipt chasing as you are preparing complex financial statements and investigating discrepancies in NetSuite.



If you are a true expert, we will pay top of the market for your skills. This is a direct-hire role. No BPO, no agencies.



Working Hours (Non-Negotiable):

You must work US Eastern Time hours.



Initial Period: During training/onboarding, you must start your shift between 9:00 AM and 10:00 AM US Eastern.



Long-Term Flexibility: Once you are fully trained and have proven your competence, you can choose your start time anywhere between 7:00 AM and 12:00 PM (Noon) US Eastern.



What You Will Do (Daily & Transactional):



Full-Cycle AP/AR: Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable across multiple clients. Create invoices, add receipts/bills (including landed costs), and process contractor payments.



PO & Disbursements: Act as the final gatekeeper for vendor payments. Review Purchase Orders (POs) for strict compliance and accuracy before setting up wire transfers or payments.



Bank Feeds & Data Entry: Roll up your sleeves for foundational tasks. Clear daily bank feeds in QBO/NetSuite and manually load transactions from PDF statements when necessary.



Inbox & Admin: Manage the accounting inboxes, respond professionally to client and vendor
s, and organize shared folders.



What You Will Do (High-Level & Month-End):



Financial Statements: Prepare, review, and finalize monthly financial statements under US GAAP.



Complex Reconciliations: Independently investigate and resolve complex vendor PO issues, payment advances, and messy balance sheet discrepancies.



Reporting: Assist with weekly cash flow projections, daily wire sheets, and top-level financial reporting for a major client running on NetSuite.



Must-Haves:



Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.



Systems: Deep, verifiable, hands-on experience in BOTH NetSuite and QuickBooks Online (QBO).



Background: Prior experience working in a vCFO, agency, or multi-client accounting environment.



Mindset: A "no task is too small" attitude combined with a senior-level analytical brain. You must know how to investigate a discrepancy and propose a solution, not just report the error.



Software: Advanced Excel skills (ability to parse, clean, and reconcile complex data).



Security: Willingness to use time-and-screen tracking software during billable hours (mandatory for our firm's data security protocols).



How to Apply (READ CAREFULLY):

We use a strict filtering process. To apply, you must send us a message on this platform following these exact instructions. If these instructions are not followed, your application will be immediately deleted.



Make the subject line of your message EXACTLY: Pivotal - Senior Accountant



Do not send a generic cover letter. Instead, answer this specific scenario in the body of your message using 4 sentences or less: You are reviewing a messy Balance Sheet in NetSuite and notice a significant unexplained variance in Accounts Payable, and simultaneously have a vendor
ing you requesting a wire transfer for a PO. What is your exact step-by-step process for handling both issues?



Attach your resume or provide a link to your LinkedIn profile.

title: Product Development & Sourcing Manager
description:
About AUGO

Take life to go.



That’s what AUGO is about. For the mom whose back door is always open with kids and dogs running through. For the off-roader strapping his ATV onto the truck. For families, adventurers, and everyone in between — AUGO is built to come with you.



We’re a family-owned US e-commerce brand selling durable, practical products across home and outdoor categories — including our magnetic screen doors and retractable ratchet straps. We’ve built a strong Amazon business with thousands of 5-star reviews, selling across Amazon US and Europe, Walmart, and TikTok Shop.



We grow by launching new products. To do that at the pace we want, we need someone who can build them.



The Role

We’re looking for a Product Development & Sourcing Specialist to own everything between a product idea and a product that’s ready to launch.



The ideas are not the problem — we have more of them than we can execute. The problem is the middle: turning a direction into a complete, manufacturer-ready specification, finding the right factories, getting real quotes back, driving samples to a decision, and getting the product ready to go live on Amazon.



Our target is ten new products live every quarter. You are the person who makes that possible.



You’ll take a product idea and rough direction from our Head of R&D and carry it through specs, sourcing, quotes, negotiation, samples, and the product-side setup of the listing. You’ll direct our existing sourcing agent and deal with factories yourself.



This is not an assistant role. You are not waiting for instructions — you are the person who makes sure nothing sits.



Full-time. Reports directly to our Head of R&D.



What You’ll Own

Product Specs & Details

Develop detailed, brand-aligned product specifications — materials, colours, comfort, construction, and the features that differentiate the product — while meeting target costs, competitive pricing, and product-appropriate shipping dimensions. The Amazon size tier gets confirmed before the design is frozen, because half an inch changes the fee.



A complete spec pack within 1–2 days of approval, written so a factory can quote from it unchanged.



Manufacturer Search

Go wide, then narrow. Work Alibaba, 1688 and other channels to find and approach a large pool of factories, verify capability and capacity, and bring it down to a shortlist worth quoting.



5–8 strong, verified suppliers for each approved product within 3–5 business days.



Pricing, Landed Cost & Negotiation

Take the shortlist to real numbers. Negotiate, calculate landed cost per unit, and tell us whether the margin works. Not a quote-forwarder — the person who knows whether the number is good and pushes until it is.



Best realistic price, MOQ, lead time, payment terms and packaging all confirmed before sample approval. Quotes collected within 2–3 days.



Supplier Follow-Up

Suppliers go quiet. The job is to not let that stop anything.



No supplier question sits unanswered. Follow-ups happen daily until resolved.



Samples Through to a Decision

Order samples from the shortlist, track them, compare them against the spec, and run the revision rounds through to a final answer.



Samples ordered within 1–2 days of a decision to sample. Every change documented, every sample driven to a written approval or rejection.



Product Setup & Launch Readiness

Create and manage UPC, SKU, FNSKU and QR codes. Own packaging, inserts, warnings and labelling to AUGO’s established standards. Confirm packaging and FBA dimensions directly with the factory. Direct product images, A+ content and video — the person who knows the product’s specs and materials briefs the creative.



Organised Data & Reporting

Every product has a clear supplier comparison showing company quality, quote, specs, risks, open questions and a recommendation. An end-of-day report every working day, a weekly scorecard and KPIs, and daily contact with the Head of R&D.



Nobody should ever have to ask you where a product stands.



What Success Looks Like

•             Spec packs complete in 1–2 days and good enough to quote from unchanged



•             5–8 verified suppliers per product within 3–5 business days



•             Landed cost per unit calculated for every finalist and presented side by side



•             Every sample reaching a written decision against the spec — nothing sitting in a box



•             Products moving through the pipeline without being chased



•             The Head of R&D’s time spent on sourcing and specs measurably down



30 / 60 / 90 Day Plan

First 30 Days — Learn the Products and the System

•             Learn AUGO’s catalogue, the two hero products, and the pipeline end to end



•             Meet the sourcing agent and our active factories



•             Learn our spec format and rebuild one existing product’s spec pack from scratch



•             Understand FBA size tiers as they apply to our actual SKUs



•             Shadow a live product through at least two stages



•             The end-of-day report starts on day one



Days 31–60 — Take the Work

•             Own the specs outright. Take the product idea and direction from our Head of R&D and turn it into a complete, manufacturer-ready specification: materials and their grades, real-world dimensions and tolerances, construction and how each feature is actually built, colourways and finishes, packaging, inserts and labelling.



•             Do the work behind the spec. A direction is not a specification. You research what you don’t know, work out the parts nobody has worked out yet, and come back with something that can actually be built — and defend how you got there.



•             Catch the dimensional problems before the design is frozen, including the half inch that moves us into a worse FBA size tier.



•             Run a full search-to-shortlist cycle alone across Alibaba, 1688 and other channels — approaching factories, verifying capability and capacity, narrowing to a shortlist worth quoting.



•             Send RFQs, chase quotes to completion, and build the supplier comparison with landed cost per unit — without help



•             Reporting is running and nobody has to ask for it



Days 61–90 — Own It

•             Carry products from approval to approved sample with no chasing



•             Five to six products launched or launch-ready against forecast



•             Clear supplier and cost documentation in place



•             A credible pipeline toward the ten-product quarterly goal



Required Experience

•             Hands-on product sourcing experience — you’ve found factories yourself across Alibaba, 1688 or other channels, engaged suppliers directly, requested and compared meaningful quotes, and argued about MOQ and unit price. This is not a role for someone who has only “worked with suppliers.”



•             Experience taking a physical product from idea through to production



•             Managed a supplier relationship through at least one full production run



•             E-commerce experience — Amazon private label strongly preferred



•             Amazon Seller Central experience preferred, not required



Requirements

Required Skills

•             Sourcing. Sources efficiently across Alibaba, 1688 and other channels. Identifies and engages reliable suppliers. Requests and compares meaningful quotes.



•             Amazon listing literacy. You read a listing the way a seller does, not the way a shopper does — pulling dimensions, materials, construction and packaging detail off competitor listings and feeding it back into a spec.



•             Numeracy, genuinely. Margins, landed cost per unit, freight allocated per unit, CBM, percentages, FBA size tiers and dimensional weight. This job is arithmetic every day.



•             Clear written specifications — appropriately phased, without unnecessary complexity, and without simply transferring supplier listings into a spreadsheet.



•             Strong written English. You’ll report daily in writing and negotiate with factories in writing.



•             Reliable computer and internet connection, and daily overlap with our Head of R&D.



Who You Are

•             You figure things out. The idea and the direction come from our Head of R&D. Turning that into a real product — every part nobody has worked out yet — is on you. You go and find out rather than assume, you’re resourceful about how you get there, and what you come back with holds up.



•             Follow-through is your identity. You chase without being told to.



•             You push back on a first price. A quote is an opening position, not an answer.



•             Detail-oriented where it costs money — you catch a spec error before it becomes 2,000 defective units.



•             You balance quality, differentiation, cost and shipping practicality rather than optimising one and breaking the others.



•             Comfortable owning a pipeline, not just completing tasks handed to you.



•             Direct communicator. You flag a delay before it becomes one.



What We’ll Teach You

Our brand standards, product point of view, customer preferences, target price architecture, and the specific qualities that make a product right for our brand. Also the Amazon fee schedules and calculators, our spec templates, our existing suppliers and sourcing agent, and our internal tools and reporting rhythm.



We’re hiring for sourcing instinct and follow-through. The rest we can hand over.



Benefits

Benefits & Culture — Why You’ll Thrive at AUGO

Real Ownership

You run the product pipeline, not a task list. From spec to launch-ready, the product is yours.



Direct Line to Decision-Makers

You’ll work daily with our Head of R&D. No committees, no waiting weeks for an answer.



Paid Onboarding

We invest in training you properly rather than throwing you at the deep end on day one.



Your Work Is Visible

Every product you bring through shows up as a live listing with your fingerprints on it.



A Brand with Proven Traction

Thousands of 5-star reviews on Amazon. We’re not asking you to build from zero — we’re asking you to help us build faster.



Room to Grow

The product line and the team are both growing. So is this role.



Performance-Based Raises

Reviewed after 90 days, then annually.



Fully Remote

Work from wherever you’re most productive.



We review applications within 48 hours and reach out to qualified candidates for next steps.

title: Senior Video Editor + Motion Graphics Artist needed for regular, ongoing work
description:
THE COMPANY

Avalon Creative Group is a well established and innovative content marketing agency based in the San Francisco Bay Area and Silicon Valley, California. We specialize in the creation of captivating and engaging content for corporate clients, offering comprehensive content design, production, and creative services. Working with Avalon is an exciting opportunity to join an award winning team of amazing designers, create content for renowned brands, and to expand your potential in a positive environment that encourages continuous learning for professional growth.



JOB DESCRIPTION

Avalon Creative Group is seeking a talented and experienced video editor and 3D animator based in the Philippines to work with us as an independent contractor. Our work includes videos to inspire audiences at corporate events, on-demand marketing webinars, internal corporate training and sales enablement, product demos, highlight reels, social media ads, interviews, customer testimonials and more. 



Our goal is to establish a long term working relationship with a creative, reliable and ambitious video professional. After successfully completing an initial trial period, the right person will become an integral member of our creative team on a full-time contract basis.



RESPONSIBILITIES

>>Edit high quality videos from a variety of sources, including single-camera, multi-camera, stock footage, AI generated video, graphic elements, music, sound effects, etc.

>>Effectively and efficiently generate video footage and elements using the latest AI tools

>>Manage accuracy and correction of color and audio

>>Understand and apply corporate branding and style guidelines and templates (MOGRTs)

>>Manage, organize and backup video assets and deliverables, including raw footage, graphics, sound files, stock footage, projects, files, etc.

>>Adhere to budgeted time constraints while incorporating client feedback and changes through multiple rounds of review and revisions

>>Contribute to and consistently apply efficient workflow processes and standards (SOPs)

>>Document guidelines and process details for team members and clients

>>Pursue ongoing professional development and skill enhancements



REQUIRED SKILLS

>>Expert level proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, centered around Premiere Pro and After Effects workflows

>>Proficiency in color correction, audio editing / mastering and video encoding

>>Demonstrated expertise in video editing fundamentals and techniques, including pacing, storytelling, and continuity

>>Excellent attention to detail and adeptness at managing multiple concurrent projects

>>Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a remote team environment

>>C2 (advanced/mastery) level proficiency in written and spoken English



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

>>At least 2 years of experience working full time as a video editor at a creative agency or in-house corporate video marketing team

>>At least 5 years of experience using Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects for professional, paid projects

>>A proven track record of punctuality, reliability and professionalism

>>Experience using a variety of AI post-production tools

>>Familiarity with team collaboration, communication and project management tools like ClickUp, Slack, Smartsheet, or similar platforms



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

>>Bachelor's degree in film making, visual communications or similar discipline

>>10 years of experience with Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects.

>>Strong understanding of visual composition, typography, and graphic design principles

>>Completion of training and/or certifications in Adobe Creative Suite applications

>>Knowledge of social media platforms and their video encoding specifications

>>Experience with 3D software like Blender, Cinema4D, or similar



ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

>>You must have strong creative skills and a portfolio of work that demonstrates your passion and experience with video editing, motion graphics and visual storytelling

>>Your portfolio must include examples of the type of work listed in the job description section

>>You must be based in the Philippines with fast, reliable internet access and a robust computer

>>You must have a quiet workspace where you can work without distractions and joining Zoom calls





COMPENSATION & ENGAGEMENT

>>This is a full-time, independent contractor and remote work position

>>Compensation rate will be between $1200 & $1600 USD per month

>>(A range of approximately ?73,800 to ?98,400 PHP per month as of Sun, Aug 16, 2026 PT)

>>Starting pay rate will be based on qualifications and experience

>>Total compensation includes:

>>Ten paid holidays per year

>>Ten days of accrued paid time off (PTO) per year

>>13th month pay and annual performance bonus paid every Dec after qualification period

>>Regular work schedule will be 9:00am to 6:00pm Pacific Time Zone

>>This is night shift in the Philippines



HOW TO APPLY If you are interested in working with us as an independent contractor and you meet the required qualifications listed above, please APPLY HERE -
