title: Full-Time Short-Form Video Editor | Direct Hire | Long-Term Position
description:
Compensation: $200–$250 USD per week to start

Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week

Location: Remote

Position: Direct hire — individual applicants only



About the Position



We are looking for a talented full-time video editor to work directly with us and become a long-term part of our team.



Our goal is simple:



We provide the raw footage. You turn it into polished, engaging, ready-to-post content.



We produce content for both a growing service business and a personal/business brand. Our videos cover entrepreneurship, leadership, business, education, behind-the-scenes content, our team, and the services our company provides.



Most of our content will be short-form videos for:



Instagram Reels

 Reels

TikTok

YouTube Shorts

LinkedIn

Other social platforms



We also plan to increase our longer-form video content over time.



DIRECT HIRE ONLY — PLEASE READ



This is extremely important.



We want to hire and work directly with the person who will actually be editing our videos.



Please DO NOT apply if:



You are an agency

You represent a team of editors

You intend to subcontract the work

You intend to outsource any of our editing

Someone else will actually be completing the editing

You are looking to manage the account while another person performs the work



The person who applies, interviews, and completes our editing test must be the same person who will be working with us and editing our content.



We will be working very closely together.



Over time, we expect our editor to learn our brands, personalities, editing preferences, content style, and what we like and don't like.



Our goal is to develop a relationship where we can eventually provide raw footage and trust you to know how to turn it into a great finished video without needing detailed instructions every time.



We are looking for a long-term team member, not a freelancer for a few projects.



Your Primary Responsibility



This is a VIDEO EDITING position.



It is NOT primarily:



Social media management

Virtual assistance

Graphic design

Administrative work

Content scheduling



Those skills are fine to have, but they are not why we are hiring you.



Your strongest skill should be video editing.



If video editing is simply one of many different services you provide, this probably isn't the right position.



What You'll Be Doing



Your responsibilities will include:



Taking raw footage and turning it into finished short-form videos

Editing videos typically between 30–90 seconds

Finding the strongest opening/hook

Removing dead space, mistakes, repetition, and unnecessary content

Improving pacing and viewer retention

Creating clean, professional captions

Adding punch-ins, zooms, movement, and transitions where appropriate

Adding B-roll when it improves the story

Adding music and sound effects when appropriate

Cleaning up and balancing audio

Performing basic color correction

Formatting content correctly for vertical 9:16 social platforms

Following established branding and editing standards

Organizing project files and completed videos

Making revisions when necessary

Eventually reviewing longer recordings and identifying multiple strong short-form clips on your own



We do NOT want every video filled with effects, animations, emojis, or unnecessary transitions.



Our style should feel clean, modern, professional, natural, and engaging.



Good editing should improve the content without making the editing itself the focus.



What We're Looking For



We want someone who:



Has demonstrated short-form video editing ability

Understands modern Reels, Shorts, and TikTok editing

Understands hooks and viewer retention

Has excellent pacing

Can recognize the strongest parts of raw footage

Has good creative judgment

Can follow an established editing style

Can eventually work without detailed instructions on every video

Communicates clearly

Is dependable

Meets deadlines

Is organized

Responds well to feedback

Wants to continuously improve



You should be comfortable working with software such as:



CapCut

Adobe Premiere Pro

DaVinci Resolve

Or comparable professional editing software



We care significantly more about the quality of your work than degrees, certifications, or how many years you've been editing.



What Success Looks Like



Initially, we expect to work closely together while you learn our preferred editing style.



As you become familiar with our content, we expect the amount of direction required to decrease.



Eventually, we want the workflow to be:



We record → upload raw footage → you edit → finished content is ready for review.



A successful editor in this position will consistently produce:



High-quality videos

Strong pacing

Clean editing

Fast turnaround

Consistent branding

Few unnecessary revisions

Reliable communication

Compensation



Starting compensation will be $200–$250 USD per week, depending on demonstrated editing ability and experience.



This is a full-time position.



This is also intended to be a long-term relationship with room to grow.



As your skills, responsibilities, speed, independence, and value to our team increase, there will be opportunities for increased compensation.



We're willing to pay more as the relationship grows.



What matters to us is finding the right person.



How to Apply



Please follow these instructions carefully.



At the very beginning of your application, write:



ORANGE VIDEO



Applications that do not include this may not be reviewed.



Then send us:



A short introduction about yourself.

Links to 3–5 of the best short-form videos YOU personally edited.

Briefly explain exactly what you did on those videos.

Tell us which editing software you primarily use.

Tell us about your experience editing talking-head, business, educational, or personal-brand content.

Tell us whether you currently work for other clients or employers.

Confirm that you personally will perform all editing work and will not subcontract or outsource our videos.

Confirm that you are interested in a full-time, long-term position.

Tell us your expected weekly compensation in USD.



Please do not send dozens of portfolio links.



We would rather see your 3 best videos than 30 average ones.



Paid Editing Test



Candidates who appear to be a strong fit will be invited to complete a paid editing test using our actual raw footage.



Multiple candidates may receive the same footage so that we can compare editing ability fairly.



We will pay candidates who are selected to complete the test.



We're not looking for the person who writes the best application or has the most impressive résumé.



We're looking for the person who can take our raw footage and consistently turn it into excellent content.



If you're an excellent editor looking for a stable, long-term position where you can work closely with a growing company and become an important part of our content operation, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
NOOR COMPANIES

Real Estate Development  ·  General Contracting

POSITION ANNOUNCEMENT

Executive Assistant to the CEO

Full-Time  |  Remote  |  Direct Support to the Chief Executive Officer

REPORTS TO Chief Executive Officer

EMPLOYMENT Full-time, 40 hours per week. Exclusive — the successful candidate may not hold other employment or clients.

SCHEDULE 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Central Time, Monday through Friday

Equivalent to 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM Manila. Night-shift availability is mandatory.

COMPENSATION $500 – $800 USD per month, commensurate with experience

Performance review at 90 days · 13th month pay · Paid Philippine holidays

LOCATION Fully remote



  THE ORGANIZATION



Noor Companies is a real estate development and general contracting firm headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota. We develop and build affordable housing, civic institutions, healthcare facilities, libraries, and mixed-use projects, and we are among the largest woman-owned firms of our kind in the country, with more than $500 million in completed work.

Development and construction operate on immovable deadlines. Permits, inspections, closings, draw schedules, and subcontractor commitments do not wait. The Executive Assistant to the CEO works at the center of that environment.

  POSITION SUMMARY



This is a critical, high-trust position functioning as a mini chief of staff to the Chief Executive Officer. The Executive Assistant manages the CEO’s inbox, calendar, meetings, events, correspondence, and social media presence, fields inbound requests on the CEO’s behalf, and supports the analysis and reporting the CEO relies on to make decisions.

The environment is fast-paced and the priorities change throughout the day. The successful candidate operates with a pronounced sense of urgency, responds quickly, communicates continuously, and takes full ownership of every item entrusted to them. Nothing is permitted to fall through the cracks.

Prior experience as an Executive Assistant reporting directly to a busy CEO, president, or owner is required. General administrative, customer service, and virtual assistant experience does not substitute for this requirement. Applications that do not demonstrate it will not be considered.



  ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES



Calendar & Inbox Management

• Own and protect the CEO’s calendar; schedule, reschedule, and resolve conflicts proactively and defend blocks of focused work

• Manage the CEO’s
: triage daily, escalate what is urgent, draft responses for approval, and independently handle routine correspondence

• Field inbound requests directed to the CEO, determine what requires their attention, and redirect or resolve the remainder

• Set up meetings with internal staff, clients, consultants, subcontractors, lenders, and community partners, including agendas and prepared materials

• Provide a written start-of-day plan and end-of-day summary, with status updates throughout the day

Communications & Written Work

• Draft, edit, and format professional correspondence, memoranda, letters, and internal communications

• Assist in the preparation of proposals, qualifications packages, and responses to requests for proposal

• Prepare and format presentations in PowerPoint for clients, partners, lenders, and board or community meetings

• Maintain document organization and version control across active projects

Events & Meeting Coordination

• Coordinate company events, groundbreakings, ribbon cuttings, client functions, and community engagements end to end

• Manage logistics, vendor coordination, invitations, RSVPs, run-of-show, and follow-up

• Arrange business travel, itineraries, and accommodations; prepare and submit expense reports

Marketing & Social Media

• Manage the CEO’s and the company’s social media presence, including drafting, scheduling, and publishing content

• Produce simple graphics and marketing collateral using Canva or comparable design tools

• Support marketing initiatives, project announcements, award submissions, and website content updates

Analysis, Reporting & Bookkeeping Support

• Build and maintain spreadsheets, trackers, and reports supporting project timelines, budgets, vendors, and expenses

• Compile and summarize data for the CEO, identifying discrepancies and drawing attention to items that require action

• Provide bookkeeping support including invoice processing, expense coding, receipt reconciliation, and coordination with the accounting team

Human Resources & Administrative Support

• Support recruiting logistics, including scheduling interviews and coordinating candidate communications

• Assist with onboarding documentation, personnel file maintenance, and administration of company policies

• Maintain confidentiality of sensitive personnel, financial, and business information without exception

• Document standard operating procedures for recurring responsibilities

  REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Minimum three (3) years of experience as an Executive Assistant reporting directly to a CEO, president, or business owner in a fast-paced environment. This requirement is not waivable.

• Demonstrated ability to manage a demanding executive calendar and inbox independently, exercising judgment about priority and urgency without direction.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel — formulas including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIF and IF statements, pivot tables, filtering, and professional formatting. Must be able to build a tracker or report from a blank worksheet.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Microsoft Word — able to produce polished, client-ready decks and professionally formatted documents.

• Strong numerical literacy — comfort working with budgets, invoices, schedules of values, and financial summaries, and the ability to identify an error in a set of numbers.

• Working knowledge of bookkeeping fundamentals — invoicing, expense coding, and reconciliation. Familiarity with QuickBooks preferred.

• Exposure to human resources administration — interview scheduling, onboarding coordination, and personnel recordkeeping.

• Marketing and social media experience — managing business accounts, drafting content, and maintaining a consistent professional voice.

• Basic graphic design capability — Canva or comparable tools, sufficient to produce clean marketing materials and simple layouts.

• Superior written English. Written work is issued under the CEO’s name and must be correct in grammar, tone, and punctuation without revision.

• Fluent, clearly articulate spoken English, suitable for daily calls and direct contact with US clients, consultants, and subcontractors.

• Reliable home office — computer with a minimum of 8GB RAM, internet service of 25 Mbps or greater, a secondary internet source, a headset, and a quiet, professional work environment.

  PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Experience supporting an executive in real estate development, construction, architecture, or a related industry

• Familiarity with Procore, Buildertrend, AppFolio, or comparable construction and property management platforms

• Experience with proposal and RFP response preparation

• Working knowledge of QuickBooks, Asana, ClickUp, Notion, Slack, or the Adobe Creative Suite

• Bachelor’s degree in business administration, communications, or a related field

  CORE COMPETENCIES



• Sense of Urgency. Responds promptly and moves work forward without being prompted. Understands that in this industry a delayed response carries a cost.

• Ownership and Accountability. Assumes full responsibility for assigned matters through completion. Raises problems early rather than concealing them.

• Continuous Communication. Maintains frequent contact throughout the workday regarding completed work, obstacles, and changes in status. Silence is not acceptable in this role.

• Attention to Detail. Catches errors in dates, figures, names, and documents before they are transmitted.

• Adaptability. Adjusts to shifting priorities throughout the day without losing track of work already in progress.

• Professionalism and Discretion. Represents the CEO and the firm appropriately in all communications and safeguards confidential information absolutely.

• Sound Judgment. Determines what warrants the CEO’s attention and what does not, and knows when to ask rather than assume.

• Aptitude for Learning. Absorbs new systems and procedures quickly, takes independent notes, and does not require repeated instruction.

  APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Applicants must complete all four steps below. Adherence to instructions is evaluated as part of this application, as it is a core requirement of the position. Incomplete submissions will not be reviewed.

Step 1 — Subject Line

Use the following subject line exactly as written:

CEO EA — Chicago Skyline

title: Behavioral Health Insurance Verification Specialist
description:
Verification of Benefits Specialist

The Purpose of Your Role



The Verification of Benefits (VOB) Specialist verifies insurance eligibility, benefits, and authorization requirements for prospective clients seeking behavioral health treatment services, including Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP) and Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP) levels of care.



Working closely with the Admissions, Utilization Review, and Business Office teams, this role ensures benefit information is accurate, clearly communicated, and properly documented before admission. The VOB Specialist supports a smooth intake process by confirming coverage details, identifying payer-specific requirements, determining financial responsibility, and helping the team understand whether a client’s insurance benefits align with the recommended level of care.



This role requires strong attention to detail, familiarity with behavioral health insurance benefits, and the ability to navigate complex payer requirements for IOP/PHP services in a timely, accurate, and compliant manner.



Core Values

Growth

Proactivity

Positivity

Results Driven



We set the bar that high for practical and aspirational reasons. Candidates with similar ethical standards, the ability to adapt in a fast-moving work culture, and a commitment to providing excellent client service are encouraged to apply.



Key Performance Indicators

* 100% accuracy in benefit verification and documentation.

* 100% of verifications completed within one hour of request.

* Maintain a variance of less than 2% between verified benefits and actual payer reimbursement outcomes.

* Accurately identify IOP/PHP coverage, authorization requirements, exclusions, limitations, and payer-specific rules before admission.

* Please note: When you achieve any of the above key indicators, your supervisor will counsel with you to set a new goal.





Core Responsibilities

* Insurance Verification and Eligibility

* Contact insurance companies through outbound calls and payer portals to verify behavioral health benefits and eligibility for prospective clients.

* Verify benefit details specific to IOP, PHP, outpatient behavioral health, and other applicable levels of care.

* Accurately obtain and document deductibles, copays, coinsurance, out-of-pocket maximums, remaining balances, authorization requirements, visit limits, exclusions, and coverage limitations.

* Identify requirements for pre-authorizations, concurrent reviews, single case agreements, medical necessity criteria, or other payer-specific conditions prior to admission.

* Confirm whether behavioral health benefits are carved in, carved out, managed by a third-party administrator, or subject to separate authorization rules.

* Escalate unclear, conflicting, or complex benefit information to leadership, Admissions, Utilization Review, or the Business Office as appropriate.





Behavioral Health and IOP/PHP Support

* Understand the difference between common behavioral health levels of care, including outpatient, IOP, PHP, residential, and inpatient treatment.

* Verify whether the prospective client’s benefits support the recommended level of care and communicate any concerns that may affect admission, authorization, or reimbursement.

* Support Admissions by clearly explaining payer requirements, financial responsibility, and documentation needs related to behavioral health treatment.

* Help identify potential reimbursement risks before admission, including non-covered services, authorization gaps, payer limitations, or inaccurate benefit information.



Documentation and Systems

* Document all benefit information, payer communications, reference numbers, authorization requirements, and financial responsibility details accurately and thoroughly in the EHR system.

* Maintain an organized system for initial and ongoing benefit verifications.

* Ensure benefit information remains current and reflects any changes prior to admission.

* Support accurate handoff documentation for Admissions, Utilization Review, billing, and leadership.





Client and Team Communication

* Communicate clearly and professionally with Admissions, Utilization Review, and the Business Office regarding client insurance benefits and financial responsibility.

* Provide timely updates when benefits are incomplete, unclear, or require additional payer follow-up.

* Communicate effectively with insurance payers to obtain accurate information and resolve discrepancies.

* Maintain a service-minded approach while supporting prospective clients and internal teams through the intake process.





Compliance and Collaboration

* Regularly audit verification of benefits activities to identify inaccuracies, trends, process gaps, and payer-specific issues.

* Collaborate with leadership, Admissions, Utilization Review, and Business Office staff to improve accuracy, efficiency, and compliance.

* Help reduce recurring verification errors by following best practices and documenting payer requirements consistently.

* Adhere to all company policies, procedures, HIPAA requirements, and compliance standards.

* Perform additional duties as assigned by leadership.





Application Instruction

If you’ve read the job description thoroughly, please include “Pineapple” in the subject line of your
 and attach a link to your most updated resume in your message.



Education and Experience

* High school diploma or equivalent required.

* Minimum of two years of experience in insurance verification of benefits, medical billing, utilization review, admissions, revenue cycle, or a related healthcare role.

* Behavioral health experience strongly preferred.

* Experience verifying benefits for IOP, PHP, outpatient behavioral health, residential, or inpatient treatment services preferred.

* Experience working with admissions, utilization review, or behavioral health billing teams preferred.





Technical Skills

* Proficiency in medical billing software and EHR systems, such as Imagine, ADS, or similar systems.

* Lightning Step experience preferred.

* Demonstrated knowledge of insurance eligibility and benefits verification.

* Strong understanding of behavioral health benefits, medical terminology, payer requirements, and medical billing practices.

* Familiarity with IOP/PHP authorization requirements, payer portals, reference numbers, benefit documentation, and financial responsibility calculations.

* Accurate and efficient electronic data entry skills.

* Soft Skills

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Excellent organization, time management, and attention to detail.

* Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced admissions environment.

* Ability to communicate effectively with insurance payers and obtain accurate information.

* Strong follow-through and ability to identify issues before they delay admission or create reimbursement concerns.

* Comfortable working with sensitive behavioral health information in a professional, confidential, and compliant manner.

title: Executive Assistant — Travel, Calendar & Records (Part-Time, Long-Term)
description:
I'm looking for a reliable, detail-focused executive assistant to support a US-based Islamic scholar who travels nationally to speak. You'll be the person who makes his travel, calendar, and engagement follow-up run smoothly so he can focus on his work.



This is a long-term role. I'd rather find one person who stays for years than cycle through people.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Travel — research and book flights, hotels, and ground transport. Manage changes and rebooking. Build complete itineraries with confirmation numbers, addresses, and contacts.

- Calendar — maintain the master schedule and catch conflicts before they happen. Confirm engagements with the other party rather than just entering them.

- Records — build and maintain a contact database of organizations, hosts, and partners. Keep files organized.

- Invoicing and follow-up — send invoices on schedule, track who has paid and who hasn't, and follow up politely and persistently.

- Correspondence — draft routine
s for my approval. Request event details from hosts.

- Inbox triage — sort what needs my attention from what doesn't.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



- Ruthlessly organized. You catch the conflict, the math error, and the missing confirmation before anyone else does.

- Strong written English. You'll be writing to community leaders and organizations on my behalf. Professional and warm.

- Comfortable with numbers. Not accounting — just accurate tracking of who owes what.

- Reliable. You do what you said, when you said it. Every time.

- Proactive. You tell me about the problem before I find it.

- Comfortable with AI tools. I use Claude daily and expect you to use it to work faster.

- Familiarity with the Muslim community and Islamic terminology is strongly preferred. You'll be corresponding with masjids and Islamic organizations, and understanding the context matters.



TOOLS

Google Workspace (Calendar, Gmail, Sheets, Drive), Claude, WhatsApp, and a shared task system.



HOURS, SCHEDULE AND PAY



- $4.50 USD per hour.

- 15-20 hours per week for the first month while we work through a backlog, then settling to around 10-15 hours per week ongoing, with room to grow.

- Working window: 8:00 PM - 12:00 AM Philippine time, Monday to Friday. This is when focused work happens and when you log your hours. You need to be reliably available in that window — please don't apply if you can't sustain it long-term.

- Light availability during your day. Outside the working window, please check messages a couple of times during your normal waking hours and answer quick questions. Nothing that requires sitting at your desk. If something turns into real work, log the time and bill it. Stop when you go to sleep — I don't expect anything overnight, on weekends, or on Islamic holidays.

- You log your actual hours; I approve them. You're paid for time worked.

- Paid twice monthly via Wise.



HOW WE WORK

Everything is in writing — no calls. You'll get a detailed onboarding document explaining how the role works, the standing rules, and what to escalate. Questions are always welcome; I'd much rather answer than have you guess.



HIRING PROCESS

1. Apply with the questions below

2. Shortlisted candidates complete two short paid tasks (about one hour total, paid at the full hourly rate whether or not we proceed)

3. One small live request to see turnaround time

4. Offer



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word KHIDMAH so I know you read the full post.



Then answer these four questions directly. Please don't send a generic cover letter — I read the answers, not the template.



1. What hours can you reliably work, in Philippine time, long-term? Be honest — I'd rather know now.

2. What is your internet and power backup situation?

3. Describe one decision you made at work without checking with your manager first. What was it, and how did it turn out?

4. Have you booked travel for someone else before? If yes, tell me about one trip. If no, say so — it's not a dealbreaker.

title: Paid Advertising Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION



Our client, based in the United States, is looking for an experienced Paid Advertising Specialist to manage advertising campaigns across Meta and YouTube.



This is a remote, part time or full time, client-facing position. The ideal candidate will have experience managing paid advertising for multiple clients and will be comfortable communicating directly with clients about campaign performance, recommendations, and next steps.



ROLE OVERVIEW



The Paid Advertising Specialist is a hands-on, client-facing role responsible for building, managing, and optimizing paid campaigns across Meta and YouTube. This person will manage multiple client accounts, communicate directly with clients, monitor campaign performance, and provide clear recommendations and reporting.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Build, launch, and manage paid advertising campaigns across Meta and YouTube.

- Manage campaigns, deadlines, and priorities across multiple client accounts.

- Communicate directly with clients about campaign performance, recommendations, and next steps.

- Participate in client meetings and provide clear, professional campaign updates.

- Follow established SOPs, campaign processes, and client requirements.

- Monitor campaign performance, budgets, pacing, and key performance indicators.

- Optimize targeting, audiences, placements, creative, and campaign structure to improve results.

- Identify performance issues and recommend practical solutions.

- Coordinate campaign assets, copy, tracking links, and launch requirements.

- Maintain organized campaign documentation and prepare performance reports.



QUALIFICATIONS



Required



- Hands-on experience managing campaigns through Meta Ads Manager.

- Experience running and optimizing YouTube campaigns through Google Ads.

- Proven experience managing paid advertising for multiple clients simultaneously.

- Previous experience in a client-facing role with strong communication and presentation skills.

- Strong understanding of campaign structure, audience targeting, conversion tracking, testing, and optimization.

- Ability to interpret campaign data and translate results into clear recommendations.

- Excellent organization, attention to detail, time management, and follow-through.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Ability to work independently in a remote environment and meet deadlines.

- Reliable computer and stable high-speed internet connection.



Preferred



- Agency experience or experience managing advertising for several clients.

- Familiarity with pixels, conversion tracking, Google Analytics, and reporting dashboards.

- Experience coordinating with creative teams, copywriters, or video editors.

- Examples of improving campaign performance, cost per lead, or return on advertising spend.



Our client is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.



HOW TO APPLY



Interested candidates will complete a pre-recorded video interview and submit their resume for review. Please include examples of Meta or YouTube campaigns you have managed, including campaign goals, advertising budgets, results achieved, and the number of client accounts managed at one time. Top candidates will be shortlisted and forwarded to the client's leadership team for final evaluation.



This is an excellent opportunity to take ownership of paid advertising for a growing company that values organization, initiative, strong client service, and measurable results.

title: Executive Assistant/Operations Manager (Health Care)
description:
About Maniya Health



Maniya Health is a premier, 75-employee multispecialty medical practice in Central New Jersey that has served our community for over 50 years. We were named #920 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private companies. We are looking for a high-capacity EA / Operations Manager to serve as the strategic right hand to our CEO.



Position Overview



The primary purpose of this role is to make the CEO's life easier. Everything else follows from that.



You will take work off the CEO's plate entirely — not by executing tasks he hands you, but by owning outcomes so completely that he stops thinking about them. Beyond direct executive support, you will manage the intersection of healthcare operations, HR, talent, IT, facilities, and project delivery. This is a senior role for someone who owns the result, not the checklist.



This is a role with real scope and real autonomy, working directly with a physician-MBA CEO at a practice growing fast enough to make the Inc. 5000. You will learn every aspect of how an innovative medical practice runs, under close mentorship, with genuine room to grow as we expand. What you build here, you own.



Structure



Reports directly to the CEO. No direct reports to start — you influence and coordinate across departments through ownership and follow-through rather than formal authority. Scope may grow as the practice does.



Schedule



Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Eastern Time. Remote. Full-time and exclusive — no concurrent employment or client work during scheduled hours. May require additional hours for urgent issues such as a system outage or a same-day provider gap.



Your First 30 Days



Training on all Practice workflows. Inbox and calendar management, provider scheduling and PTO end to end, and closing the open vendor loops that currently sit with the CEO.



Responsibilities

1. Executive Support — The Core of the Role

Full Lifecycle Ownership: You are the final destination for anything assigned to you. When the CEO CCs you on an
 or delegates a project, you own it until it's done. He should never have to follow up or wonder about status.

Inbox Management: Oversee the general practice inboxes, routing information as appropriate. Once trust is established, you will manage the CEO's inbox — triaging, drafting responses, flagging what genuinely needs him, handling the rest.

Calendar & Anticipation: Manage the CEO's calendar with foresight, including professional and personal logistics such as travel and events. Adjust for time zones, seasonal shifts like Daylight Savings, and personal commitments — holidays, celebrations, errands — without being prompted.

Closing Open Loops: Many of our vendors and partners don't respond, or agree to something and go quiet. Today the CEO carries those loops in his head. Your job is to take them off his plate entirely — own the follow-up cadence, escalate when needed, close every loop.

Representing the CEO: Attend vendor and partner meetings on his behalf. Take detailed notes, capture action items and owners, circulate the summary, drive follow-ups to closure. You are a polite but firm representative, ensuring team deadlines are met.



2. Project Management

General Project Ownership: Projects come planned and unplanned. A provider gives notice and hundreds of patients need rescheduling. A new AI phone system has bugs to identify, report, and verify as fixed. A service line needs standing up. You take the goal, break it into steps, identify who does what, and drive it to completion — surfacing risks early and never letting it stall silently.

Vendor Sourcing: Research and source vendors for software, hardware, and services. Run comparisons, gather quotes, check references, present options with a recommendation.

Implementation & Closure: Own implementations end to end — configuration, testing, staff training, go-live. Identify bugs, log them with the vendor, and follow up until they are actually fixed. A ticket submitted is not a ticket resolved.

Renewals & Contracts: Track renewal dates, licenses, and service agreements so nothing auto-renews unnoticed or lapses unexpectedly.



3. Provider Scheduling & Coordination

End-to-End Ownership: Manage the full lifecycle of provider scheduling, vacations, PTO, and CME across approximately 40 providers. You are the final auditor — 100% accuracy across EHR and tracking systems before anything reaches the CEO's desk.

Visiting Specialists: Several providers are specialists who come in one day a week from their own practices. You coordinate directly with their offices — confirming schedules, managing changes and cancellations, keeping templates accurate, making sure their day runs smoothly on site.



4. HR, Talent & Employee Lifecycle

Recruiting & Hiring: Lead sourcing, job posting, resume screening, interview scheduling, and coordination with hiring managers. Build the pipeline before a seat opens.

Onboarding & Offboarding: Own onboarding end to end — paperwork, system access, training coordination, day-one readiness. Same rigor on exit: final paperwork, access removal, equipment return.

Talent & Compliance: Coordinate performance reviews, track training and credentialing, monitor license and certification expirations. You don't just send documents — you manage the completion rate, ensuring every signature is captured and filed.



5. Facilities, IT & Office Administration

Account Management: Provision accounts for new hires across all systems; de-provision immediately on departure. Access sprawl is a compliance risk, and closing it is your responsibility.

IT Support & Continuity: Handle everyday requests — password resets, access issues, device and printer problems, basic troubleshooting. Know the failover procedures and execute them; if the phone system goes down, route to the backup and notify the team. Know what you can fix and what needs a vendor — escalate fast, then own the follow-up.

Facilities Issues: When a roof leaks or the HVAC fails, you own it from first report to final invoice. You won't be on site, so you coordinate with our on-the-ground team to get eyes on the problem and confirm the work was done properly. Your part is getting the vendor scheduled — following up daily if that's what it takes — and verifying the bill matches the quote.

Supplies & Equipment: Keep every location stocked — clinical supplies, office supplies, everyday consumables. Nobody should ever tell the CEO we've run out of something.

Purchase Orders, Reimbursements & Refunds: Review, approve, and track POs with a clear record of what was ordered, what arrived, and what it cost. Same for staff reimbursement requests and patient refunds — reviewed, approved, tracked to completion.



6. Operational Oversight

Daily Review: Review checklists and Google Chat spaces daily to identify operational gaps and correct provider scheduling gaps.

Monthly Operational Reviews: Prepare and run them — pull the data, build the deck, identify what moved and what didn't, come with recommendations rather than just numbers.

Process Ownership: Own the recurring administrative and operational processes that keep the practice running. You know which exist, whether they were completed, and where they break down — and you fix them rather than reporting that they broke.

Patient Discharges & RCM: Execute the patient discharge process end to end, with the rigor these documents require. We have a billing manager who owns billing operations; your role is coordination and oversight — confirming revenue cycle processes are running, surfacing issues, following up on anything that stalls.



7. Data & Analysis

Reporting & Dashboards: Use Excel and Google Sheets to turn operational, financial, and clinical quality data into reports that drive decisions. Build, maintain, and present operational KPI dashboards. When something breaks, dig into why and lead the process improvement rather than patching symptoms.

Analyst on New Initiatives: Serve as data analyst on new projects — researching potential service lines, expansion opportunities, and market questions. Gather the data, run the analysis, present findings with a recommendation rather than a data dump.



Key Requirements

Outcome Ownership: You own results, not tasks. You act as your own auditor and catch your own errors before anyone else does. You maintain 100% accuracy in high-stakes repetitive workflows — PTO approvals, provider scheduling, PO tracking. When a project stalls, you feel it personally.

Persistence: Much of this job is making other people do what they said they would — vendors, contractors, partners, internal teams. You follow up five times without becoming apologetic or abrasive.

Reliability: You are a steady, reachable anchor during business hours. If you can't make a commitment — a call, a deadline, a check-in — you say so in advance rather than going quiet. A missed commitment with notice is a scheduling problem; a missed commitment without notice is a trust problem.

Anticipation & Context: You connect the dots without being told, looking ahead at the calendar and environmental factors to adjust proactively. You understand how one change in a physician's schedule ripples through five other systems.

Risk-Based Judgment: In a medical practice, administrative work carries legal and clinical weight. You approach sensitive documentation — patient discharge letters, HR contracts — with extreme rigor and full compliance with US healthcare standards.

30,000 Feet and 2 Feet: You can move between strategic and tactical without losing quality on either — building a KPI dashboard in the morning and chasing a roofer in the afternoon. Both matter, and you stay calm and organized across both.

Technical Fluency: Advanced Excel and Google Workspace — trackers, pivot tables, VLOOKUPs — plus the ability to quickly master new software including EHR and HRIS.



On AI



We use AI tools daily and expect you to. What we care about is whether you direct the tool and verify the output, or hand over your thinking. Be transparent about where you use it.



On Monitoring



Because this role has access to protected health information, all work is performed on monitored systems using Teramind. Every team member with PHI access operates under the same requirements.



To be direct: any attempt to circumvent monitoring — mouse movers, jigglers, activity simulators, or anything similar — ends the engagement immediately. If the schedule or workload isn't working, tell us and we'll fix it.



Qualifications

US Health care provider experience mandatory

Proven longevity at prior jobs

5–7+ years as a senior EA, Operations Manager, or Chief of Staff

Direct CEO or C-suite support experience is mandatory. You must have supported a CEO or equivalent executive before. This is not a role where you learn executive support on the job.

Mandatory: Deep experience in the US healthcare / medical practice ecosystem

Job longevity is mandatory. We are looking for someone who has held prior roles for multiple years, not a pattern of short stints. If your resume shows several positions under a year, please explain why in your application.

Advanced Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUPs) and Google Workspace

Working proficiency with Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT

Proven ability to master internal software (EHR, HRIS) and maintain complex checklists, prioritization, and follow-up with 100% accuracy

Selection Process



Advancing candidates complete a short practical exercise using real operational data. It assesses analytical accuracy, critical thinking, and — most importantly — how you verify your own work.



Final candidates should expect reference checks with prior supervisors, including on attendance and follow-through.

description:

Paid time off after 3 months Location: Remote, Philippines



About the role



I run two things that need video. The first is my YouTube channel, Trevor Carlson, a travel storytelling channel with about 54,000 subscribers. The second is Fresh Fuel Marketing, a paid media agency where we make video ads for clients.



I have a lot of footage. Old trips, b-roll, unused takes, half finished projects. What I do not have is someone who watches all of it, figures out what should be made from it, and then drives those videos to done.

 what gets made, writes the outline or script, and either cuts it yourself or hands it to an editor and gives them notes until it is right.

 what videos should be made from that footage and pitch those ideas to me with a clear reason why

Keep every project moving and visible in Slack so I always know what stage things are at

Communicate with me directly, clearly, and without needing to be chased

What I am looking for

You have managed video projects before, not just edited them. You have d
 what to make, not only how to cut it

You can watch two hours of raw footage and come back with a short list of specific ideas, not vague ones

You can edit. Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci, CapCut, whatever you are strongest in. Tell me which

, Notion, Google Drive, or similar project and review tools

title: Data anaylst
description:
# Virtual Assistant – TikTok Live Set Builder & Scheduling



**Remote Position**



Our Tik Tok Shop is looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help manage the daily setup and scheduling of our TikTok Live shows.



We operate a high-volume live-commerce business and can run up to 10 live shows per day. As we continue to grow, we are looking for someone who can take ownership of building our daily show sets and making sure every show is properly prepared and scheduled.



This is primarily an **operations and scheduling position**. You will not be responsible for purchasing, accounting, company finances, or making financial decisions.



## What You'll Be Doing



Your main responsibilities will include:



* Building TikTok surprise sets inside our internal Tool House software

* Following predefined set-building rules and templates

* Using our points-based system to create balanced sets

* Making sure sets contain the correct mix of base items, mid-tier items, bigger hits, and top/chase items

* Reviewing inventory availability while building sets

* Making sure each set passes our internal set requirements

* Building approximately 5–10 sets per day depending on the schedule

* Scheduling TikTok Live shows for our hosts

* Making sure the correct set, host, show time, and listing are associated with each show

* Keeping the daily show schedule organized

* Checking that upcoming shows are completely ready before their scheduled start time

* Communicating any inventory issues, scheduling conflicts, or set-building problems to management

* Keeping track of which sets are built, finalized, uploaded, and scheduled



## What We're Looking For



We want someone who is:



* Extremely organized

* Very detail-oriented

* Comfortable working on a computer for most of the day

* Able to follow detailed processes and rules accurately

* Good with numbers and basic math

* Comfortable learning new software

* Able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines

* Reliable and consistent

* Able to work independently once trained

* Comfortable asking questions when something does not look right

* Able to communicate clearly in English



You do **not** need to be an expert on Milwaukee tools or TikTok Live before starting. We will provide training on our products, software, set-building system, and workflow.



Experience with TikTok Shop, live selling, e-commerce, inventory management, scheduling, spreadsheets, or similar operations work is a plus.



## What a Typical Day Looks Like



You will log into Tool House and review the upcoming live-show schedule.



For each show, you will:



1. Select the appropriate set template.

2. Build the set using available inventory.

3. Follow the points and product-distribution requirements shown by our system.

4. Make adjustments until the set passes all required checks.

5. Finalize the set.

6. Prepare the TikTok listing/upload.

7. Schedule the show for the correct host and time.

8. Confirm that everything is ready.

9. Move on to the next scheduled show.



Our goal is for this person to eventually own this entire process so our live-selling team can arrive each day with their shows already built and ready to run.



## This Role Is a Good Fit If...



You enjoy repetitive but important operational work, like creating systems, checking details, keeping schedules organized, and making sure nothing gets missed.



A strong person in this role should eventually be able to look at a schedule of 8–10 upcoming shows and independently make sure all 8–10 are properly built and ready to go.



## Growth Opportunity



Tool House US is a rapidly growing live-commerce company. This position may expand into additional live-selling operations responsibilities as the business continues to grow.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term member of the team rather than someone looking for a short-term project.



## To Apply



Please send:



* A short introduction about yourself

* Your previous VA, operations, e-commerce, or scheduling experience

* Your normal working hours and time zone

* Your computer/internet setup

* Your expected hourly rate

* Why you think you would be a good fit for a detail-oriented role like this



Please also start your application with the words **"Tool House VA"** so we know you read the entire listing.

title: Product Manager (AI Native, Hands On)
description:

Written update in Slack every working day, plus 2 hours of overlap with Toronto time (EST) twice a week for calls Salary: $1,500 to $3,000 USD per month to start, up to $3,000 for someone who is clearly senior. 13th month pay included. Paid time off after 3 months Location: Remote, Philippines



About the role



I build things fast. I use AI to get from an idea to something that runs, and I have a stack of internal tools and web apps sitting at about 70 percent done. They work when I use them. They are not finished products.



I need someone to take them the rest of the way.



That means finding what is broken before a user does, d
 what actually has to be built before launch and what can wait, cleaning up the parts I rushed, and shipping. You will use AI to do this the same way I do. That is not a shortcut here, it is the job.



This is not a role where you write tickets and wait for a developer. You are in the code. You use Cursor, Claude Code, or whatever you are fastest in, and you make the changes yourself.



What you will do

Take over projects that are partly built and get them to a state I can put in front of real users

Go through what exists, find what is broken, half finished, or held together with tape, and write up what has to happen

D
 what ships in v1 and what does not. Push back on me when I want to add things

Write and fix code yourself using AI tools. Front end, back end, whatever the project needs

Test properly before launch. Edge cases, error states, mobile, the things that break in front of a user

Handle deployment and keep environments, keys, and repos in order

Write the small amount of documentation needed so the thing can be maintained

Keep everything visible in Slack so I always know status without asking

What I am looking for

You have shipped software to real users, not just built demos

You are genuinely fast with AI coding tools. Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, Copilot, Replit, whatever. Tell me which and what you built with it

You can read someone else's messy code and figure out what it is doing without asking twenty questions

Comfortable in JavaScript or TypeScript. React, Next.js, Astro, Node, or similar. Familiar with a database like Supabase or Postgres

You can deploy. Vercel, Netlify, Railway, or similar. Git and GitHub are second nature

You have product judgment. You can look at a feature and tell me it is not worth building

You catch bugs. You are the kind of person who tries to break things on purpose

Strong written English. Most of our communication is written

You tell me early when something will slip. I do not need perfect, I need honest

Nice to have

Experience with marketing or ads platforms, APIs, and webhooks

Zapier, Make, or n8n

Notion API

Mobile or PWA experience

You have done this before: inherited a half built thing and gotten it live

Tools we use



Slack, Notion, GitHub, Google Drive, and whatever AI coding tools you are best with.



How to apply



Read this carefully. Applications that skip a step get deleted.



1. Send your resume. You can use AI to write or format it. I do not care.



2. Write your cover letter yourself. Please do not use AI for this one. I want to hear how you actually think. Tell me about one specific project you took from half finished to live. What was broken when you got it, what you cut, what you shipped. Short is fine.



3. Do this task. Imagine I hand you a working prototype on day one. It runs on my machine, real people have never used it, and I want it live in six weeks.



Send me two things:



The first 10 questions you would ask me before writing a single line of code

A one page plan for those six weeks: what you would do in week 1, what you would cut, and what you would consider the minimum bar for launch



I am judging this on the questions more than the plan. Good questions tell me you have done this before.



4. Include links. GitHub, a live product you built, anything I can actually click. If you cannot share code, describe what you built and what your part was.



5. Put this in your subject line: PM AI - [the last thing you shipped]

title: LIVE WEBINAR PRESENTER & SALES PROFESSIONAL

Capital Fleet Rentals is looking for an exceptional **Live Webinar Presenter & Sales Professional** to conduct live online presentations for prospective business partners.



**This is not a traditional Virtual Assistant position.**



We are looking for someone with outstanding spoken English, strong executive presence, confidence, energy, professionalism, and the ability to engage and influence a live audience.



If you can enter a virtual room, establish credibility quickly, keep people engaged, answer questions confidently, and guide an audience toward a clear next step, we would like to hear from you.



## THE ROLE



You will conduct live Zoom webinars for Capital Fleet Rentals.



We anticipate beginning with approximately **one webinar per week**, with the potential to increase to approximately **two webinars per week as registration volume grows**.



Each webinar is expected to last approximately **30–60 minutes**, including audience questions.



You will receive presentation materials, information about our business, training, and guidance before conducting webinars independently.



Responsibilities include:



* Conducting professional live Zoom presentations

* Presenting information naturally rather than simply reading slides

* Explaining business concepts clearly and conversationally

* Maintaining audience attention and engagement

* Communicating with confidence, energy, and credibility

* Answering audience questions professionally

* Responding effectively when conversations move beyond the presentation

* Handling reasonable questions and objections with professionalism

* Helping attendees understand the information being presented

* Guiding interested attendees toward the appropriate next step

* Professionally representing Capital Fleet Rentals



## WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Relevant experience may include:



* Live webinar presenting

* Consultative sales

* Business development

* Public speaking

* Training or facilitation

* On-camera presenting

* Professional hosting

* Business presentations

* Customer-facing sales presentations



Previous vehicle-rental experience is **not required**.



We can teach you our business.



What is much harder to teach is **presence, confidence, communication, persuasion, judgment, and the ability to command a live audience.**



Those qualities are extremely important to us.



## COMPENSATION & SCHEDULE



**Compensation: $50 USD per completed webinar**



This is a specialized gig position rather than a traditional hourly role.



We expect to begin with approximately **one webinar per week** and may increase to approximately **two webinars per week depending on registration volume and business needs**.



A specific number of weekly webinars is not guaranteed.



Webinars will generally be scheduled during hours suitable for a U.S. Eastern Time audience.



Anticipated start: **Late September / Early October 2026**



## SELECTION PROCESS



We are intentionally taking our time to identify the right presenter rather than simply filling the position quickly.



### Step 1 — Application Video



Please submit a **2–3 minute video presentation on a professional topic of your choice**.



You may:



* Explain a business concept

* Present a product or service

* Teach something

* Tell a compelling professional story

* Discuss another professional topic you know well



We will **not provide a script for this first video**.



Imagine that you have a live audience in front of you and your objective is to capture and maintain their attention.



Professional video production is not required. Please do not heavily edit your submission.



We want to evaluate your natural:



* Spoken English

* Communication ability

* Confidence

* Executive presence

* Energy and personality

* Persuasiveness

* Professionalism

* Camera presence

* Ability to hold an audience's attention



### Step 2 — Live Presentation Audition



Candidates who advance will receive information about Capital Fleet Rentals and a short presentation assignment before their interview.



You will have time to prepare.



During the interview, you will deliver a short live presentation as though we are attendees at one of your webinars.



Expect questions.



We want to see how well you prepare, understand unfamiliar information, communicate naturally, respond to questions, think on your feet, and engage a live audience.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A brief introduction.

2. Your relevant experience in webinars, sales, public speaking, presentations, training, hosting, or business development.

3. Your **2–3 minute presentation video**.

4. Your current location and time zone.

5. Confirmation that you are comfortable conducting webinars during agreed-upon U.S. Eastern Time hours.

6. Confirmation that you understand compensation is **$50 USD per completed webinar**.

7. Your answer to this question:



**“What separates an average presenter from someone who can truly command and influence a live audience?”**



Please do not submit a generic application.



This individual will represent Capital Fleet Rentals in front of prospective business partners, so communication ability, professionalism, credibility, and presence are very important to us.



We are looking for someone who can walk into a virtual room with confidence, earn people's attention, establish trust, communicate clearly, and make the audience want to hear what comes next.

title: Real Estate Virtual Assistant – Canadian Market (Paragon | BC | PST Hours)
description:
Real Estate Virtual Assistant — West Coast Living (Oakwyn Realty)

???? Remote | Full-Time | Philippine-Based Applicants | PST Hours (9 AM – 6 PM)





Who We Are

West Coast Living is a top-producing real estate team based in Vancouver, BC, operating under Oakwyn Realty. We specialize in residential resale, presale project marketing, rental property management, and developer-facing listing services. We are a fast-moving, highly collaborative team that takes pride in delivering an exceptional client experience and we hold ourselves to the same standard internally.

We are looking for a seasoned Real Estate Virtual Assistant who is ready to grow with us long-term. This is not a general admin role. This is a career opportunity for someone who knows Canadian real estate, speaks the language, understands the systems, and wants to be a real part of a professional team.





The Role

You will be embedded into our team,  attending meetings, communicating directly with agents and clients, and supporting the full transaction and marketing cycle. You will be relied on for accuracy, speed, professionalism, and initiative. If we succeed, you succeed. We believe in recognizing and rewarding the people who show up and deliver.





What You Will Do

Transaction & Listing Support

Prepare, organize, and track listing documents including MLS input forms, Schedule A/B addenda, and BCREA contracts

Enter and update listings on Paragon MLS — including photos, room measurements, strata details, and listing remarks

Manage document collection and completion checklists for active listings and buyer files

Follow up with lawyers, notaries, and conveyancers on missing items and completion milestones

Maintain accurate records in the team CRM (Reach)

Prepare showing feedback summaries and market update reports for clients



Administrative & Operations

Manage and organize Google Drive and Dropbox folders — naming conventions, version control, archiving

Draft and proofread client-facing
s, letters, and follow-up messages in a warm, professional tone

Prepare and manage web forms, online applications, and digital document submissions

Maintain team calendars, schedule showings, and coordinate appointments

Research properties, strata documents, title histories, and building profiles using online tools

Source and verify information from BC Assessment, Stratapress, Strata Plan Registry, and other public records

Support presale marketing files including unit trackers, price lists, and developer correspondence



Communication & Team Participation

Attend team meetings via Zoom or Google Meet (PST hours — 8 AM to 5 PM Monday to Friday)

Communicate responsively via WhatsApp and
 with team members and clients

Flag issues proactively — if something is missing, unclear, or time-sensitive, you speak up

Support the team lead with personal organization, task tracking, and project follow-up





What You Need to Bring

Non-Negotiable Requirements:

Minimum 2–3 years of real estate experience — either in a Canadian real estate office, with a Canadian real estate team, or supporting a Canadian broker or agent remotely

Solid working knowledge of Paragon MLS — including listing entry, status updates, and photo uploads

Familiarity with Canadian real estate forms, terminology, and transaction stages (Accepted Offer, Subject Removal, Completion, Possession)

Fluent written and spoken English — your
s, documents, and verbal communication must be professional and clear

Advanced skills in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Gmail, Calendar) and Dropbox

Experience with web forms, digital documents, and e-signature tools (DocuSign or similar)

Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain accuracy under pressure

Reliable internet with minimum 25 Mbps upload/download — you must provide your speed test result

Backup internet plan for outages (mobile hotspot, nearby café, or generator) — tell us your plan



Strong Assets:

Experience with Canva for real estate marketing materials

Experience with presale project marketing or new development real estate

Familiarity with BC real estate specifics: strata, depreciation reports, Form B, PTT, FINTRAC

Proactive with technology — you don't just use tools, you suggest better ones

Experience supporting a team lead or broker in a client-facing real estate environment





Work Setup & Availability

This role works Vancouver time (Pacific Standard / Pacific Daylight Time) — Wednesday to Sunday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. This is a hard requirement. Our clients and our market operate on this schedule, and you will be expected to be present and responsive during these hours.



We will ask you:

What is your current internet speed? (Please include a screenshot of a recent speed test from 
 or speedtest.net)

Does your city/area experience frequent typhoons, power outages, or weather-related disruptions?

What is your backup plan if your primary internet goes down? (Mobile data, nearby café, generator — please describe)

We have experienced connectivity issues with previous VAs during weather events. We take this seriously and expect an honest, detailed answer.





Who Thrives on This Team

You are organized to the point that other people notice. You communicate before you're asked. You read a document all the way through before responding. You notice when something doesn't add up. You are proud of the quality of your work and you take ownership of your file like it's yours.



You want to build something — not just fill a role. You are looking for a team that will invest in you and give you room to grow. You are not looking for a side gig. You are looking for a career.





How to Apply — Read This Carefully

?? Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be reviewed.



Step 1 — Subject Line

Your subject line must read exactly: "WCL VA – [Your Name] – I Read the Whole Thing"

Any other subject line tells us you did not read this ad.



Step 2 — Your Application

In the body of your application, answer the following in order:

Briefly describe one real estate transaction or file you supported from start to finish — what was your role and what happened?

List every MLS system or real estate software you have used and how long you used each

What is the difference between Subject Removal and Completion in a BC real estate transaction? (Answer in your own words — do not Google this. If you know Canadian real estate, you know this.)

What is your internet speed and what is your backup plan for outages?

What city are you located in, and does it experience typhoons or storm-related outages? How do you handle this?

Tell us one tool or process you introduced in a previous role that made the team more efficient



Step 3 — Attachments

Your application must include:

Your updated resume (PDF preferred)

A portfolio or work sample — this can be a Canva design, a document you created, a spreadsheet you built, or any piece of work that shows us the quality of what you produce. If you do not have a portfolio, create a short sample — a listing description, a formatted table, a one-page summary of anything. This is your chance to show us how you work.

A screenshot of your internet speed test (from 
 or speedtest.net)





Compensation & What We Offer

We pay for skill, experience, and reliability — not the lowest rate we can find. This is a long-term role and we compensate accordingly.



Base Rate:

$9.00 – $11.00 CDN per hour, full-time (40 hours/week), based on experience and demonstrated Canadian real estate knowledge.



What's Included:

Competitive base rate reviewed after your first 120 days

Performance-based increases — if the team grows, your compensation grows with it

13th month bonus (paid annually — this is a standard we honour without exception)

10 paid days off per year

A stable, long-term position with a professional and supportive team environment

Direct access to the team lead and agents — you are not working in isolation



We are not looking for the cheapest option. We are looking for the right person. If you bring the skills, the professionalism, and the commitment — we will take care of you and grow together.





What to Expect

Qualified applicants will be contacted for a short written screening, followed by a video interview over Google Meet. We move quickly with candidates who demonstrate they are the right fit.



This is a long-term role with a team that takes care of its people. If you are serious about real estate, serious about quality, and ready to work hard alongside people who will do the same — we want to hear from you.



West Coast Living | Oakwyn Realty | Vancouver, BC
