title: Recruiting & Onboarding Coordinator
description:
About the Role

Philia Home Care is looking for a detail-oriented Recruiting & Onboarding Coordinator to manage our full caregiver hiring pipeline — from first application through orientation and final onboarding setup. You'll be the person candidates interact with throughout their hiring journey, and the person who keeps our records, compliance documents, and systems accurate and up to date.



What You'll Do

• Monitor our applicant tracking system (Apploi) daily for new caregiver applications

• Conduct video interviews with candidates and evaluate them using our standardized scoring criteria

• Approve or decline candidates based on structured interview results

• Verify HHA/CNA license validity against state licensing databases

• Contact and document candidate references

• Coordinate orientation logistics: calendar invites, onboarding document packets (SignNow), and document upload forms

• Help candidates complete applications and onboarding paperwork as needed

• Confirm orientation attendance and follow up on reschedules or no-shows

• Collect and verify compliance documents (TB clearance, ID, CPR certification, vaccination records)

• Set up new hires' personnel files in Google Drive

• Enter approved hires into our care management system (AxisCare)

• Keep candidate status accurate and current across all systems throughout the process



What We're Looking For

• Strong written and spoken English communication skills

• Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly with speakers of diverse accents and English dialects — candidates and clients may include native speakers of French, Amharic, Tagalog, and other language backgrounds, so comfort adapting to and understanding varied accents is essential

• 2+ years of experience in HR, recruiting, or healthcare staffing preferred

• A track record of compassion and good judgment in past roles — we're looking for someone who can recognize these qualities in others, not just process paperwork

• Comfortable conducting video interviews and applying a structured evaluation process

• Highly detail-oriented and organized; comfortable managing multiple systems (applicant tracking, e-signature, cloud storage, care management software) at once

• Reliable, responsible, and resourceful — able to use good judgment and follow through independently

• Excellent, stable internet connection suitable for consistent, high-quality video/voice calls

• A quiet, professional space for candidate interviews

• Availability during US business hours to conduct reference checks

• Availability around orientation days to prepare materials in advance and complete follow-up documentation afterward



What We Offer

• Fully remote, stable long-term contractor engagement.

• A supportive, mission-driven team that genuinely cares about its people.

• Opportunity to grow your role as Philia grows.

• Competitive compensation commensurate with experience.

• You will be a genuine member of our team! Not just a person on the phone!!! 



Please use the word "Care" in the subject line of your application.

title: Real Estate Analyst
description:
NOOR COMPANIES

Real Estate Development  ·  General Contracting

POSITION ANNOUNCEMENT

Real Estate Development Analyst

Full-Time  |  Remote  |  Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer

REPORTS TO Chief Executive Officer

EMPLOYMENT Full-time, 40 hours per week. Exclusive — the successful candidate may not hold other employment or clients.

SCHEDULE 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Central Time, Monday through Friday

Equivalent to 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM Manila. Night-shift availability is mandatory.

COMPENSATION Commensurate with experience

Performance review at 90 days · 13th month pay · Paid Philippine holidays

LOCATION Fully remote



  THE ORGANIZATION



Noor Companies is a real estate development and general contracting firm headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota. We develop and build affordable housing, civic institutions, healthcare facilities, libraries, and mixed-use projects, and we are among the largest woman-owned firms of our kind in the country, with more than $500 million in completed work.

Our pipeline spans market-rate and affordable housing, public and civic solicitations, and mixed-use redevelopment, financed through conventional debt and equity as well as housing tax credits, tax increment financing, and public agency programs.

  POSITION SUMMARY



The Real Estate Development Analyst supports the Chief Executive Officer across the full development lifecycle — from identifying and screening potential development sites, through underwriting and financing, entitlement, design coordination, and construction close-out.

The Analyst is responsible for the financial models that determine whether a project proceeds, the budget tracking that governs every dollar spent once it does, and the coordination and follow-up that keeps architects, engineers, consultants, lenders, and municipalities moving on schedule. This is a research-, analysis-, and follow-through-intensive position requiring precision with numbers and persistence in pursuit of information.

This position requires a technical foundation. Candidates must have education or working experience in architecture, engineering, construction, or real estate, and must be able to read and interpret architectural and civil drawings. Applications without this background will not be considered.



  ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES



Site Identification & Market Research

• Search brokerage and listing platforms — LoopNet, Crexi, CoStar, Catylist, brokerage websites, and auction platforms — daily for land and redevelopment opportunities matching the firm’s criteria

• Screen candidate sites against acquisition criteria including zoning, parcel size, utility availability, access, topography, floodplain, and known environmental conditions

• Research parcel ownership, assessed value, tax status, sale history, and legal description through county assessor, recorder, and GIS systems

• Identify off-market opportunities including surplus public land, tax-forfeited parcels, obsolete or underutilized properties, and expiring-use affordable properties

• Compile land sale comparables, rent comparables, sale comparables, absorption data, and demographic and employment data for each submarket under consideration

• Prepare one-page site screening summaries with photographs, aerials, parcel maps, zoning summary, preliminary program, and order-of-magnitude economics

• Maintain the acquisition pipeline tracker recording every site reviewed, its status, owner and broker contacts, pricing, and the reason for pursuit or rejection

Financial Modeling & Proforma Analysis

• Build and maintain development proformas from scratch in Excel, including sources and uses, hard and soft cost budgets, development schedule, absorption and lease-up assumptions, stabilized operating proforma, and monthly cash flow

• Calculate and report the return metrics governing investment decisions — untrended and trended yield on cost, internal rate of return, equity multiple, cash-on-cash return, debt service coverage ratio, and loan sizing against loan-to-cost and loan-to-value constraints

• Model the full capital stack including senior construction debt, permanent debt, tax credit equity, tax increment financing, deferred developer fee, soft and gap loans, grants, and sponsor equity

• Run sensitivity and scenario analyses across construction cost, interest rate, rent, exit capitalization rate, absorption pace, and subsidy assumptions

• Update proformas as design, cost estimates, financing terms, and program change; maintain disciplined version control and document every assumption and its source

• Reconcile proforma assumptions against contractor estimates, consultant fee proposals, and lender term sheets

• Prepare summary financial exhibits for the CEO, lenders, investors, and public agency partners

Development Budget & Expenditure Tracking

• Maintain the master development budget for every active project, tracking each line item from original budget through committed, invoiced, paid, and remaining balance

• Track every dollar of spend across all projects and reconcile against the general ledger with the accounting team

• Monitor consultant and contractor contract balances, invoice against contracted fee, and flag any invoice exceeding contracted scope

• Prepare, assemble, and track predevelopment and construction draw requests to lenders and public funders, including supporting documentation, lien waivers, and inspector approvals

• Track change orders, budget amendments, contingency usage, and cost-to-complete; report variances promptly and identify the cause

• Produce monthly budget-versus-actual variance reports for each project and a consolidated report for the CEO

• Maintain the funding draw calendar and monitor sources and uses balance throughout construction

Architect, Engineer & Consultant Coordination

• Maintain the consultant roster for each project — architect, civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, landscape, geotechnical, environmental, survey, traffic, and specialty consultants — with scope, fee, contact, and contract status

• Track consultant contracts, scopes of work, fee schedules, insurance certificates, and deliverable due dates

• Maintain the design deliverables calendar across schematic design, design development, construction documents, and permit set milestones, and monitor progress against it

• Follow up persistently with architects and engineers on outstanding deliverables, drawing revisions, and responses; escalate delays to the CEO before they affect the schedule

• Log and track requests for information, submittals, design decisions, and outstanding items requiring resolution

• Organize and version-control drawing sets, specifications, reports, and studies in the project document library

• Prepare agendas for design and coordination meetings, record minutes, and distribute and track action items to closure

Entitlements & Municipal Opportunity Development

• Research zoning ordinances, comprehensive plans, overlay districts, density and height limits, parking requirements, and design standards for candidate sites

• Identify municipalities, counties, housing authorities, and economic development agencies with active development priorities, surplus land, redevelopment districts, or announced solicitations

• Set up meetings between the CEO and city planning, economic development, housing, and public works staff to identify development opportunities; prepare briefing materials in advance and track follow-up commitments after each meeting

• Monitor city council, planning commission, HRA and EDA agendas and packets for relevant items, land dispositions, and emerging opportunities

• Track entitlement milestones for each project — pre-application conference, site plan review, rezoning, variance, conditional use permit, plat approval, and public hearings

• Maintain a master calendar of submission deadlines, hearing dates, and approval expiration dates

• Research and summarize impact fees, utility connection charges, park dedication requirements, and other municipal exactions affecting project economics

Public Financing & Funding Applications

• Track application cycles and deadlines for Minnesota Housing programs including the Multifamily Consolidated Request for Proposals, 9% and 4% Housing Tax Credits, and the State Housing Tax Credit, as well as city and county funding sources

• Assemble funding application materials, exhibits, narratives, and supporting documentation, and verify completeness against agency checklists

• Analyze projects against Qualified Allocation Plan scoring criteria and identify actions that improve competitive position

• Research and summarize available incentives including tax increment financing, tax abatement, brownfield and cleanup grants, historic tax credits, New Markets Tax Credits, and energy incentives

• Maintain a consolidated funding calendar covering every source, cycle, and deadline relevant to the pipeline

• Track awarded funding through commitment, closing, and compliance milestones

Due Diligence, Reporting & Project Administration

• Maintain due diligence checklists and trackers covering title commitment and exceptions, survey, Phase I and Phase II environmental assessments, geotechnical investigation, wetland delineation, utility availability letters, and zoning verification

• Track all critical dates including purchase agreement contingency periods, option and extension deadlines, earnest money conditions, and closing dates, and provide advance notice of each

• Prepare weekly and monthly pipeline reports and project status dashboards for the CEO

• Assemble lender, investor, partner, and public agency reporting packages

• Maintain organized project files, contact directories, and the central document library across all active projects

• Document standard operating procedures and templates for recurring analytical and tracking work

  REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Minimum two (2) years of professional experience in real estate development, architecture, civil or structural engineering, construction, property development, or commercial real estate analysis.

• Educational background in architecture, engineering, real estate, construction management, finance, or a closely related discipline.

• Ability to read and interpret architectural and engineering drawings — site plans, floor plans, elevations, and civil and utility drawings — and familiarity with the schematic design, design development, and construction document phases.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency. Must be able to construct a development proforma and cash flow model from a blank worksheet without templates or add-ins, using formulas, lookups, and logical functions accurately.

• Working command of real estate finance fundamentals — net operating income, capitalization rate, yield on cost, internal rate of return, equity multiple, debt service coverage ratio, loan-to-cost and loan-to-value, amortization, and sources and uses.

• Demonstrated research capability using brokerage and listing platforms, public property records, GIS systems, and municipal planning documents, with the ability to locate information that is not readily indexed.

• Exceptional attention to detail with numerical information. Errors in a proforma or a budget carry direct financial consequence.

• Persistent, professional follow-up. A substantial portion of this position consists of pursuing consultants, brokers, and agency staff until a response is obtained.

• Superior written English sufficient to prepare summaries, memoranda, and application narratives issued to lenders, investors, and public agencies.

• Fluent, clearly articulate spoken English for participation in calls with US architects, engineers, brokers, lenders, and municipal staff.

• Reliable home office — computer with a minimum of 8GB RAM, internet service of 25 Mbps or greater, a secondary internet source, a headset, and a quiet, professional work environment.

  PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Licensure or licensure eligibility as an architect or civil engineer

• Experience with affordable housing finance, Low-Income Housing Tax Credits, or publicly subsidized development

• Prior work supporting United States real estate projects or United States based clients

• Familiarity with CoStar, LoopNet, Crexi, or comparable commercial listing platforms

• Working knowledge of AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, Bluebeam Revu, ArcGIS or QGIS, Procore, or Argus

• Experience preparing responses to requests for proposal or public solicitations

• Competence in PowerPoint and Canva for the preparation of presentation and marketing materials

  CORE COMPETENCIES



• Analytical Rigor. Works accurately with numbers, checks results, and understands what a model is actually saying rather than merely producing one.

• Persistence and Follow-Through. Pursues outstanding items to resolution. Does not accept silence from a consultant or agency as an outcome.

• Sense of Urgency. Understands that entitlement calendars, funding deadlines, and closing dates do not move, and works accordingly.

• Attention to Detail. Identifies errors in budgets, drawings, applications, and dates before they are transmitted or relied upon.

• Continuous Communication. Reports progress, obstacles, and changes in status throughout the workday without being asked.

• Ownership and Accountability. Assumes responsibility for assigned projects through completion and raises problems early.

• Sound Judgment. Distinguishes material issues from immaterial ones and knows when to escalate.

• Discretion. Safeguards confidential financial, ownership, and transaction information absolutely.

• Aptitude for Learning. Acquires unfamiliar markets, programs, regulations, and systems quickly and independently.

  APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Applicants must complete all four steps below. Adherence to instructions is evaluated as part of this application, as precision is a core requirement of the position. Incomplete submissions will not be reviewed.

Step 1 — Subject Line

Use the following subject line exactly as written:

DEV ANALYST — Cedar Bluff



Step 2 — Written Responses

Answer each of the following in the body of your message. Number your responses.

1. Describe your education and professional background in architecture, engineering, construction, or real estate, including your employer, your title, and your tenure.

2. Describe the most complex financial model or proforma you have built. What did it analyze, what were the principal assumptions, and did you build it from scratch or modify an existing template?

3. Explain, in your own words, the difference between yield on cost and internal rate of return, and why a developer examines both.

4. Describe your experience reading architectural or engineering drawings. What drawing types have you worked with, and in what capacity?

5. Describe a time you were responsible for obtaining information or a deliverable from someone who was slow to respond. What did you do?

6. Describe any experience you have with development budgets, invoice tracking, draw requests, or construction cost reporting.

7. What research platforms, property databases, or GIS systems have you used?

8. Confirm your availability from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time, Monday through Friday, on a long-term basis.

9. Confirm that this position would be your sole employment and that you hold no other clients.

10. State your internet speed and your backup connection.

11. State your expected monthly compensation in USD.

Step 3 — Video Introduction

Record a video of two to three minutes and provide a link (Loom or Google Drive). Do not attach a video file. Appear on camera and address the following:

1. Introduce yourself and summarize your technical background in architecture, engineering, construction, or real estate.

2. Walk through one project or analysis you worked on, explaining what you were responsible for.

3. Describe how you would begin researching whether a vacant parcel is a viable development site.

Step 4 — Work Samples

Attach two samples of your work from the categories below. Remove or replace all confidential information.

• A financial model, proforma, feasibility study, or cost analysis you constructed in Excel

• A market study, site analysis, or research summary you prepared

• A project budget, cost report, or tracking spreadsheet you maintained

• A drawing, rendering, site plan, or design study you produced or contributed to

  SELECTION PROCESS



1. Application review. Complete submissions are reviewed on a rolling basis.

2. Technical assessment. A paid exercise requiring construction of a simple development proforma in Excel and a brief written site analysis.

3. Interview with the Chief Executive Officer. Forty-five minutes by video, including discussion of the technical assessment.

4. Reference verification. Contact with at least one prior employer or supervising professional.

5. Offer and introductory period. A thirty-day paid introductory period.



Qualified applicants will be contacted within one week of submission.



Candidates should not apply if any of the following apply:

You hold other employment or clients  ·  You are unable to work the specified night-shift hours on a long-term basis  ·  You have no education or working experience in architecture, engineering, construction, or real estate  ·  You are unable to build a financial model in Excel without a template  ·  You are seeking part-time, project-based, or short-term work.

title: Remote Home Asset & Inventory Specialist
description:
Remote Home Asset & Inventory Specialist



Job Overview:



We are seeking an execution-driven Home Asset & Inventory Specialist to support a portfolio of manufactured homes across Texas and California. The role reports to a designated Operations Leader and works closely with Facilities/Field Operations and the Revenue Team.



The specialist will take ownership of vacant homes through the lifecycle, from formal possession through Market Ready status, including homes awaiting title resolution, make-ready, rehabilitation, or an approved sale, rental, relocation, or demolition strategy.



The role will coordinate administrative, project-management, data, title, vendor, field-verification, and Revenue handoff processes while maintaining accurate inventory and status information in Rent Manager.



Key Responsibilities:



Legal Handoff & Title Administration

Receive formal possession, abandonment, surrender, or legal handoffs and maintain a centralized title and ownership pipeline.

Verify ownership records, title documents, serial numbers, HUD data, tax records, liens, releases, and other supporting documentation.

Coordinate approved title-acquisition, abandonment, surrender, lien-release, and ownership-transfer processes.

Track required documentation, deadlines, tasks, and status histories.

Coordinate with authorized management personnel, attorneys, title specialists, tax offices, state agencies, and other approved third parties.

Escalate missing, conflicting, or legally complex title matters promptly.

Administratively coordinate title and abandonment processes without making independent legal determinations or performing activities reserved for licensed or authorized professionals.

Home Inventory & Data Management

Maintain accurate home-level inventory data in Rent Manager, including community/site, year, make, model, size, VIN/serial number, HUD information, ownership, title status, occupancy status, physical condition, and renovation/rehab stage.

Maintain accurate appliance inventory, target rent, sale price, RTO/lease-option pricing where applicable, target completion dates, next actions, assigned field resources/vendors, photographs, and supporting documentation.

Identify missing or conflicting information and coordinate physical verification when system information cannot be confirmed.

Ensure Rent Manager accurately reflects the physical status and condition of each home.

Asset Triage & Decision Support

Review field-audit photographs, walk-through videos, condition reports, title status, estimated repair scope and cost, market rent, potential sale price, site value, expected project duration, internal maintenance capacity, and vendor availability.

Prepare accurate information for leadership to determine the appropriate strategy for each home, including:

Make Ready

Park-Funded Rehab

Sell As-Is

Demo / Remove

Relocate / Other Approved Strategy

Execute approved strategies and provide leadership with the information needed to support asset and CapEx decisions.

Do not independently approve major CapEx or disposition decisions outside delegated authority.

Make-Ready & Rehab Project Management

Create or coordinate projects in Rent Manager and develop or use standardized Scopes of Work (SOWs).

Establish approved budgets and target completion dates.

Coordinate required materials and assign work to internal maintenance personnel or local field resources where appropriate.

Monitor internal technician workload and project capacity and identify when additional resources are needed.

Obtain and coordinate third-party vendor bids when required, including when internal capacity is unavailable, specialized licensing or trade expertise is required, project volume exceeds available resources, or outside execution provides a better economic result.

Issue or coordinate approved vendor work orders and Purchase Orders.

Track project milestones and require timestamped progress photographs and videos according to established procedures.

Review daily or milestone progress on active projects and identify delays immediately.

Track change orders and scope changes.

Compare vendor invoices against approved SOWs, bids, Purchase Orders, photographs, and completion documentation.

Escalate budget increases, missed milestones, quality issues, and contractor performance concerns.

Verify required completion documentation before recommending project closeout.

Maintain visibility into project scope, responsible parties, expected costs, deadlines, and completion status.

Vacant Home & Project Pipeline Management

Maintain a centralized portfolio-wide pipeline for vacant and non-performing homes.

Track each home through stages such as legal/possession hold, title resolution, field assessment, triage, strategy approval, make-ready, rehab, vendor work, sale as-is, demolition/removal, final verification, and Market Ready.

Ensure every home has a current stage, responsible person, next action, due date, budget, status notes, and supporting documentation.

Ensure no home remains in an undefined status and that every home has a clear next action.

Market-Ready Verification

Confirm that physical work is complete before a home is moved to Market Ready.

Verify required field inspections, completion photographs and videos, utilities, and basic habitability requirements where applicable.

Confirm Rent Manager status, home specifications, title/ownership status, approved rent/sale/RTO pricing, deposit, and other approved terms.

Confirm required marketing photographs, assets, and community/site information.

Revenue & Marketing Handoff

Notify the Leasing & Sales Manager and Revenue Team once a home is verified as Market Ready.

Provide complete home specifications, approved pricing, current photographs and videos, expected availability/move-in date, and applicable rental, sale, or RTO structure.

Ensure Rent Manager accurately reflects the home as available.

Coordinate with Marketing so verified inventory can be advertised promptly.

Monitor the home until it moves into the appropriate leasing or sales pipeline.





Required Skills & Qualifications:



3–5+ years of experience in U.S. property management, manufactured housing, asset management, construction coordination, rehab management, housing inventory, or a related field.

Manufactured-housing experience is strongly preferred.

Experience managing vacant-unit turns, make-readies, and/or residential rehabilitation projects.

Experience coordinating internal maintenance personnel and outside contractors.

Experience reviewing and enforcing Scopes of Work (SOWs).

Experience working with budgets, vendor bids, Purchase Orders, invoices, and change orders.

Experience reviewing field-inspection reports, photographs, and video documentation.

Advanced experience with Rent Manager, the company’s CRM/property management software, is strongly preferred, including familiarity with unit/home records, inventory and occupancy information, Service Orders, Tasks, Workflows, Automation, Vendors, Purchase Orders, Attachments, Documents, Notes/History, Reporting, Dashboards, and resident/unit status management.

Strong Excel and Microsoft 365 skills are required.

Experience with construction or project-management software, digital inspection tools, cloud-based photo documentation, AI-assisted workflows, and dashboard reporting is highly desirable.

Strong project-management, organizational, analytical, and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and concurrent projects.

Strong commercial judgment and problem-solving skills.

Excellent written and spoken English.

High attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

High integrity and willingness to challenge inaccurate data, incomplete work, unsupported invoices, missed deadlines, and unfulfilled commitments.

Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively across operations, field teams, vendors, legal/title resources, and Revenue/Marketing teams.





Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

Mid-Senior level

title: Inside Sales Representative – Inbound Leads | US Customers
description:
We are looking for a full-time Inside Sales Representative to convert inbound leads into paying customers for a U.S.-based flower business.



This is NOT a cold-calling or lead generation position. Our digital marketing team is already generating inbound leads from people and businesses interested in purchasing flowers.



Your responsibility is to take ownership of those leads and turn as many qualified opportunities as possible into sales.



What you will do:



• Call new inbound leads quickly after they submit an inquiry

• Understand what the customer needs, their occasion/event, timeline, budget, delivery requirements, and preferences

• Recommend appropriate products/options and help customers make a purchasing decision

• Follow up consistently by phone,
, and messaging when a lead does not purchase immediately

• Handle common objections, including price and product questions

• Ask for the sale and help the customer complete their purchase

• Keep every lead and follow-up properly updated in our CRM

• Report sales activity and results through clear weekly KPIs



We are looking for someone who:



• Has excellent spoken and written English

• Has proven experience in phone sales, inside sales, or closing inbound leads

• Has sold to U.S. customers before

• Is confident speaking with customers on the phone

• Knows how to ask good questions instead of simply reading a script

• Is persistent with follow-up without being pushy

• Is comfortable handling objections and asking for the sale

• Is organized and disciplined with CRM follow-up

• Can work full-time during U.S. Eastern Time business hours

• Is motivated by measurable sales results



IMPORTANT: Customer service experience alone is not enough for this position. We are specifically looking for someone who has been responsible for generating or closing sales.



How to apply



Please answer the following questions in your application:



1. What was the most recent product or service you personally sold?

2. Were you responsible for closing the sale yourself or setting appointments for another salesperson?

3. How many leads did you typically handle per week or month?

4. What sales targets, conversion rates, revenue numbers, or other measurable results did you achieve?

5. Tell us about your experience selling to U.S. customers by phone.

6. Are you available to work full-time during U.S. Eastern Time business hours?

7. What monthly compensation are you looking for?



***Please also include a link to a 60–90 second video or audio recording completing the following exercise:



Imagine I submitted an online inquiry because I need flowers for an event three weeks from now. You are calling me for the first time after receiving my inquiry.



Speak as if you were actually calling me. Your objective is to understand what I need and move the conversation toward a purchase.



Applications without the recording and answers to the questions above will not be considered.

title: Sales Call Center Director (New York Fastest Growing Med Spa)
description:
Call Center / Sales Development Director — High Performance Appointment Setting Team (Med Spa)



Position: Remote

Type: Full-time

Compensation: Up to $2800 monthly (Base + Bonus)



We're one of New York's fastest-growing aesthetics companies. We have 5 locations in New York, and are expanding to 20 locations by the end of 2027. 



We run advertising at scale, and every lead that comes in is greeted by our appointment-setting team within minutes. This team is the engine of the business — and we're looking for the person who will run it. We already have a team of 8 in house appointment setters, which will double in size over the next year. We are looking for a driven and experienced leader to take ownership of this Philippines Appointment setting team. 



This is not a role where you manage a queue and file reports. You will live in the call recordings, the dial data, and the conversion metrics. You will know within a week which setter is fumbling the price objection, which script line is killing bookings, and which hour of the day we're leaving money on the table. Then you'll fix it.



If you're the kind of person who gets a little obsessed with a 3-point lift in book rate, keep reading.



What You'll Own:



Coaching & Development



Run daily huddles and weekly 1:1s with every setter

Listen to and score calls every single day; deliver specific, recorded-example-based feedback

Build and maintain a call-scoring scorecard covering opening, discovery, objection handling, urgency, and close

Own onboarding and ramp for new setters — get new hires to full productivity fast, with a documented ramp plan

Side-by-side and live-listen coaching; roleplay objections until they're automatic



Performance Management:



Own the team's KPIs and report on them daily: dials, contact rate, set rate, show rate, and setter-sourced revenue

Identify underperformance early, build written improvement plans, and follow through — including tough calls on who stays

Run performance rankings and make coaching time proportional to opportunity, not seniority

Partner with leadership on incentive design, contests, and spiffs that actually change behavior



Operations & Scripts:



Own the scripts, rebuttals, voi
 templates, and SMS/follow-up cadences — and A/B test them relentlessly

Manage a 24/7 coverage schedule across a mix of US-based and offshore team members, including nights and weekends

Monitor speed-to-lead and hold the team to a minutes-not-hours standard on new inquiries

Keep CRM hygiene tight: disposition accuracy, pipeline stage integrity, no lead left untouched

Work directly with marketing on lead quality feedback, and with clinic/closing teams on smooth handoffs



Hiring & Team Building:



Recruit, interview, and hire setters as we scale

Build a culture people want to compete inside of — high standards, real recognition, zero drama



How You'll Be Measured:



Appointments set per setter, per day

Lead-to-appointment conversion rate

Show rate on booked appointments

Speed-to-lead (time from opt-in to first dial)

Setter-sourced revenue

Team retention and ramp time for new hires

You'll have a dashboard. You'll defend those numbers weekly. And when they move in the right direction, you'll get the credit.



Who You Are



Required:



5+ years managing or supervising an outbound sales, appointment-setting, inside sales, or high-volume contact center team

A track record you can actually talk through in numbers — "I took set rate from X to Y in Z months"

Genuinely strong at coaching: you can pull up a call, diagnose the miss in 30 seconds, and give feedback that sticks

Comfortable in a CRM and dialer environment; you build your own reports rather than waiting on someone else's

Data-literate — pivot tables, conversion math, and cohort comparisons don't scare you

Available for a schedule that covers a 24/7 operation, including some evenings and weekends

Direct, thick-skinned, and accountable. You raise problems early and own outcomes.



Nice to Have:



Experience in med spa, aesthetics, healthcare, or another high-volume consumer lead-gen environment (Preferred)

Experience managing offshore or remote agents

Familiarity with GoHighLevel, Zenoti, or similar CRM/booking platforms

Experience building QA scorecards or training programs from scratch



Who This Is Not For



Anyone who needs a fully built playbook handed to them

Anyone who manages by dashboard and never listens to a call

Anyone who's uncomfortable holding people accountable



What We Offer:



Competitive Compensation

Paid time off and paid holidays

Real ownership of a function that directly drives company revenue

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Virtual Assistant – Marketing, Tech & AI



Part-Time | 10–15 Hours/Week | $5–$7 USD/Hour | Long-Term



Are you a highly motivated, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant looking for meaningful work where you can make a real impact?



I’m a U.S.-based marriage and relationship coach looking for a smart, reliable, tech-savvy VA to join my team long-term. My work helps people better understand themselves and each other and build stronger, healthier relationships.



I’m looking for someone who is organized, proactive, excellent with technology and AI, and able to figure things out independently—not someone who needs every step spelled out.



Please read the entire post carefully before applying.



What You’ll Help With



* Use AI tools like ChatGPT to assist with content, research, lead magnets and marketing materials

* Design carousels and social media assets in Canva

* Update and create pages, landing pages and funnel pages on our existing WordPress website

* Build and manage opt-in forms, lead-magnet delivery sequences and automations in Kit/ConvertKit

* Help manage and repurpose content for Instagram and other sm platforms

* Schedule social media content across platforms

* Upload and organize video content using Vimeo

* Organize projects, content and launch plans using Google Workspace

* Test forms, links and automations to make sure everything works correctly

* Research solutions and troubleshoot basic technical problems

* Help create systems and processes that make the business more efficient



You Should Be Comfortable With



**AI / ChatGPT:** You should be genuinely proficient with AI—not simply able to type a prompt. I want someone who knows how to use AI to research, organize information, repurpose content, improve workflows and get work done faster while still using good judgment and checking the output.



**WordPress:** You should be comfortable working inside an existing WordPress website, including creating and editing pages and landing pages. You do NOT need to be a web developer or know how to code.



**Kit / ConvertKit:** Experience with Kit/ConvertKit or a similar marketing platform is strongly preferred. You should understand or be able to quickly learn opt-in forms, subscribers, tags, lead-magnet delivery, email sequences and automations.



**Canva:** You should have a strong working knowledge of Canva and be able to create polished, professional-looking PDFs, lead magnets and social media assets.



**Social Media:** You should understand Instagram, TikTok and YouTube and how content is formatted and managed across these platforms.



Experience with ** Zapier** is a plus.



You do not need to have used every tool we use. If you are technical, resourceful and learn new software quickly, I am open to training the right person.



 Required Qualifications



* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong technical skills and ability to learn new programs quickly

* Excellent organization and attention to detail

* Reliable and prompt communication

* Proactive problem-solving

* Ability to follow instructions carefully

* Resourcefulness—you look for answers before immediately asking for help

* Good judgment and willingness to check your own work

* Integrity and dependability

* Interest in personal growth and work that genuinely helps people



Experience as a VA, marketing assistant, social media assistant or online-business assistant is a bonus.



Hours & Compensation



Approximately **10–15 hours per week**, with the possibility of additional hours during busier periods.



Because I am in the United States, you must be able to regularly overlap with me during **4:00–7:00 PM U.S. Central Time**. You do not need to work that entire three-hour period every day, but you must have reliable availability within that window for communication and collaboration.



Starting pay is **$5–$7 USD/hour depending on experience**, with opportunities for increased responsibility, hours and compensation as the business grows.



I am looking for a **long-term team member**, not someone who simply completes a list of tasks.



I value clear communication, trust, initiative and appreciation. I want someone who enjoys learning, becoming better at what they do and contributing ideas—not just waiting for instructions.



As the business grows, I want the person in this role to grow with it.



Most importantly, the work we do matters. Our goal is to create content, resources and programs that help people understand themselves and the people they love more deeply and build better relationships.



If that mission resonates with you, I would love to hear from you.



To Apply answer the following questions please:

 address, and location in the Philippines?**



2. **What hourly rate are you requesting, and how many hours per week are you available?**



3. **This role requires regular availability during 4–7 PM U.S. Central Time. Are you able to consistently work or communicate during part of that window? What hours would you ideally work in Philippine Time?**



4. **Rate your experience with the following and briefly describe what you’ve done with each:**

   * Kit/ConvertKit or similar marketing software

   * Google Workspace

   * Social media management

   * Vimeo

title: Ecommerce Operations Assistant
description:

Ecommerce Operations Assistant

Full-Time · Remote



About AUGO

Take life to go.

That’s what AUGO is about. For the mom whose back door is always open with kids and dogs running through. For the off-roader strapping his ATV onto the truck. For families, adventurers, and everyone in between — AUGO is built to come with you.

We’re a fast-growing e-commerce brand selling durable, practical products across home and outdoor categories — including our magnetic screen doors and retractable ratchet straps. We’ve built a strong Amazon business with thousands of 5-star reviews, and we’re now scaling onto TikTok Shop, Shopify, and international marketplaces.

To keep growing at pace, we need someone who can execute across the entire operation.



The Role

We’re hiring a full-time Ecommerce Operations Assistant to be the tactical backbone of our team.

This is a shared role — you’ll support multiple department heads across Amazon operations, customer service, multi-platform store management, pricing, and light sourcing. You won’t be siloed to one area. You’ll be the reason customer messages get answered fast, listings stay healthy, pricing stays consistent across platforms, and the operation runs smoothly across countries.

You’ll report to the team through a shared task queue. Priorities are set collaboratively each week. Your job is to execute — cleanly, quickly, and with the kind of attention to detail that makes department heads want to keep giving you more.

If you love variety, ownership, and being trusted across an entire operation, this role is for you.



What You’ll Own

Amazon Listing Monitoring & Support Monitor Amazon listing health across our catalog. Flag issues as they happen — Buy Box loss, suppressed listings, content violations, low inventory alerts. Support listing updates when needed (titles, bullets, descriptions, images). Back up the team on keyword research and backend search terms.

Customer Service Across Channels Respond to Amazon customer messages within 24 hours. Handle the customer
 inbox at 
 Amazon Q&A responses. Escalate complex issues to the right department head. Track recurring issues so we can fix them upstream.

Multi-Platform Store Management Support our Shopify store — product info, imagery, promotions, and updates. Support TikTok Shop backend maintenance. Coordinate updates across platforms so everything stays consistent.

Pricing Across Platforms & Countries Keep pricing accurate and aligned across Amazon (US + international marketplaces), Shopify, TikTok Shop, and any other channels we launch on. Maintain pricing sheets in Google Sheets. Roll out coordinated pricing changes when the team makes them.

Image Work & Content Support Basic image editing in Canva or Photoshop. Prepare listing images to spec across platforms. Support A+ content and promotional graphics when needed.

Sourcing Research Basic supplier research on Alibaba and 1688. Build vendor comparison spreadsheets. Coordinate sample tracking. You’re not negotiating deals — you’re building the data department heads need to negotiate.

Data & Reporting Support Data entry into internal systems. Compile weekly reports across platforms. Ad-hoc analysis for department heads as needed.



What Success Looks Like

•             Monitor Amazon listing health across the catalog — flag issues within 24 hours

•             Resolve customer messages within 24 hours across Amazon +
 inbox (95%+ hit rate)

•             Handle 50+ customer service touches per week solo across all channels

 inbox, VA Task Queue

Days 31–60 — Own Cross-Department Work

•             Handle 30–50 customer messages/week solo across Amazon +

•             Take ownership of pricing consistency across platforms

•             Complete first Shopify store update project

•             Complete first image editing assignment

•             Complete first sourcing research task

•             Begin weekly async check-ins with department heads

Days 61–90 — Optimize & Scale

•             Full ownership of customer inbox at scale (50+/week)

•             Full ownership of Amazon listing health monitoring

•             Own pricing coordination across all platforms

•             Deliver Shopify updates on schedule

•             Complete cross-department sourcing projects

•             Flag process improvements and help refine SOPs



Required Experience

•             1+ year direct hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience — non-negotiable

•             Experience monitoring or managing e-commerce listings

•             Prior customer service background

•             Comfortable managing tasks from multiple stakeholders



Required Skills

•             Near-native written English (9+/10 self-rating)

•             Amazon Seller Central proficiency

•             Customer service written communication

•             Google Workspace proficiency (Sheets, Docs, Drive)

•             Basic Canva or Photoshop

•             Detail-oriented, organized, comfortable multi-tasking

•             Reliable time zone overlap with US Eastern (3–4 hrs/day minimum)



Nice to Have (Not Required)

•             TikTok Shop backend familiarity

•             Amazon PPC / advertising familiarity

•             Helium 10, Jungle Scout, DataDive, or similar tools

•             Alibaba / 1688 sourcing experience

•             International marketplace experience (Amazon EU, UK, CA, AU)

•             Basic spreadsheet formulas (VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH)

•             A+ content design experience



Who You Are

•             Self-directed within clear priorities

•             Comfortable receiving tasks from multiple department heads — you don’t get overwhelmed by multi-tasking, you find rhythm in it

•             Strong prioritization judgment — you know what to do first

•             Proactive communicator who flags blockers early

•             Handles pressure well

•             Owns your work — doesn’t wait for permission

•             Team-oriented — you’re comfortable being a shared resource, not a solo hire



Benefits & Culture — Why You’ll Thrive at AUGO

Cross-Functional Exposure Most VA roles pigeonhole you into one narrow area. This one gives you access to every part of the operation — Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, customer service, pricing, sourcing, cross-country work. You’ll learn how an entire e-commerce brand actually runs from the inside.

Direct Line to the Team You’ll work directly with the founder and multiple department heads. No corporate red tape, no committee approvals, no waiting weeks for direction. Real feedback, real answers, real ownership.

A Brand With Proven Traction Thousands of 5-star reviews on Amazon. We’re not a startup guessing at product-market fit — we’re a proven brand scaling across new channels, new countries, and new categories. Your work compounds on real 
ntum.

Real Impact Across Departments Your work moves the needle in customer satisfaction, listing health, pricing accuracy, cross-platform consistency, sourcing costs — everywhere. You’ll see your contribution in real business results, every week.

Growth Path Prove yourself here and there’s room to grow — into specialist tracks (Amazon operations, customer experience, sourcing, international expansion), team lead roles, or department support as AUGO scales.

Fully Remote Work from wherever you’re most productive. All you need is reliable internet, US Eastern time zone overlap, and the discipline to show up every day.

Mission-Driven AUGO is about helping families and adventurers take life to go. You’ll be growing a brand that genuinely makes people’s lives easier — that shows up in every 5-star review, every returning customer, every review that says “buying another one for my in-laws.”

title: Experienced E-commerce Supply Chain Manager Shopify, ParcelPanel & Supplier Operations
description:
Experienced E-commerce Supply Chain Manager

Shopify, ParcelPanel & Supplier Operations



We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Supply Chain Manager for our growing US-focused fashion e-commerce business.



This is not a basic order-checking position. You will take ownership of our daily order operations, supplier performance, shipping issues, product-quality risks and internal reporting.



We are looking for someone who identifies problems early, works with verified information and follows every issue until it is fully resolved.



Requirements



You must have:



At least two years of experience in e-commerce supply chain, logistics or order operations

Experience working with Shopify stores generating at least $100,000 in monthly revenue or processing a high daily order volume

Strong experience with Shopify and ParcelPanel

Experience communicating directly with suppliers or fulfillment agents

Good knowledge of tracking statuses, carrier delays and fulfillment problems

Experience using Google Sheets or Excel

Excellent written and spoken English

Strong problem-solving, organization and follow-up skills

Experience handling multiple stores, suppliers or workflows

The confidence to hold suppliers accountable when agreements are not followed



Experience with Gorgias, Slack, 
, 17Track, YunExpress or ParcelsApp is a strong advantage.



Main Responsibilities

Daily order management

Check all open Shopify orders every day

Compare Shopify, ParcelPanel and our internal tracking sheets

Verify that fulfilled orders have valid tracking information

Investigate unfulfilled, delayed, lost and exception shipments

Handle incorrect addresses, duplicate orders, cancellations and order changes

Monitor Lost in Transit, Return to Sender and Return to China cases

Make sure every unresolved issue has a status, action, owner and follow-up date

Prevent unfulfilled orders from remaining unresolved for more than seven days

Provide Customer Support with accurate and verified order updates

Supplier management

Follow up on orders that are not processed on time

Request confirmed shipping dates instead of accepting vague answers

Monitor stock shortages and unavailable variants

Request replacements or reimbursements for supplier mistakes

Track wrong products, sizes, colors and variants

Follow up on damaged shipments and quality problems

Record supplier responses, resolutions and next actions

Monitor repeated supplier failures and enforce supplier agreements



Our suppliers are generally expected to process orders within three to five business days, add tracking within 24 hours after processing and report stock problems within 48 hours.



Product-quality control

Review repeated sizing and product-quality complaints

Collect customer photos, videos and supporting evidence

Compare advertised products with the actual materials and measurements

Discuss recurring quality problems with suppliers

Recommend size-chart or product-page corrections

Help find alternative or backup suppliers

Recommend pausing risky products when necessary

Confirm that agreed supplier corrections have actually been completed

Reporting



You will complete a clear End-of-Day Report containing:



Orders checked

Open issues handled

Unfulfilled, delayed or lost orders

Supplier problems

Refunds or replacements processed

Completed resolutions

Current unresolved cases

Store and open-order status

Risks, recurring problems and priorities for the next day



All internal sheets must remain accurate and updated.



What Success Looks Like



You will be evaluated on:



Accuracy of order and tracking information

Number of missed unfulfilled orders

Speed of identifying problems

Quality of supplier follow-ups

Accuracy of internal sheets and EOD reports

Reduction of avoidable delays, refunds and chargebacks

Ability to identify risky products early

Reliability, ownership and follow-through



Accuracy always comes before speed.



What We Offer

A serious long-term position

Clear SOPs, training videos and internal tracking systems

Direct communication with management

The opportunity to help improve our supply chain department

Growth opportunities as our order volume and team expand

The possibility of moving into a senior or department-lead position

Performance bonuses after clear targets have been agreed upon

How to Apply



Start your application with the exact words:



COCA COLA



Applications that do not begin with these words will not be reviewed.



Please answer:



How many years of e-commerce supply chain experience do you have?

What Shopify stores or niches have you worked with?

What was the largest monthly revenue or daily order volume you managed?

Which relevant tools have you used?

What supplier and fulfillment problems were you personally responsible for solving?

Have you created or improved SOPs, tracking sheets or operational reports?

Describe a situation where you found an order problem before the customer complained.

What is your realistic weekly availability and preferred working schedule?

Practical Case



A Shopify order has been unfulfilled for eight days. ParcelPanel shows “Info Received”, but there is no confirmed carrier movement. The supplier did not warn the team, and the customer is becoming frustrated.



Briefly explain:



What you would check

Which tools you would use

What you would ask the supplier

What you would record internally

What update you would give Customer Support

How you would follow up until the case is resolved



Generic or copied applications will not move forward.



Successful candidates will receive a practical assignment and will then be invited to an English video interview. Compensation will be discussed during the interview based on demonstrated experience, skills and overall fit.

Overcome customer objections and execute contracts seamlessly.

Ensure smooth post-sale handoffs to the field crew for installation.

Build trust and positive relationships with clients to generate recurring referral business.



2. Lead Management & Pipeline Follow-Up

Prioritize rapid response to new inbound leads. We believe speed-to-lead matters—the sooner a prospect receives a helpful, professional response after requesting a quote, the greater the opportunity to start a conversation and earn their business. While circumstances will vary throughout the day, treat new inquiries as a priority and respond as quickly as reasonably possible.

Maintain a 24-hour maximum response standard. No new quote request or qualified inbound lead should go more than 24 hours without receiving a response or acknowledgment.

Create responsiveness without pressure. Our goal is for prospects to feel that their inquiry is important and that our team is attentive—not that they are being chased or pressured into making a decision.

Consistently follow up with open opportunities. Maintain organized, professional follow-up with prospects who have received quotes, requested additional time, or have not yet made a decision.

Qualify and prioritize opportunities. Identify customers who are ready to move forward, those who require additional information or follow-up, and those who may be better suited for future consideration.

Maintain an organized sales pipeline. Use the CRM and established follow-up processes to ensure opportunities do not fall through the cracks and that each prospect receives the appropriate level of communication throughout the sales process.



3. Customer Retention & Revenue Growth

Lead seasonal renewal outreach to re-engage past clients and secure renewal contracts.

Target and pursue upsell opportunities (e.g., upgrading seasonal packages to permanent solutions, expanding to additional properties, adding premium services).

Build relationships focused on high lifetime customer value to hit a 75%+ renewal/rebooking rate.



4. Sales Process Improvement & Documentation

Map out the sales workflow to identify bottlenecks, friction points, and conversion barriers.



A/B test proposal formats, pricing structures, and objection-handling strategies.

Create and update standard proposal templates, scripts, and objection guides.

Continually refine approaches based on real-time customer conversations.

5. Feedback & Strategic Recommendations



Submit monthly written reports detailing key operational and sales findings:

Top objections and recurring pushback ("customers always ask about X").

Pricing feedback and sensitivity trends (e.g., "$1,500 seasonal closes at 40%; $2,000+ closes at 15%").



Actionable ideas to boost overall conversion rates from 10% to 15%+.

Patterns regarding messaging that sells vs. messaging that fails.

Partner directly with the CEO and Operations to test new pricing structures and sales messaging.

6. Sales Pipeline & Performance Tracking

Weekly Pipeline Tracking: Maintain and share weekly updates on active leads, pending proposals, expected close dates, and key follow-up items to keep the team aligned.

Monthly Sales Performance Report: Track and review:

Total leads received and lead sources.

Close rates, revenue by category, and month-over-month trends.

Average deal value, lead response time, and proposal-to-close conversion rate.

Renewal and rebooking progress compared with monthly/seasonal targets.

Team Review & Follow-Up: Use the tracking data to identify opportunities, gaps, and follow-up priorities, and coordinate with the sales team on next steps.



Required Qualifications

You do not need previous experience in the holiday lighting industry. We can teach you our products, services, pricing, and sales process.

What we're looking for is someone who knows how to sell, communicates well, follows up consistently, and is willing to learn.

Sales ability: Previous experience in direct sales, inside sales, or customer-facing sales with the ability to understand customer needs, present solutions, handle objections, and confidently ask for the sale.

Excellent English communication: Strong spoken and written English with the confidence to communicate professionally with U.S. homeowners by phone, video,
, and SMS.

Relationship building: Able to quickly establish rapport and create a comfortable, consultative customer experience.

Follow-up discipline: Organized and persistent without being pushy; able to manage multiple opportunities at different stages of the sales process.

Objection handling: Comfortable discussing pricing, answering questions, addressing concerns, and helping customers make confident purchasing decisions.

Organization & CRM use: Comfortable learning and consistently using CRM systems to document conversations, proposals, follow-ups, and deal status.

Self-directed & accountable: Able to prioritize opportunities, manage responsibilities independently, and take ownership of results.

Team player & collaborative: Works well with others, communicates openly, shares information, and is willing to support the team to achieve shared goals.

Coachable & willing to learn: Open to feedback and willing to learn our products, services, customers, and sales process.

Reliable remote-work setup: Reliable computer, high-speed internet, professional work environment, and ability to consistently work U.S. Eastern Time.

Preferred Qualifications

The following experience can help you succeed in the role, but you do not need to check every box to apply:

3+ years of direct or high-ticket sales experience.

Experience selling to U.S. customers.

B2C or full-cycle sales experience.

Home-service sales experience such as HVAC, solar, roofing, landscaping, lighting, or similar industries.

Remote phone or video sales experience.

Experience with recurring, seasonal, or renewal-based revenue.

Experience with upselling, account growth, or customer retention.

Experience providing feedback that helped improve a sales process.

Most importantly, we're looking for someone who can sell, communicate professionally, follow up consistently, take care of customers, and continue improving. If you have a strong sales background but haven't worked in holiday lighting before, we still want to hear from you.

When applying, be prepared to share examples of your previous sales experience, results you're proud of, and situations where you successfully helped move a customer from initial interest to a completed sale.

Competencies

Results-driven: Motivated by closing deals and hitting targets

Adaptive: Willing to test approaches, measure results, and pivot based on data

Customer-focused: Builds genuine relationships; understands long-term value of customer retention

Detail-oriented: Maintains accurate records; tracks what's working and what isn't

Collaborative: Works well with small team; open to coaching and process feedback

Proactive: Identifies opportunities and problems before being asked; offers solutions



Role Expectations

1. Work Environment

Location: 100% Remote (Must work from home or anywhere in the Philippines).

Work Schedule

Standard Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET), following U.S. Eastern Time. This is a consistent U.S. daytime / Philippine overnight position.

Optional Peak-Season Hours: During our busiest sales season, representatives who want additional earning opportunities may choose to extend their availability until approximately 7:30–8:00 PM ET.

Extended hours are optional and are not part of the standard year-round schedule. Team members who prefer to maintain the regular 8:00 AM–5:00 PM ET schedule may do so.

For representatives who want to maximize their earnings during peak season, the extended window provides additional opportunities to respond to inbound leads, conduct customer consultations, follow up with active opportunities, close additional sales, and earn additional commission.

2. Employment Structure

Status: 1099 Independent Contractor (either party must provide 2 weeks' notice to terminate).

Equipment: Contractor must supply their own reliable computer, phone, high-speed internet, and necessary work environment.

Why Join Us?

Base Pay + Uncapped Commission: Earn a guaranteed hourly base plus commission on new sales, renewals, and upsells, with additional performance bonus opportunities.

Work With a Great Team: Join a supportive, collaborative team with a hands-on and approachable CEO who values good ideas, initiative, and teamwork.

Leadership Opportunity: Take a key role in helping lead and grow the sales team, with the opportunity to shape sales processes, improve performance, and contribute to the company’s growth.

Room to Grow: As the company continues to grow, there will be opportunities to take on more responsibility and make a meaningful impact.





3. Reporting Structure



Work closely with the CEO to stay aligned on sales priorities, pipeline progress, and growth goals.

Partner with the Operations team to coordinate lead information, property details, and installation scheduling.

Share feedback and ideas with Operations to make lead handoffs smoother and improve the overall customer experience.



Compensation & Earning Potential

This position combines a guaranteed hourly base with uncapped sales commission and performance-based bonus opportunities. Our compensation structure is designed to provide dependable base income while rewarding representatives who generate new business, grow existing accounts, retain customers, and deliver a strong customer experience.

Base Pay: $5.00–$8.50 USD/hour

Starting base pay is determined by experience, communication ability, demonstrated sales performance, and overall qualifications. There is also room for base compensation to grow as you demonstrate strong performance and take on additional responsibility.

New Customer Sales: 5% of Gross Profit

Earn 5% of gross profit on qualifying new customer sales you successfully close.

Upsells & Account Growth: 5% of Gross Profit

Earn 5% of gross profit on the additional sale when you successfully sell additional products, services, or upgrades to an existing customer.

For example, if an existing customer adds additional lighting or another service to their original project, the 5% commission applies to the gross profit generated by that additional sale.

Customer Renewals: 2% of Gross Profit

Earn 2% of gross profit when a returning customer reaches a renewal decision and you successfully secure their business for another term. This includes:

Returning one-year customers who renew for another season or term.

Customers who have completed a multi-year agreement and choose to enter into a new agreement.

Customers who are still within an active multi-year agreement are not considered renewals and do not generate renewal commission on their existing contracted service. However, any qualifying additional products or services sold to that customer are eligible for the 5% upsell commission.

Additional Performance Bonuses

Representatives may also qualify for additional performance-based bonuses tied to individual and company goals, including sales performance, close rates, customer retention, and customer satisfaction.

Your Performance Drives Your Earning Potential

Our compensation philosophy is simple: the more value you create, the greater your opportunity to earn.

Your hourly base provides consistent compensation for managing customers, following up with leads, maintaining the sales pipeline, supporting existing accounts, and completing the day-to-day responsibilities of the position.

Commission rewards you for producing measurable results:

New revenue → 5% of gross profit

Upsell/expanded revenue → 5% of gross profit

Renewed revenue → 2% of gross profit

Existing contracted revenue → Base compensation

Sales commission is uncapped, allowing high-performing representatives to increase their earnings as they close more business and grow customer accounts.

High-performing representatives may also have opportunities to advance into Senior Sales Representative, Sales Lead, or Sales Management positions with increased responsibility and compensation.

Payment & Invoicing

Invoices are submitted semi-monthly on the 1st and 15th of each month.

Direct wire transfer or digital payment is processed within 2–3 business days of invoice submission.

No expense reimbursement is provided.

Please send your resume along with a 1–2 minute video introduction telling us a little about yourself and why you believe you're the best fit for the role.



Submit your application to 
 look forward to hearing from you!

title: Customer Success Sales Representative
description:
Customer Success Sales Representative

MISSION STATEMENT



SecureSpace Self Storage is one of the fastest-growing self-storage platforms in the USA, with assets located primarily in high-density, urban markets. With a focus on exceptional customer service, modern technology, and upgraded security features, SecureSpace provides a high-quality storage experience that our customers can count on at any location they visit.



SCOPE OF POSITION



The Customer Success Sales Representative at SecureSpace plays a critical role in converting prospective customers into new tenants by identifying their storage needs, recommending the right storage solution, and confidently completing rentals entirely over the phone.



Because many customers will rent a storage unit without visiting the facility or seeing the unit in person, this position requires the ability to build trust quickly, clearly communicate the value of SecureSpace's facilities and features, and help customers feel confident in their rental decision. Representatives will use SecureSpace's technology and available facility information to accurately describe unit options, pricing, promotions, access, security features, and other relevant amenities.



This is a results-driven sales position that combines consultative selling with exceptional customer service. The ideal candidate is confident, persuasive without being overly aggressive, comfortable overcoming objections, and motivated by achieving individual and team sales goals.



The representative will perform all responsibilities remotely while remaining actively connected with customers and the SecureSpace team. Success in this position requires strong communication, accountability, adaptability, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced sales environment.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE



· 2–5 years of sales, inside sales, call center, or customer service experience; phone-based sales experience preferred.



· High school diploma or equivalent; college education is a plus.



· Excellent verbal communication skills with the ability to build rapport and establish trust with customers over the phone.



· Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to ask effective questions, identify customer needs, and recommend appropriate storage solutions.



· Comfortable discussing pricing, promotions, unit features, protection plans, and additional products or services.



· Confident in asking for the sale and guiding customers toward completing their rental during the initial interaction.



· Ability to effectively address customer concerns and overcome objections related to price, location, unit size, availability, facility features, and other factors.



· Goal-oriented and motivated by measurable sales targets, conversion goals, and performance incentives.



· Demonstrates a proactive attitude, strong work ethic, and personal accountability for results.



· Friendly and service-focused while maintaining a strong sales mindset.



· Innovative and proactive problem solver who can adapt quickly to changing customer needs, inventory, pricing, and business priorities.



· Self-motivated and capable of working independently in a remote environment while actively contributing to team goals.



· Comfortable learning and navigating multiple systems and technology platforms while communicating with customers.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:



· Engage with prospective customers by phone to identify their storage needs, including desired unit size, location, timeframe, accessibility requirements, and other preferences.



· Convert inbound sales opportunities into completed storage rentals by confidently guiding customers through the entire rental process.



· Build customer confidence in renting a storage unit sight unseen by accurately explaining facility features, unit types, security measures, access options, pricing, promotions, and other relevant information.



· Utilize consultative selling techniques to recommend storage solutions based on each customer's individual needs rather than relying solely on customer-requested unit sizes.



· Clearly communicate the value and benefits of SecureSpace facilities and differentiate available options when customers are comparing competitors.



· Address and overcome objections related to pricing, unit size, distance, availability, promotions, facility features, and other common customer concerns.



· Create appropriate urgency when availability or promotional pricing is limited while maintaining an honest and customer-focused sales approach.



· Confidently ask for the sale and encourage qualified customers to complete their rental during the initial interaction whenever possible.



· Achieve and exceed individual and team sales goals, including unit rentals, conversion rates, protection plan enrollment, moving supply sales, and other established performance metrics.



· Accurately explain rental agreements, payment expectations, access procedures, protection plan requirements, and other important move-in information before completing a rental.



· Maintain accurate and detailed customer and sales notes within company systems to support follow-up and ensure a seamless customer experience.



· Follow established procedures for sales opportunities requiring additional follow-up and maintain ownership of opportunities when appropriate.



· Stay knowledgeable about SecureSpace locations, available inventory, promotions, facility amenities, policies, and sales procedures.



· Function independently on a daily basis while promoting teamwork and collaboration with other representatives, facility teams, and leadership in a remote environment.



· Demonstrate strong communication, sales, troubleshooting, and adaptability skills while representing SecureSpace professionally during every customer interaction.



· Complete additional duties as assigned.



REPORTS TO



Customer Success Manager



PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS



Qualified individuals must be able to perform the position's essential duties with or without accommodation. A qualified person with a disability may request a modification or adjustment to the job or work environment to meet the physical requirements of the position. GSA/SecureSpace will attempt to satisfy requests if the accommodations needed are reasonable and no undue hardship would result.



· Ability to perform essential job functions while seated for extended periods, including working on a computer and handling a high volume of phone calls, as well as sit, walk, stand, bend, squat, climb, kneel, and twist intermittently or continuously.



· Capability to read documents and focus on computer screens, with or without corrective lenses as may be required.



· Ability to arrange the workspace efficiently for productivity, accommodating any individual needs for ergonomic considerations.



· Ability to maintain a reliable remote workspace and effectively communicate with customers and team members throughout the scheduled workday.



· Willingness to transition between sales opportunities, customer interactions, follow-up activities, and other responsibilities while maintaining productivity and effectiveness.

Communication and task management via
