title: Technical Artist — VFX, Shaders & Level Game Objects
description:
About the game

is a third-person roguelite dungeon crawler in Unity. Runs are built from DunGen tiles across themed worlds (fire, ice, castle/dungeon, tutorial). Combat is ability- and modifier-heavy, with elemental damage, bosses, traps, chests, portals, and secret rooms.



We need someone who can make those spaces read clearly, feel dangerous, and stay performant — not a generalist who only drops store VFX into a scene.



The role

You will own the look of gameplay and the objects players interact with:



VFX & shaders — combat, status, environment, and feedback

Level design game objects — tile dressing, interactables, and world-specific props that survive procedural assembly

You work in the Editor: Shader Graph, VFX Graph, particle systems, prefabs, and tile layouts. Light C# is useful for wiring effects to gameplay; this is not a systems-programmer seat.



What you’ll do

VFX & shaders

Author Shader Graph (and HLSL when Graph is not enough) for combat and environment: slashes, trails, shockwaves, beams, lava/ice, scan/highlight, dissolve, portals, status indicators.

Build VFX Graph and Particle System prefabs for abilities, enemy telegraphs, boss attacks, pickups (Ash), teleports, traps, and discovery feedback.

Adapt and restyle third-party packs (Hovl, UNI VFX, KriptoFX, elemental blast/shield kits, dissolve/scan FX) so they match Ember’s look and URP stripping/perf rules.

Work with volumetric fog/lights, URP features, and material variants so fire vs ice vs stone worlds stay distinct without blowing the GPU budget.

Make effects readable in combat: silhouettes, timing, color coding for elements/status, and clear “this will hit you” vs flavor.

Level design game objects

Dress and maintain DunGen tiles: rooms, corridors, start/end tiles, boss rooms, unique/secret rooms, transition tiles.

Build and polish interactable prefabs: chests, doors, secret doors, traps, heal/modifier pickups, teleports, journal pickups, spawn VFX, merchant/set dressing.

Place collision, triggers, spawn points, NavMesh-friendly geometry, and static flags so tiles generate cleanly and pass level validation.



Profile and fix overdraw, fill rate, lightmap scale, and batching on tiles and VFX.

What we’re looking for

Required



Shipped (or late-production) work in Unity URP with Shader Graph and either VFX Graph or high-end Particle Systems.

Strong prefab / scene craft: hierarchy, LODs, colliders, materials, lighting, and “this object works when a generator instances it.”

Portfolio that shows gameplay VFX (hits, AOE, status, telegraphs) and authored 3D spaces (dungeons, interiors, or tile-based levels) — not only cinematic reels.

Comfort with performance: overdraw, particle budgets, shader variants, URP stripping, mobile/PC-class constraints.

Ability to take an existing art kit and make coherent, on-theme game objects, not one-off hero shots.

Strong plus



Custom HLSL, Shader Graph subgraphs, or URP Renderer Features.

Elemental / dark-fantasy combat look (fire, ice, poison, arcane, dissolve, scan).

Light C# for VFX hooks, material property blocks, or pooling.

ProBuilder, Polybrush, or kitbashing dungeon modular kits.

Not the focus



Character modeling/animation as a primary duty

Full gameplay systems / AI programming

UI/UX as a primary duty

title: Video Editor & Graphic Designer
description:
We're looking for the person who opens our creative brief, reads what we wrote, and comes back with something better than what we asked for.



If your instinct on getting a brief is to fill the order exactly as written, this role will frustrate both of us. We want the editor who asks why the hook isn't landing and proposes a stronger one, who remembers the b-roll we shot two projects ago and pulls it into this week's Reel, and who sends us a trend on Tuesday that we hadn't seen yet.

We're hiring one person to do that across video and design.



Who we are

The Assist is a newsletter for professional women navigating the full complexity of career and life, reaching 300K+ engaged readers. We publish four editions a week (OG Tuesday, Wellness Wednesday, ThirstyThursday, and The Weekender), each built for a different moment in her week, and we're building out our Instagram presence to match what we've built in
. We're small, we move fast, and we care a lot about craft.



We give readers the specific move, not just the concept. Tactical guidance, honest perspective, whole-person support: written by women, for women, never corporate.



The role

You'll work as an embedded member of our creative team on a contract basis. You'll sit inside our process, know our brand as well as we do, and have opinions about it.



Two jobs in one seat:

Video (roughly 70% of the work). Cutting Instagram Reels, and building the template system that lets us produce them at volume.

Design (roughly 30%). Finishing our brand identity and building carousel templates our team can run without you. This is ideal but not required. 



What you'll deliver each month

8-10 Instagram Reels

Ongoing additions to our Reel and carousel template library

Proactive ideas: trends, formats, and hooks you think we should try



How our process works

Our campaigns live in a Notion database. Each campaign contains a creative brief for a Reel, and inside that brief you'll find b-roll, script ideas, and the preset templates we want used.

Raw footage and brand assets currently live in Google Drive, but we're just getting started with video, so you'll help us shape the process as we go.



You pull the brief, cut the Reel, and send it back. Along the way we expect you to talk to us:

“Can you shoot b-roll of X? It would make this opening land.”

“Have you seen the latest trend of X? You guys should try it.” 

“You used footage two campaigns ago that fits this. Want me to pull it in?”

“This hook isn't strong enough. Here are two alternates.”



The video work, specifically

We want our video brand identity to feel like our newsletter has come to life: fun, witty, and full of big-sister energy. We're here to motivate, teach, share, and collaborate. We're all learning together, and the editing should feel that way too.

We want videos that are in this kind of style:



Talking-head editing that stays natural while feeling finished. One locked-off shot, soft natural light, mic visible on purpose. The energy comes entirely from the cutting.

Invisible jump cuts. Tightening speech in-frame so the pace lifts without feeling choppy, fast and dense without ever feeling jarring.

L-cuts and J-cuts. Audio leading or trailing the picture so transitions land smoothly.

Headline typography as the scroll-stopper. Oversized, all-caps, stacked, centered, with color used intentionally to reinforce the point being made. This is the single most important skill for this role.

Caption styling with real taste in type. Something like a light serif set phrase-by-phrase, not the default karaoke preset most editing apps default to.

Screenshot and cutout overlays. Drop-shadowed, slightly rotated, clustered as visual evidence inside the frame.

Restraint with stickers and emoji. Sparse accents that punctuate a moment and then get out of the way.

Sound design that serves the edit. Little to no music bed, closer to wall-to-wall voiceover, with pace coming from the speech and the cutting rather than a track underneath it.



The design work, specifically

This role covers both finishing our brand identity and turning it into templates our team can run without you. That's two different skill sets, and we're looking for someone who can do both.



Brand strategy

Finish our brand identity. We're about 85% there. We have a couple of different brand guidelines in place that need to be merged into one cohesive document, with the judgment calls that requires (what stays, what goes, what's the actual system) rather than just formatting an existing decision.



Production

Build carousel templates. Reusable, on-brand, and simple enough that our interns and virtual assistants can produce from them without design training.

Create visual assets we can rebuild ourselves. Everything you make should be handed over in a form our team can edit and extend.



Tools

Required: Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, Notion.

Also needed: After Effects, Descript, Canva, Illustrator, plus a willingness to bring in other tools we haven't discovered yet.



You should be

Fluent in short-form vertical video, with a portfolio of Reels or TikToks you cut yourself

Genuinely good with type. Most of this job is typography moving in time

Comfortable being told "here's the brief, make it better"

A self-starter who can help us see what's possible with video, since we don't know everything about it ourselves

A clear communicator in writing, since most of our back-and-forth will be async

Organized enough to build systems other people can use, and to hand over files in a state they can pick up

Active enough on social media that trends reach you before they reach us

Available on Slack with hours that overlap the Pacific Standard Time team, and open to the occasional quick scheduled video call when async isn't enough



You'll stand out if

You've built a template system that a team actually adopted and kept using

You've worked on a newsletter, media brand, or creator-led business

You have a point of view about our current Instagram and tell us what you'd change

You've helped shape a brand identity and can walk us through the thinking behind it

You send us an idea we hadn't thought of before we've even hired you



The arrangement

Independent contractor, month to month.

Monthly retainer depending on skillset and experience, tied to the deliverable goals above.

Work made for hire, standard ownership terms.

Either side can step away with 30 days' notice.



How to apply

Apply through this listing and reply with two or three Reels or TikToks you personally cut, ideally similar in style to what we're going for. If they're already visible on your profile or portfolio, feel free to just point us there instead of re-sending them.

Remote, Philippines. 11:00am to 8:30pm US Eastern. 1,200 to 1,500 USD per month.



ABOUT THE JOB

We are an online education company. Members pay for a course and for our team to help them finish it. You are one of three people they talk to when they need help. You work in our community platform, our support ticket system and our
 inbox.



WHAT YOU DO

- Answer member questions in the community, by
 and in the ticket system within two hours.

- Communicate with the developer team about customer problems. Write the ticket so a developer can act on it without asking questions. Chase it until it is done. You tell the member it is fixed.

- Communicate with the customer support and onboarding teams about customer problems. Hand over the members who need a phone call, a billing change or a refund decision, and follow up so nothing gets dropped between teams.

- Keep a list of every open request and work it down to zero. A request stays on your list until the member confirms it is sorted.

- Calm down members who are threatening to cancel or asking for a refund. Hear them out and bring in a manager while there is still a chance to fix it.

- Write and post community announcements. Product changes, delays and new resources.

- Welcome every new member and reply to their introduction post. Show them where to start so their first week is not silent.

- Moderate the community. Remove spam, keep discussions on topic, step in when members argue.

- Write an end of shift report. How many messages came in, how many you closed, what is still open, and what you need from another team.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Excellent written English. You will be writing to American customers all day. They should feel calmer after reading your message.

- Two years of customer support experience, ideally for a software product or an online service, and ideally already on US hours.

- Comfortable learning software. You do not need to write code. You do need to read an error message, look through a help document, and work out what to tell the member. You see every technical problem first.

- You do not let things sit. When you cannot solve something, say so and hand it to someone who can.

- The application key is Alden



YOUR SCHEDULE

- Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Friday and Saturday, 11:00am to 8:30pm US Eastern, with Wednesday and Thursday off. The same hours every day you work. Each shift is 9.5 hours including two paid 30 minute breaks. In Manila that is 11:00pm to 8:30am, so this is night work.



You are never on your own. Two teammates cover the community on their own shifts, and your hours sit alongside theirs through the busiest part of the day.



HOW WE MEASURE YOUR WORK AND HOW WE PAY

Three numbers, and you see all three every morning. How quickly you reply. How many members you answered. A quality score on the replies you wrote.

Online Instruction & Course Management:

title: Meta Ads Uploader
description:
Meta Ads Uploader for Ecommerce Brand



We need a reliable person who already knows how to use Meta Ads Manager and can upload approved ecommerce ads quickly and accurately.



This is a straightforward execution role. We will provide the videos, primary text, headlines, product URL, budget, and campaign instructions. Your job is to upload everything correctly, check the setup, and get the ads live.



What You Will Do



For each product launch, you will:



• Receive the approved video batch, primary text, headlines, product URL, and campaign instructions.

• Create or duplicate the required campaign and ad-set structure.

• Upload all approved video ads into Meta Ads Manager.

• Add the correct primary text, headline, CTA, product URL,
 Page, and Instagram account.

• Apply the correct budget, schedule, targeting, optimization event, and tracking information provided in the launch instructions.

• Follow our campaign, ad-set, and ad naming system.

• Check every ad before publishing to make sure the correct video, copy, headline, URL, CTA, and settings are attached.

• Publish or schedule the campaign at the requested time.

• Confirm that the ads are live, scheduled, or in review, and report any rejection or setup problem.

• Update our launch tracker when the work is complete.



Who We Need



You should have:



• Real hands-on experience uploading ads in Meta Ads Manager.

• Experience with ecommerce or Shopify campaigns.

• A clear understanding of campaigns, ad sets, ads, CBOs, budgets, schedules, pixels/events, URLs, Pages, and Instagram identities.

• Strong attention to detail. Uploading the wrong video, URL, copy, budget, or product is not acceptable.

• The ability to follow simple instructions and naming conventions exactly.

• Reliable availability, a stable internet connection, and clear English communication.

• The habit of asking a question when information is missing instead of guessing.



Do not apply if you have only boosted posts, have never built ads inside Ads Manager, or need basic Meta training.



Schedule and Compensation



This is intended to become a recurring, long-term role. Work will be part time to start but will very quickly become full time if you are good. Please state your weekly availability, preferred work schedule, expected monthly salary in USD, and earliest start date in your application.



How to Apply



Please send only the following:



1. A short explanation of your Meta Ads Manager experience.

2. The approximate number of ecommerce campaigns or ads you have uploaded.

3. A 2–3 minute Loom video showing a campaign you built or a safe demo account. Hide all private client or account information.

4. Your weekly availability, expected monthly salary in USD, and earliest start date.

5. Your internet speed and backup internet option.

6. Begin your application with the words META UPLOADER so we know you read the full post.

7. Your whatsapp number so we can reach out to you



Do not send a long generic application.



Strong applicants will complete a short test in which they receive a mock launch brief and upload a small batch of ads into a draft campaign. If the setup is accurate and communication is good, we can begin working together immediately.

title: VIDEO EDITOR, SHORT-FORM REELS (Remote · PHP & SA)
description:
Summary

WHO WE ARE

We're a small creator-management agency (Portugal HQ) that builds handmade brands for a tiny roster of creators. The founder works on every account. We're hiring our first dedicated editor for one flagship creator: a cozy homemaker lifestyle brand (warm home, garden, cooking, comfort) with a retro-gaming thread woven through it.





WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY EDIT

Instagram Reels (15 to 30s) for a warm domestic-lifestyle brand. Think lamp-lit rooms, cooking and garden moments, soft-spoken voiceover, a retro game paused on the TV in the background. Warm and cozy, but never slow or boring. Our editing style:



- 2-3s pacing rule - Something must happen every 2 to 3 seconds: a sound effect, a subtle zoom, a cut, a text pop, an on-screen detail. Micro-events keep retention high. The trick is doing this while the reel still FEELS calm and warm, not chaotic. Gentle movement, not zoom-punch spam.

- Optimal trimming - Tight cuts, no dead air, no wasted frames. Every clip trimmed to its best moment.

- Sound design as a core skill - Domestic texture (kettle, chopping, rain on the window, keyboard clicks) layered with retro game SFX accents and a whisper-register voice. You'll integrate sound effects constantly. Our audience recognizes the brand by sound in 3 seconds.

- Simple, clean transitions and effects - Smooth and purposeful. No flashy transition packs, no trend-chasing effects that fight the cozy vibe.

- Nostalgia-literate accents - You don't need to be a Nintendo expert. You'll work from our reference bank of era-correct sounds and visuals, and you'll learn why a 1998 chest-opening sound outperforms any trending audio for our audience.



You'll get a full style bible, hook templates, banned-elements list, and direct feedback from the founder. We want an editor who becomes THE voice of this brand's edit, not a gig-worker juggling 30 clients.





WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

- Some experience with short-form vertical content (Reels, Shorts, TikTok). Show us, don't tell us.

- Strong pacing instincts: you know how to keep a reel alive every 2 to 3 seconds without making it feel loud

- Clean audio mixing and confident sound-effect work. This brand lives and dies on sound.

- Solid color grading fundamentals (warm grades, skin tones)

- CapCut, Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve all welcome. We judge the output, not the software.

- A good laptop that can handle raw vertical footage and deliver on deadline

- Fluent written English. Feedback loops are async and fast.

- Reliable internet



Bonus points: you've edited cozy-lifestyle, cooking, home, or ASMR-adjacent content · you understand parasocial audiences · you grew up on PlayStation, Nintendo, or Sega · you've worked with creator brands before.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager (5-10 Years) | US and UK Clients | Excellent Spoken English | Full Time
description:
SENIOR CUSTOMER SUCCESS MANAGER

Full time | Remote, Philippines | US and UK client accounts



ABOUT ALBA TALENT



Alba Talent is a UK revenue architecture firm. We build the revenue systems that growing businesses in the US and the UK depend on, and we train and certify the people who run them.



You would work one book of accounts inside a single client business, full time. The same accounts month after month, so you get to know them.



We are hiring one Senior Customer Success Manager.



THE ROLE



You own a portfolio of client accounts from onboarding through to renewal. You are the primary relationship owner and the voice the client hears most often. Performance is measured on retention, account health and renewal outcomes. Not ticket volume.



This is a senior seat and you will be left to run it. You take your own calls and you make your own calls. You pull someone else in when the situation needs it.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Own a portfolio of client accounts across the full lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, expansion and renewal

- Lead client facing calls yourself: kickoffs, onboarding, scheduled check ins, quarterly business reviews, escalations and renewals

- Watch account health and step in early when engagement drops

- Take an at risk account and work the retention conversation through to an answer

- Handle an unhappy client without flinching, and settle it at your level where you can

- Open expansion conversations when an account is actually using what it already pays for

- Keep CRM records and account notes to a standard a colleague could pick up without a briefing

- Report on portfolio health honestly, including the accounts that are slipping



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



- Five to ten years in Customer Success, Account Management or a client facing role where you owned the commercial outcome. Support experience on its own will not meet the bar here.

- You have served US, UK or Australian clients, and you know how they talk and what they expect.

- Retention, escalation and renewal conversations are things you have run, not things you have read about.

- Credibility with founders, directors and VPs on a live call. You should be able to hold a position under pressure, and direct a difficult conversation rather than absorbing it.

- Excellent spoken English. Clear, neutral, easy to follow. This is most of the job.

- A major CRM such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho or GoHighLevel, plus the usual video and chat tools.



COMMUNICATION AND AUDIO STANDARDS



You will be on client calls every day. We assess audio quality as part of selection, and we have previously declined otherwise strong candidates on this basis alone. Please read this part before you apply.



- A dedicated USB or XLR headset or microphone. Not a laptop built in mic. Not wireless earbuds.

- A private, quiet room for the whole shift.

- Wired internet at 25 Mbps or better, plus a backup connection and a plan for when the power goes.

- A webcam you are happy to keep on.



ENGAGEMENT AND COMPENSATION



- Full time, forty hours per week, long term

- 1,000 to 1,200 USD per month, set by experience

- Paid twice monthly

- You need to cover US business hours, 9am to 6pm US Eastern. In practice this is a night shift in the Philippines, roughly 9pm to 6am.

- Two week paid trial at the full rate. If it works, the seat is permanent, and we would rather keep someone for years than rehire every twelve months.



SELECTION PROCESS



Everyone who works a client account for us completes our internal Customer Success certification before going live. It ends in a live assessed call: a retention conversation, an escalation, and an upsell. Candidates do fail it. Passing is what puts you in front of a client, and the credential is yours to keep.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send all four. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.



1. Start your reply with the word ORBIT, so we know you got to the end of this.



2. The hardest client account you have personally saved. What was going wrong, what you did, and how it ended. We are reading for judgement here, so a short paragraph is fine.



3. Your CV.



4. A voice recording of two to three minutes, answering this out loud:



   "A client tells you they are cancelling at the end of the month because they are not seeing value. Talk me through how you would run that call."



   Speak as you would on a client call. Do not read from a script and do not use an AI voice. Every recording gets listened to, and this is the part that carries the most weight.



   When you send the link, write it with the dots spelled out, for example: loom (dot) com slash share slash yourrecording. This job board removes standard web links.



Also tell us the monthly USD figure you are looking for within the range above, and your earliest available start date.



Every candidate who submits a complete application will receive a response.

title: Sales Outreach Lead Generator
description:
# Lead Generation & Appointment Setting Specialist



**Location:** Manila, Philippines

**Company:** BBSpro Services Inc.

**Reports To:** Sales Director / Management Team

**Employment Type:** Full-Time



## About BBSpro Services Inc.



BBSpro Services Inc. is a Western Canadian provider of commercial chemical, warewashing, draught beverage, and related service solutions. We work with restaurants, hospitality groups, hotels, food-service operators, and other commercial businesses.



We are looking for a **Lead Generation & Appointment Setting Specialist** based in Manila to support our Canadian sales team by identifying qualified prospective customers and arranging meetings for our local sales representatives.



This is primarily a **business development support role**. The successful candidate will be responsible for researching potential customers, building high-quality lead lists, obtaining internal approval before outreach, and then contacting approved prospects to secure qualified in-person sales meetings.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Lead Research & List Building



Research and identify prospective customers that fit BBSpro's target customer profile.



Target prospects may include:



* Restaurants and restaurant groups

* Hotels and hospitality operators

* Bars, pubs and breweries

* Commercial kitchens

* Food-service operators

* Senior living and institutional facilities

* Other businesses that may require commercial chemical, warewashing, sanitation, or draught services



For each prospect, collect and verify relevant information including:



* Company/business name

* Location

* Type of business

* Number of locations, where applicable

* Website

* Decision-maker name and title

* Phone number

*
 address

* LinkedIn profile, where available

* Existing supplier or relevant information, where reasonably identifiable

* Reason the prospect may be a good fit for BBSpro



**All lead lists must be submitted to the BBSpro team for review and approval before any prospect is contacted.**



### 2. Lead Approval Process



The specialist will maintain an organized pipeline of potential leads and submit new lead lists to BBSpro management or the sales team for approval.



The process will be:



**Step 1 – Research:** Identify and research potential customers.



**Step 2 – Submit:** Send the proposed lead list to BBSpro for review.



**Step 3 – Approval:** BBSpro will approve, reject, or provide feedback on the leads.



**Step 4 – Outreach:** Only approved leads may be contacted.



**Step 5 – Qualification:** Determine whether the prospect has a legitimate potential need for BBSpro's products or services.



**Step 6 – Meeting:** Schedule a qualified in-person meeting for the appropriate BBSpro sales representative.



The specialist must **not contact unapproved prospects**.



## Appointment Setting & Outreach



Once a lead has been approved, the specialist will contact the prospect through appropriate channels, including:



* Phone calls

*

* LinkedIn or other approved business channels

* Follow-up communications



The objective is **not simply to generate calls or send
s**. The objective is to create genuine sales opportunities and secure meetings with qualified decision-makers.



The specialist should be able to clearly and professionally introduce BBSpro, identify the appropriate decision-maker, understand the prospect's basic needs, and explain why a conversation with BBSpro may be valuable.



## What Is a Qualified Meeting?



A meeting should generally meet the following criteria:



* The company fits BBSpro's target customer profile.

* The meeting is with a decision-maker or meaningful influencer.

* The prospect has a potential need for one or more BBSpro products or services.

* The prospect understands the general purpose of the meeting.

* The prospect has agreed to meet with a BBSpro representative.

* The meeting has a confirmed date, time, location and contact person.



The goal is **quality over quantity**. Meetings should represent legitimate potential business opportunities rather than appointments booked simply to meet activity targets.



## CRM & Reporting



The specialist will be expected to maintain accurate records of:



* Leads researched

* Leads submitted for approval

* Approved/rejected leads

* Outreach attempts

* Conversations

* Follow-up dates

* Prospect feedback

* Meetings scheduled

* Meeting outcomes provided by the Canadian sales team



A weekly activity report should summarize the lead-generation and appointment-setting pipeline.



## Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Performance may be measured based on:



* Number of qualified leads researched

* Accuracy and completeness of lead information

* Percentage of submitted leads approved by BBSpro

* Contact rate on approved leads

* Qualified conversations generated

* Qualified meetings booked

* Meeting attendance/show rate

* Conversion of meetings into sales opportunities

* Quality and accuracy of CRM records



**Meeting quality and eventual sales pipeline generated will be more important than simply maximizing the number of meetings booked.**



## Qualifications



The ideal candidate will have:



* Previous experience in B2B lead generation, business development, appointment setting, inside sales, or sales development

* Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal

* Confidence speaking with business owners, managers, executives and other decision-makers

* Strong internet research and prospecting skills

* Experience using LinkedIn and other lead-generation tools

* Experience with CRM systems

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to follow a structured approval and sales process

* Strong organizational and follow-up skills

* Ability to work independently while coordinating with a Canadian-based sales team



Experience prospecting into the **restaurant, hospitality, food-service, commercial cleaning, chemical, equipment, or facilities-management industries** would be considered an asset.



## Working Hours



Because the position supports customers and sales representatives in Western Canada, the successful candidate must be comfortable working hours that provide reasonable overlap with **Pacific Time (Vancouver)**.



Some prospecting and appointment-setting activities may need to occur during Canadian business hours.



## What Success Looks Like



A successful Lead Generation & Appointment Setting Specialist will consistently provide BBSpro with a pipeline of well-researched prospects, follow the company's lead-approval process, professionally represent BBSpro during outreach, and generate qualified meetings that give our Canadian sales team a genuine opportunity to win new business.



The role is not measured simply by how many names are added to a spreadsheet or how many calls are made. **Success means creating qualified sales opportunities that can turn into long-term BBSpro customers.**

title: YouTube Video Editor — Software & Marketing (Long-Term)
description:
Hi, my name is Stepan and I run faceless YouTube channels reviewing online marketing and software tools. I am hiring a second long-term editor to work alongside my current one.



WHAT YOU DO



You get raw screen recordings, the voiceover audio, and the script. You turn them into a finished, high-quality video: captions, zooms, text callouts, effects, transitions, music, and our offer cards.



You do not record anything. You do not narrate. Someone else does that. Your job is purely the edit.



Most videos are 5-15 minute software tutorials and comparisons. Some are shorter 1-3 minute deal videos where I want heavier effects.



Around 4 finished videos per week.



THESE ARE MY VIDEOS — this is the standard



Best VPN 2026 (9:07) — 

Lovable Pricing (7:05) — 

UpPromote Tutorial (5:43) — 

Surfshark Coupon Code (1:33) — 



The first three are the level I want for tutorials. The last one is a short deal video — that is where I want maximum effects.



Look at how the screen recordings are cropped and placed on a coloured background, how the captions highlight keywords, and how the discount card appears several times. That is what I am buying.



PAY



$
/month for 20 hours a week, depending on your experience and how the test video goes.



Paid every 2 weeks by Wise. Reviewed at 3 months and 6 months. There is room to grow into full-time and higher pay if the work is strong — I already have one editor on those terms.



WHAT ELSE



Work your own daytime hours. No graveyard shift — I am in Europe.

Weekends off. Philippine holidays off. 13th month pay.

I pay for your tools, including CapCut Pro.

Performance bonuses when videos do well.



WHO I WANT



Strong editing in CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut

Comfortable with captions, text animation, zooms and motion graphics

Good eye for pacing — you know when a shot has been on screen too long

You follow a spec sheet exactly. This is not a creative-freedom role.

Reliable internet and a plan for brownouts

Thumbnail design is a plus, not required



WHO I DO NOT WANT



Wedding, cinematic or vlog editors. Different skill.

Anyone who needs a lot of revision rounds to get there.



HOW TO APPLY



I read every application that does all three. I skip the rest.



1. Start your message with the word STARLIGHT



2. Send 2-3 videos you personally edited that are closest to my examples above. Software, tech, marketing or educational content. Not a general showreel — I will not open one.



3. In 2-3 sentences: pick any ONE of my four videos above and tell me one specific thing you would edit differently, and why.



There is a paid test video ($30) before anything else. I never ask for unpaid work.

title: Facebook Community Engagement & Compliance Specialist
description:
Job Type

Full-time / Part-time (Flexible)



Remote



20–40 hours/week (negotiable)



About the Role

We are looking for a Community Engagement & Compliance Specialist to manage our
 presence. This is not a traditional social media marketing role focused on aggressive growth or paid advertising. Instead, your primary focus will be:



Community management – building and nurturing a legitimate, engaged community around educational content and harm-reduction topics.



Content moderation – ensuring all posts and comments comply with platform policies and internal guidelines.



Compliance – navigating
's strict content policies to keep our page and group safe from bans or flags.



This role requires someone who understands the regulatory and legal landscape of health-adjacent products and can operate within tight compliance boundaries.



Key Responsibilities

1. Content Creation & Reels Production

Short-form video production – create, edit, and publish
 Reels (15–60 seconds) and other short-form video content .



Graphic creation – design engaging graphics, carousels, and static posts using Canva or similar tools .



Content calendar – develop and maintain a content calendar aligned with educational and research-focused goals .



Content formats – produce a mix of:



Educational Reels (highest priority – Meta's algorithm favors video content) 



Carousel posts for educational comparisons 



Story ads and static posts



Post-production – basic video editing (CapCut, Canva, or similar tools) .



2. Community Management & Moderation

Review and approve/deny incoming member requests for private
 groups.



Review all pending posts daily. Approve positive, educational, and on-topic content .



Remove spam, self-promotion, rule violations, and content that makes unsubstantiated health claims .



Ensure negative posts, complaints, or discussions about illegal use are never approved publicly.



Respond to all comments, direct messages, and mentions within 24 hours on weekdays.



Respond to urgent inquiries within 24 hours on weekends .



Flag and escalate crisis situations (FDA announcements, legal changes, negative press) to leadership immediately.



3. Content Strategy & Scheduling

Create and maintain a social media content calendar aligned with educational and research-focused goals .



Schedule posts using Meta Business Suite .



Maintain a consistent posting cadence with:



Educational/value posts



Community engagement prompts



Regular community activities



Stay current with social media trends, platform updates, and best practices .



4. Compliance & Policy Navigation

Operate strictly within
's advertising and content policies .



Avoid any "black hat" techniques or content that could trigger health/fraud filters.



Ensure all published content is scientifically accurate and does not make unsubstantiated claims .



Adhere strictly to "research purposes only" framing.



Document moderation actions and compliance checks as required.



5. Reporting & Escalation

Assist in regular content performance reporting .



Track engagement, growth, and compliance metrics .



Report any compliance flags, platform warnings, or crisis situations to leadership immediately.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Weekly Reels published – at least 2–3 Reels per week 



100% of member requests reviewed within 24 hours



Daily moderation of all pending posts with zero spam or unresolved negative posts going live

title: Zoho Creator & Deluge Developer
description:
We are a growing wholesale distribution company in Texas looking for an experienced Zoho Creator developer to help complete a custom B2B customer portal called Pressley Connect.



The goal is to give our customers ONE easy-to-use portal where they can view products with their customer-specific negotiated pricing, place and repeat orders, view recently ordered and favorite products, request quotes, view order history and invoices, see balances, make payments, and manage their account.



The project has already been started. We currently have a Zoho Creator application connected to Zoho Inventory, including Inventory Items and Customers. We have also started workflows to identify the logged-in customer and retrieve their individual pricing.



We need someone to review what we've already built, fix or improve anything necessary, and complete the portal. The current application is called “Pressley Customer Ordering” and needs to be renamed/rebranded as Pressley Connect, as this will be a complete customer portal—not simply an ordering app.



Experience with Zoho Creator and Deluge is essential. Experience with Zoho Inventory, Zoho Books, APIs, integrations, customer portals, and price lists/price books is strongly preferred.



We are ready to start ASAP and want someone who communicates well, can explain their recommendations, and can move the project forward quickly.



This project also has the potential to become a long-term position with our company. Pressley Paper Co. is growing, and for the right person, we would like to continue the relationship after the portal is completed. Future work could include maintaining and improving our Zoho systems, automations, website/e-commerce updates, integrations, data management, reporting, technology projects, and other administrative or operational tasks based on the person's skills.



We are not simply looking for someone to complete one assignment—we would love to find a reliable, tech-savvy person who can learn our business and grow with our company long-term.



When applying, please tell us about your Zoho Creator/Deluge experience, similar projects you've completed, other technical/business skills you have, your availability, and your rate.

title: Playwright Automation Developer (Python) - Long Term
description:
Playwright Automation Developer (Python) — Long-Term Role



We're a US insurance company. Our platform gets insurance quotes automatically by logging into insurance carriers' websites and filling out their quote forms using Playwright and Python.



We're looking for a developer to own this work long-term.



What you'll do



Add new insurance carriers to our system by writing new Playwright automations — logging into their portal, navigating it, filling the quote form, and pulling the quote back

Keep the existing automations working when those websites change their layout or login process

Fix problems quickly when an automation stops working

Step in manually when an automation gets stuck, and push the quote through yourself

Improve the automation after each fix so the same problem doesn't happen again



What we need



At least 4 years of real Python development experience

You have used Playwright or Selenium to automate real websites that you don't own — logging in, filling forms, and getting data out. This is the most important requirement.

Experience with what goes wrong: websites changing, sessions expiring, timeouts, getting blocked

You know how to write code that retries and recovers instead of just failing

Good problem-solving — you can figure out why something broke, not just that it broke

You can make decisions on your own — when there's more than one way to solve something, you can pick one, explain why, and move forward without waiting to be told

You write clean, readable code that someone else on the team can understand and review

Good written English and reliable communication



Please read — what this role is, and isn't



This is hands-on coding with Playwright (Selenium or Puppeteer experience also works) against live websites we don't control. It is not a no-code or workflow-automation role — no Zapier, Make, n8n, or UiPath.



It's also different from software testing. If your Playwright or Selenium experience is writing tests for your own company's app, that's a valuable skill but a different kind of work than this. This role is about automating other companies' websites in production. When we talk, we'll ask about the specific projects where you've done that.



Nice to have



Experience getting around blocks: proxies, CAPTCHAs, user agents, saving sessions

title: Retained Legal Counsel
description:

Payment Terms: Direct via PayPal (USD / PHP equivalent) + 100% Reimbursed Expenses



Overview

Seeking a licensed, independent attorney or small firm based in or near Makati City to act as Counsel of Record for two active legal actions, alongside a separate monthly retainer for dedicated evidence gathering and field coordination.



Scope of Work

1. Primary Litigation Matters



Administrative Case: Drafting, signing, and prosecuting an Integrated Bar of the Philippines (IBP) Disbarment / Administrative Complaint before the Commission on Bar Discipline (CBD).



Criminal Case: Drafting, filing, and prosecuting a Criminal Complaint-Affidavit for Falsification of Public Documents / Notarial Misconduct (Fake/Unauthorized Notarizations) before the Office of the City Prosecutor.



2. Special Retainer Contract (Evidence & Document Gathering)



Guaranteed Allocation: 5 full working days per month dedicated exclusively to document retrieval, court/agency records requests, securing certified true copies, and field evidence collection.



Compensation & Fee Structure

Primary Litigation Acceptance Fee: $1,600.00 USD total (~₱93,000+ PHP) for taking EACH matters as Counsel of Record.



Monthly Evidence Retainer: $600.00 USD / month for the guaranteed 5 days of monthly field/retrieval work.  (This is a side contract for personal liason work.  I will send you to different places to collect my evidence 4 days a month and 1 day month to write affidavits).



Appearance Fee: $120.00 USD (~₱7,000 PHP) per official in-person or online court hearing, prosecutor's preliminary investigation, or formal IBP conference.



Pleading / Drafting Fee: $120.00 USD (~₱7,000 PHP) per major court pleading, formal reply, or formal position paper.



Formal Demand / Legal Letters: $70.00 USD (~₱4,000 PHP) per letter drafted and sent on firm letterhead.



Out-of-Pocket Expenses (OPE): 100% Reimbursed / Advanced. Filing fees, official records certification fees, printing, process service, messenger, and verified transport/kilometrage will be reimbursed immediately upon presentation of official receipts via PayPal.  (This includes photocopies, copying and I will only pay for outside copy and printing services).



Key Requirements

Bar Admission: Active Member of the Integrated Bar of the Philippines (IBP) in good standing.



Location: Based in or easily accessible to Makati City / Metro Manila for court filings and prosecutor appearances.



Counsel of Record: Candidate must sign all pleadings and formal filings as official counsel of record (No pro se mandates or liability-shifting clauses).



Payment Processing: Willingness to accept retainer payments and itemized invoice payouts via PayPal.

title: Senior Python Engineer / Architect - Long Term
description:
Senior Python Engineer / Architect — Long-Term Role



We're a US insurance company with a live platform called Insure Stack. It takes a customer's information and gets insurance quotes from many carriers at the same time — the goal is all quotes back in under 10 seconds.



Right now it doesn't work reliably. When a quote fails, someone on our team spends 1–2 hours fixing it by hand, and the same problems keep coming back. We believe the cause is in how the system is built, not how hard people are working.



We're looking for a senior Python engineer to take ownership of this — to figure out what's actually wrong architecturally and rebuild it so it works reliably. You'd be the most senior engineer on a small team, and you'd be writing code every week, not just directing.



What you'd work on



Figure out why quoting is slow and unreliable, and fix it at the architecture level

Make many carrier requests run in parallel and finish inside a strict time limit

Build proper error handling: timeouts, retries, and graceful failure instead of crashes

Add logging and tracing so problems can be diagnosed in minutes instead of hours

Make sure fixes are permanent — the system should learn, not repeat the same failures



What we need



8+ years of professional software engineering, with real ownership of system design

Strong Python, including async programming and concurrency (this is essential)

You've worked on a system where speed mattered and can explain how you made it faster

Experience with reliability: timeouts, retries, handling failures properly

You can take over an existing system that someone else built and improve it

Experience at a small company or startup where you owned real outcomes

You d
 trade-offs on your own — you can weigh doing it properly against doing it quickly, and stand behind the decision

You set the code-quality standard — your code is readable and reviewable, and you improve the code around you

Good written English and clear communication



Nice to have



Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Cloud Storage)

Experience with browser automation or web scraping

Insurance, fintech, or other regulated industry experience



The bar we hire against



We use AI coding tools a lot, and they handle plenty of routine work well. The person we hire needs to bring what those tools can't: strong judgment about what actually matters in a system, and enough ownership that we can hand over a whole area and trust it's in good hands.

title: Senior Video Editor & Motion Graphics Designer
description:
Senior Video Editor & Motion Graphics Designer

Full-time remote role for a serious, reliable video professional

Important: Please read before applying.

We receive many applications, but we will only review applicants who follow the application instructions at the end of this post. Generic messages, AI-only applications, and applicants who do not answer the required questions will not be considered.

Location: Philippines

Schedule: Full-time, aligned with U.S. Eastern Time

Compensation: USD 1,000-1,500/month, based on experience, portfolio quality, communication, and technical assessment

Role Type: Hands-on production role, not a management-only position

About Us

We are a growing company with two core activities: we provide global virtual employees for law firms, and we operate a marketing agency focused primarily on law firm marketing.

Our marketing team creates video, social media, branding, web, and performance-driven content for law firms and other professional-service businesses. We are looking for a senior video editor and motion graphics designer who is talented, organized, deadline-driven, and able to communicate clearly in a remote team.

This role is not only about making videos look good. We need someone who understands hooks, pacing, retention, captions, thumbnails, sound, platform behavior, and how video supports marketing goals.

What You Will Do

- Edit short-form and long-form videos, including reels, ads, testimonials, podcasts, webinars, educational videos, corporate videos, live clips, and social media campaigns.

- Create motion graphics, lower thirds, animated titles, branded visuals, thumbnails, captions, subtitles, transitions, and supporting design assets.

- Edit content for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, YouTube Shorts,
, Meta ads, and other paid or organic channels.

- Improve videos through pacing, story structure, sound design, color correction, color grading, audio cleanup, and platform-ready exports.

- Work with English, Spanish, and Arabic content using scripts, transcripts, subtitles, and review feedback. Fluency in Spanish or Arabic is preferred but not required.

- Use AI-assisted tools for transcription, cleanup, masking, rotoscoping, B-roll support, localization, upscaling, and workflow efficiency while keeping final work professional and natural.

- Support remote video production when needed by advising on framing, lighting, audio, screen recording, camera placement, and live video setup.

- Organize files, project assets, exports, versions, feedback, and delivery notes clearly.

Required Skills

- Senior-level video editing portfolio, ideally with 4+ years of hands-on experience or equivalent demonstrated work.

- Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects.

- Strong CapCut skills for short-form social videos, captions, templates, and platform-native edits.

- Strong Photoshop and Illustrator ability for thumbnails, layouts, graphics, masks, and branded assets.

- Strong motion design fundamentals: typography, timing, composition, keyframing, transitions, and visual hierarchy.

- Strong understanding of color correction, color grading, exposure, skin tones, audio cleanup, codecs, export settings, and platform deliverables.

- Strong social video judgment: hooks, retention, pacing, captions, thumbnails, CTAs, repurposing, and performance feedback.

- Working knowledge of AI-assisted creative tools and modern video workflows.

- Strong English communication for remote teamwork, written updates, questions, revisions, and deadline management.

- Reliable high-speed internet and a workstation capable of editing high-resolution video files.

- Availability for meaningful overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.

This Role Is a Strong Fit If You

- Take ownership from brief to final export.

- Communicate early when something is unclear or a deadline is at risk.

- Are organized with files, versions, feedback, and delivery notes.

- Can make serious professional-service content feel credible, modern, and engaging.

- Are comfortable receiving direct feedback and improving work quickly.

This Role Is Not a Fit If You

- You only know basic CapCut templates or simple social edits.

- You only know AI prompting but do not have strong traditional editing skills.

- You are entry-level and do not have a strong finished-work portfolio.

- You are looking only for a supervisor, creative director, or management role.

- You cannot reliably work with U.S. Eastern Time.

- You are slow to respond, miss deadlines, or struggle with written communication.

Practical Editing Assessment

Finalists may be asked to complete a practical editing task so we can evaluate editing judgment, technical ability, communication, and ability to follow direction.

The assessment is for evaluation only. We will not publish, sell, post, run as an ad, deliver to a client, or otherwise use a candidate’s assessment edit for commercial or company content. Candidates may add a visible watermark or sample label to the assessment output.

How to Apply

To be considered, send a message with the subject line:

SERIOUS VIDEO EDITOR - [Your Full Name]

In your application, answer all of the following:

1. Share your portfolio link with 3-5 of your strongest video editing samples.

2. Which sample best shows your motion graphics skill, and why?

3. Which sample best shows your social media editing skill, and why?

4. What tools do you use daily? Include Adobe, CapCut, AI tools, and any project/file management tools.

5. Confirm your expected monthly compensation in USD.

6. Confirm your availability during U.S. Eastern Time.

7. Share your computer specs and internet speed.

8. Are you comfortable editing English, Spanish, and Arabic videos using transcripts, subtitles, and review feedback?

9. In 3-5 sentences, explain why you are a strong fit for this role.

10. Write this exact sentence at the end of your application: I understand this is a full-time senior video editing role requiring strong communication, deadline ownership, and EST availability.

Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter - US Market
description:
JOB TITLE: B2B Appointment Setter (Cold Calling) - US Market



Company: Pulse Marketing Collective

Type: Part-time, 2 to 2.5 hours per day, Monday to Friday

Hours: Must work during 9am to 5pm US Eastern. No weekends.

Salary: Base hourly rate plus a bonus for every booked meeting that shows up



ABOUT US



Pulse Marketing Collective builds AI-powered outbound systems for B2B

companies in the US. You will be calling business owners to book short

introductory meetings with our team.



You are NOT selling anything on the phone. Your job is done the moment

the meeting is on the calendar.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will be given a clean list of business names and phone numbers, a

proven script, and access to every tool you need. From there:



- Work the list, get past gatekeepers, and reach the owner or decision

  maker

- Book qualified introductory meetings directly into our calendar

- Log every call outcome accurately in the CRM, including who you spoke

  to and what they said

- Send a short confirmation to every booked prospect and follow up to

  reduce no-shows

- Flag bad numbers, wrong contacts, and closed businesses so the list

  improves over time

- Report your numbers at the end of each day (dials, connects, meetings

  booked)





HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED



The daily target is 100 dials, which is 500 per week. But we judge you

on MEETINGS BOOKED, not dials.



To be direct: if you make 70 dials a day and book 15 meetings a week,

that is a better result than 120 dials a day and 5 meetings. We would

rather you slow down, get through to the right person, and have a real

conversation than rush through a list to hit a number.



The dial target is a floor for effort, not the thing you are graded on.



What does not work is low dials AND low meetings. If both are down, the

role is not working.





REQUIREMENTS



- Near-native spoken English with a neutral accent and no hesitation.

  You need to sound like a natural conversation to a US business owner,

  not like someone reading. This is the single most important

  requirement for this role.

- Ability to go off script. Gatekeepers ask unexpected questions and you

  must respond naturally in the moment.

- Proven track record of B2B cold calling into the US market and booking

  meetings. Be ready to discuss what industry you called, your connect

  and booking rates, and what worked.

- Comfortable with gatekeepers. Not aggressive, not apologetic. Calm and

  hard to brush off.

- Reliable fiber internet with a backup connection, a quiet home office,

  and a noise-cancelling headset. No background noise, no call center

  floor, no family in the room.

- Consistent availability during US Eastern business hours.

- Coachable. We record and review calls, give direct feedback, and

  expect you to apply it.





NICE TO HAVE



- Experience calling owner-operated small businesses rather than

  enterprise

- Familiarity with a CRM and a power dialer

- Experience in med spa, aesthetics, healthcare, or professional

  services





HOW TO APPLY



1. Send a short note about your US B2B cold calling background with real

   numbers. Start your message with the word "MIAMI" so we know you read

   this post.



2. Attach TWO voice recordings:

   - Recording 1: You reading a short cold call script, about 60

     seconds. We will send the script if you ask, or use one of your own.

   - Recording 2 (more important): Answer this unscripted in your own

     words, about 2 minutes. "Tell me about the hardest gatekeeper you

     ever got past and exactly what you said." No script. No

     preparation. Just talk.



   Applications without BOTH recordings will not be reviewed.



3. Shortlisted candidates do a live video call with us. Part interview,

   part live role play where we play a difficult gatekeeper.



4. Successful candidates start a PAID two-week trial on real dials

   before anything becomes ongoing.





WHAT YOU GET FROM US



- A clean, pre-built lead list. You never source your own numbers.

- A script that already works, plus objection handling.

- All software and phone systems paid for.

- Direct feedback on recorded calls so you actually improve.

- More hours and higher pay as your booking volume grows.

description:
## Business Manager / Director of Business Affairs & Finance



I’m looking for a senior, highly capable person who can act as a cross-functional right hand across several small businesses.



The role sits between finance, legal, operations, administration, and business strategy. It is not primarily a bookkeeping role or a traditional virtual assistant role.



### Core Responsibilities



**Finance & Accounting Oversight**



* Review bookkeeping and accounting across businesses

* Oversee billing, accounts receivable and accounts payable

* Review monthly P&Ls, balance sheets and cash flow

* Budgeting and financial forecasting

* Identify discrepancies, unusual expenses or financial issues

* Coordinate with outside accountants and tax professionals

* Potentially oversee junior bookkeeping/admin staff



**Contracts & Business Affairs**



* First-pass review of contracts and agreements

* Summarize key terms and identify business/legal issues

* Draft and revise routine commercial agreements

* Maintain organized contract records

* Track renewals, termination dates and important obligations

* Coordinate with US counsel when specialized legal advice is required

* Help prepare negotiation positions and deal terms



**Employee & Contractor Onboarding**



* Prepare and organize employment and contractor agreements

* Coordinate payroll setup and required documentation

* Maintain personnel files

* Handle confidentiality/IP documents

* Manage onboarding and offboarding processes across businesses



**Client Onboarding**



* Manage client engagement agreements

* Confirm scopes, retainers and payment terms

* Coordinate billing setup

* Maintain organized client files and contracts

* Track outstanding agreements, deposits and receivables



**Investor Administration**



* Manage investor onboarding and documentation

* Maintain Carta and cap tables

* Coordinate subscription agreements and signatures

* Track investment funding and closing status

* Maintain investor records

* Coordinate with attorneys and accountants on closings

* Assist with investor communications and reporting



**Entity & Compliance Management**



* Maintain a master record of all business entities

* Track ownership, EINs, operating agreements, bank accounts and tax status

* Monitor annual filings, licenses, insurance and other recurring obligations

* Maintain organized corporate records



**Business & Financial Advice**



* Help evaluate deals, investments and new business opportunities

* Financial modeling and scenario analysis

* Research business, financial and legal questions

* Identify risks before decisions are made

* Help determine when outside legal, tax or accounting specialists are needed

* Provide thoughtful recommendations rather than simply executing instructions



**Operations & Administration**



* Help build systems and processes across businesses

* Coordinate lawyers, accountants, insurance brokers, payroll providers and other professionals

* Maintain document organization and version control

* Create closing checklists, project trackers and recurring reporting

* Help manage and delegate work to junior administrative support



### Ideal Background



Ideally:



* CPA, accountant, lawyer, finance professional, or combination thereof

* Strong corporate/commercial contract experience

* Strong accounting and financial-analysis skills

* Experience supporting US businesses

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Comfortable working directly with business owners

* Very organized and detail-oriented

* Strong judgment and problem-solving ability

* Able to take an ambiguous problem and independently propose a solution

* Comfortable managing multiple businesses and projects simultaneously



This person does not need to replace US attorneys, accountants or other specialists. The goal is to have one senior person internally who understands the businesses, manages routine work, coordinates specialists, and knows when something needs to be escalated.

title: Virtual Assistant Property Manager (VAPM)
description:
About us:

EIG Property Management is based in Minneapolis, MN. We manage 1,400 apartment rental units in the Twin Cities. We are seeking a full-time remote Virtual Assistant Property Manager to join our great team! As a Virtual Assistant Property Manager, you will be the primary point of contact for our residents, answering calls, offering tenant support, supporting the on-the-ground property managers, and assisting with various administrative tasks.



The preferred candidate will be a go-getter, willing to work hard, learn new tasks, and be a dedicated and reliable team member. We are looking for one dedicated individual that can work 40-50 hours per week. Generally, the hours are Monday to Friday about 7AM to 5PM US Central. We are not looking for an agency or someone working another job during our business hours.



Responsibilities:

* Manage Lease Renewals: Train staff on how to perform renewals, monitor renewal status for various teams, draft renewal leases, send leases for electronic signature.

* Manage Delinquency: Train staff on how to perform delinquency, monitor delinquency status for various teams, submit eviction complaints to attorneys, coordinate eviction processes with attorney and property management teams.

*Inspection Management: Assign unit inspections to the PM teams, track inspection progress, compile results of inspections, ensure high quality, analyze performance.

* Maintain property and tenant records.

* Receive and return phone calls, texts and
s.

* Communicate with 3rd party stakeholders

* Coordinate activities to address high water usage

* Download data and complete data entry tasks.

* The above is not an exhaustive list.



Job Requirements

Excellent English speaking and writing ability.

Technology Requirements: strong consistent internet and electricity, 2 screens, 10-key on your keyboard, headset.

As this is a work-from-home setup, you must have a quiet working environment anytime you are clocked in for work.

US Central Time hours as scheduled, generally an 8-9 hour day Monday to Friday between 8AM and 5PM.



Qualifications:

Preferred 4-year university degree

Preferred previous experience in property management for at least 3 years

Preferred experience with Google Workspace, particularly with Google Sheets and/or MS Excel



Application Requirements

If you are interested in applying, please include the following in your job application submission:

1. A custom audio or video recording. Please take 1 to 4 minutes to share why you are interested in the position, or a quick summary of your experience and qualifications.

2. Confirmation that you are not an agency.

3. Attach a PDF of your resume.

4. Confirm that you plan to conduct the interview with the same quality of computer and equipment that you would bring to the job, including webcam, headset, strong computer. During the interview, you will need to be on video and you will need to share your desktop for a brief spreadsheet exercise.

title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
LEAD THE CREATIVE OPERATION. THEN HELP BUILD WHAT COMES NEXT.

Creative Production is the center of this role at the start. You will manage the editors, own the production system, raise the quality of the work, and make sure strong creative moves from brief to final asset without senior leadership having to manage every detail.



This is not a coordinator role. It is not a virtual-assistant role. We need a Marketing Operations Manager who can operate the day-to-day work and improve the system at the same time.



A NOTE FROM OUR CMO

Before applying, watch this short video from our CMO about the role, its expectations, and what success looks like:


/share/9cd974e7c8a848de8b84a4a992df4e45



Once Creative Production is stable and you have demonstrated the judgment, leadership, and capacity required, the role will expand into Social Media Operations. That second phase will include the team, publishing, community, creator, affiliate, and channel systems around the content.



Phase 2 is planned to begin 60–90 days after your start date. The exact timing will depend on demonstrated readiness and business needs.



ABOUT VERITAS

Veritas builds complete Starlink Mini deployment setups—mounts, power, cables, cases, and accessories—for consumers, work teams, and government fleets.



We are a growing US company with a small, high-output marketing team in the Philippines. Several team members have grown with the company over the long term. We want the same for this role.



THE DETAILS

• Full-time independent contractor role with fixed monthly compensation of $2,000–$2,500 USD, based on experience, leadership depth, and overall fit—not an hourly position

• Approximately 45–50 hours per week, with the regular work schedule fully aligned with Pacific Time

• Philippine graveyard shift: roughly 11:00 PM–8:00 AM or 12:00 AM–9:00 AM, depending on U.S. daylight saving time

• Fully remote and long-term

• This must be your only job. No part-time employment, side hustles, ongoing freelance clients, or subcontracting

• Occasional weekend availability when production, launches, or publishing require management coverage

• Metro Manila, Rizal, Bulacan, Cavite, or Laguna required; no regular onsite office days, but occasional in-person meetings may be scheduled



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

At full production, the team aims to produce one long-form video and up to 14 supporting creative assets each week. These may include shorts/reels, static graphics, or carousels and are adapted for distribution across
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X.



PHASE 1: LEAD CREATIVE PRODUCTION

• Manage a two-person video-editing team, including their priorities, workload, deadlines, coverage, development, and performance.

• Turn approved priorities into clear production plans, briefs, scripts, storytelling direction, B-roll needs, and deliverables.

• Own the production pipeline: capacity, assignments, dependencies, revisions, blockers, asset readiness, and delivery visibility.

• Review short-form, long-form, ads, thumbnails, static assets, carousels, platform versions, and other creative output.

• Evaluate the full story—not only whether one shot matches one line. Check hooks, pacing, B-roll, demonstrations, captions, CTAs, factual accuracy, brand alignment, and viewer flow.

• Give editors clear, prioritized, actionable feedback and verify that required revisions were completed correctly.

• Use performance findings to identify stronger hooks, packaging, formats, V2/V3 opportunities, and creative tests.

• Build and improve SOPs, review standards, production trackers, asset repositories, AI-assisted QA, and backup coverage.

• Coordinate minor corrections and urgent production support when needed, without turning the role into a primary editing position.



PHASE 2: ADD SOCIAL MEDIA OPERATIONS

Phase 2 is planned to begin 60–90 days after your start date, once Phase 1 is operating reliably and you have demonstrated readiness for the expanded scope. At that point, you will also:

• Manage the current Social Media Moderator and future social media team members.

• Own the publishing calendar, content inventory, platform schedules, launch pushes, and publishing verification across
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X.

• Ensure each platform receives the correct version, copy, CTA, description, tags, products, related content, links, and native-platform setup.

• Oversee community, marketing inboxes, important comments and messages, channel presentation, and routine reputation handling.

• Manage routine creator-partnership and affiliate operations, including communication, records, deliverables, logistics, and escalation.

• Own routine UTM, Bitly, campaign-link, profile-link, and destination-verification workflows.

• Review social performance and turn findings into decisions, tests, and coordinated creative recommendations.

• Build and maintain the social department’s processes, AI workflows, reporting, and continuity systems.



HOW THE ROLE FITS

You will report to and work closely with senior marketing leadership. In Phase 1, the video editors report to you. In Phase 2, the Social Media Moderator also reports to you.



You will have authority over routine departmental planning, assignments, quality, coaching, corrections, and process improvements within approved standards. Cross-functional, sensitive, contractual, financial, policy, staffing, reputation, and other material decisions remain with senior leadership.



HOW WE USE AI

Our marketing operation uses AI for context, research, briefs, feedback, quality control, documentation, analysis, automation, and institutional memory.



We want someone who uses AI heavily to improve judgment and execution—not someone who accepts raw output. Sources must be checked. Brand and product accuracy must be protected. What the team learns should improve the next workflow.



YOU'RE A STRONG FIT IF YOU

• Have at least eight years of professional work experience.

• Have at least three years managing teams and direct reports.

• Have at least two years of experience inside a creative or marketing function.

• Have meaningful corporate, in-house, agency, or field-based operating experience—not only freelance, VA, or task-based remote experience.

• Have managed a creative-production pipeline and can explain the team size, volume, process, problems, decisions, and results.

• Are exceptionally strong at storytelling and can diagnose why an edit is technically correct but still wrong for the overall story.

• Hands-on video-editing experience is an advantage, but it is not required. You must be able to direct editors, evaluate their work, and clearly explain what needs to change and why.

• Can coach editors, address recurring mistakes, manage underperformance, and maintain accountability without becoming the bottleneck.

• Take action without waiting for step-by-step direction and consistently look for ways to improve quality, speed, visibility, and continuity.

• Use performance evidence to improve creative work—not only report numbers.

• Use AI daily with structured context, validation, human review, reusable systems, and feedback loops.

• Communicate clearly in conversational American English.

• Can sustain a Philippine graveyard schedule and occasional weekend coverage.

• Reside in Metro Manila, Rizal, Bulacan, Cavite, or Laguna and be willing to attend occasional in-person meetings.

• Have reliable primary internet, a backup connection, and backup power.

• Want one company to grow with for the long term.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

• Someone who waits for detailed instructions before acting.

• Someone whose experience is limited to task-based VA work, short freelance engagements, or managing multiple clients.

• A strong individual contributor who does not want to manage, coach, and hold people accountable.

• Someone who reviews only technical editing details but cannot evaluate the complete story and business goal.

• Someone who creates more process without improving output, visibility, quality, or results.

• Someone planning to keep another job, freelance clients, or subcontract any part of the work.

• Someone testing a graveyard schedule for the first time without a credible plan to sustain it.



HOW WE WORK

Clear priorities. Direct feedback. Strong ownership. Problems are raised early. Decisions are documented. The goal is not to look busy. The goal is to build work that performs and an operation that improves.



Our brand voice follows the same standard: short words, short sentences, confident but never salesy. Like a friend who knows the gear.



HOW TO APPLY

Use this subject line and at least 20 AP:

[INSERT REQUIRED WORD] - [X] years of professional experience - [X] years managing teams



Include the following:

• Your resume with company names, employment dates, role titles, team sizes, and whether each role was corporate, in-house, agency, freelance, or VA work.

• Have you directly managed a creative-production or video-production team? Answer Yes or No. If yes, state the team size.

• Can you provide examples of videos, campaigns, or creative projects you directly led if you advance to the next stage? Answer Yes or No. Do not send links or detailed explanations at this stage.

• In one short logistics block, confirm that this would be your only job and that you would complete all work personally. Include your city or province, most recent U.S.-hours role and actual schedule, primary and backup internet, backup power, and occasional weekend availability.



Note: Applications missing any requirement will not be considered.

title: 3D Rendering Specialist & Packaging Designer (Beauty / Cosmetics)
description:
Important Application Instructions:



Do NOT just send a generic application. To ensure you have read this entire post and have the attention to detail we need, you must follow the specific instructions at the bottom of this page.



About Us:

We are Rude Cosmetics. We believe makeup is a tool of self-expression, and our brand is built on being bold, edgy, and completely unapologetic. We are looking for a hybrid 3D Artist and Graphic Designer who can conceptualize our packaging and bring it to life on screen.



The Role:

This is a dual-purpose role for a true visual powerhouse. We need someone who can design the flat 2D artwork for our cutting-edge makeup products AND build photorealistic 3D models, renders, and short 3D videos of those products for our marketing campaigns and e-commerce store.



To see the exact caliber of 3D animation and rendering quality we are looking for, please review this reference: 
==



Key Responsibilities:

• 3D Rendering & Animation: Build highly accurate 3D models of our cosmetics components (palettes, lipstick tubes, skincare bottles). Create photorealistic static images and dynamic 3D videos (product spins, floating elements, texture reveals) matching the quality of the reference link above.

• Creative Packaging Design: Conceptualize bold, Gen-Z trend-aligned 2D artwork for new product lines.

• Dieline Layout: Apply your 2D packaging designs cleanly onto flat dieline templates provided by our production team.

• Marketing Assets: Render final 3D assets to be used across our website, social media, and digital advertising.



Requirements:

• 3D Software Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in 3D modeling and rendering software (e.g., Blender, Cinema 4D, Maya, or Keyshot).

• 2D Design Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop for the packaging artwork.

• Lighting & Texturing: A deep understanding of how to light 3D scenes and apply realistic textures (metallics, gloss, matte, powder finishes) specifically for beauty/CPG products.

• Portfolio: You must provide a portfolio that showcases BOTH your 3D product renders/animations AND your 2D packaging/graphic design work.



Working Hours & Pay:

• Schedule: We can be somewhat flexible with working hours for the right candidate, but you must have some daily overlap with Los Angeles morning time (PST/PDT) for quick communication and feedback.

• Hours: This is a long-term, part-time role (20 hours per week) with the potential to grow based on performance.

• Pay: $5.00 to $7.00 per hour, depending entirely on the quality of your 3D rendering portfolio and packaging experience.



How to Apply (READ CAREFULLY):

We are looking for someone with a sharp eye for detail. To prove you have read this entire job post, you must do the following:



1. Make the subject line of your message EXACTLY: 3D RUDE DESIGN

2. Send us a message here on OnlineJobs with a direct link to your portfolio.

3. In your message, point us directly to one specific example of a 3D product render/video you have done, and one specific example of a 2D packaging design you have done.



Do not send a long, generic cover letter. Just the secret word and your targeted portfolio links! If your aesthetic is a match, we will reply with the next steps.
