title: Aesthetic Nurse – Piercing Specialist (Onsite / Cruise Line)
description:
Contact Marketers is recruiting a licensed Nurse Practitioner (NP) based in the Philippines to join an international cruise line client in an onsite role aboard their global fleet. This unique position blends clinical nursing expertise with hands-on ear and body piercing experience to provide high-standard piercing services, maintain strict hygiene standards, and deliver exceptional guest care at sea. It is a ideal fit for a PRC-licensed nurse ready to apply their clinical background in a dynamic, aesthetics-focused retail and guest services environment onboard.



**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**



* **Onboard Piercing Services:** Perform professional ear piercing and body piercing procedures for cruise guests following strict clinical safety and aesthetics standards.

* **Sterilization & Infection Control:** Maintain a sterile environment, manage clinical equipment, and execute proper infection prevention and sanitation protocols.

* **Guest Consultations & Aftercare:** Provide personalized pre-procedure consultations, evaluate contraindications, and deliver comprehensive post-piercing aftercare instructions to guests.

* **Clinical Documentation:** Maintain accurate, confidential records of all client consultations, procedures, and consent forms in alignment with cruise line standards.

* **I
 Management:** Handle minor post-procedure complications or localized reactions expertly, referring guests to the ship's medical center if necessary.

* **Team & Operations Support:** Collaborate with the shipboard spa, retail, and medical teams to ensure seamless daily operations and inventory management.



**REQUIREMENTS**



* **Licensure:** Licensed Registered Nurse (RN) in the Philippines, PRC-registered and in good standing.

* **Practical Experience:** Proven, hands-on experience performing ear or body piercings in a clinical, medspa, aesthetics, or professional piercing studio setting.

* **Clinical Skills:** Deep working knowledge of sterilization, bloodborne pathogens, aseptic technique, and aftercare management.

* **Travel Readiness:** Willing and eligible to live and work onboard international cruise ships for the duration of assigned sea contracts (valid passport and ability to secure maritime visas/C1/D).

* **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written English communication skills for guest-facing interactions in a multicultural environment.



**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**



* Prior experience in medical aesthetics, wellness, hospitality, or previous shipboard/cruise line roles.

* Familiarity with international health and safety protocols (such as USPH standards).

* Confident, outgoing demeanor with a high focus on guest service and satisfaction.

title: TikTok Shop Affiliate Manager — DracoSlides
description:
**TikTok Shop Affiliate Manager — DracoSlides**



**About the Brand**



DracoSlides is a premium comfort slides brand based in North America. We sell on TikTok Shop and are growing fast. Our slides feature a suede memory foam insole, adjustable velcro straps, and a streetwear-first aesthetic. Think socks with slides, baggy fits, and the kind of product people actually want to show off.



**The Role**



We need someone to own our TikTok Shop affiliate program end to end. This is a remote, full-time position. You'll be the person finding creators, reviewing their profiles, reaching out to them, managing samples, sourcing TikTok Live sellers, and making sure affiliates are actually posting and converting.



**What You'll Do**



- Search TikTok Shop's creator marketplace and find affiliates who fit our brand (streetwear, sneaker culture, lifestyle, men's fashion)

- Review creator profiles using Cruva — check GMV history, video performance, follower quality, and brand fit before approving sample requests

- Send outreach messages to qualified creators and follow up with affiliates who ghosted after receiving samples

- Source and recruit creators specifically for TikTok Live selling — we generate strong revenue from livestreams and need people who can actually sell on camera

- Stay on top of TikTok trends and proactively suggest video formats, hooks, and content angles that will work for our product

- Track affiliate performance weekly and escalate top performers for paid partnerships or higher commissions

- Manage the full sample request queue — approve, reject, or message creators based on their profile



**What We're Looking For**



- Hands-on experience with Cruva (required — this is our primary tool for managing affiliates)

- Experience with TikTok Shop seller tools (creator marketplace, sample requests, Seller Center)

- Strong eye for content — you should be able to watch a creator's recent videos and quickly assess whether they can move product

- Experience sourcing or managing TikTok Live sellers is a strong plus

- Solid English writing for creator outreach and follow-ups

- Self-directed and organized — you'll be managing a daily queue without someone micromanaging you

- Bonus: familiar with Claude AI or other AI tools for outreach and research



**Compensation**



- Fixed monthly rate (discussed based on experience)

- Performance bonus tied to affiliate GMV



**Hours**



Full-time



---



**To Apply — Complete Both Tasks First**



Applications without these will not be reviewed.



---



**Task 1: Diagnose These Affiliates**



Below are three real affiliates from our TikTok Shop. Tell us what you see and exactly what you would do.



Affiliate 1: @ejwayy

- 520,000 followers

- Average video views: 42,385

- Videos posted for us: 2

- Total brand GMV generated: $8,430

- Platform-wide GMV (last 30 days): $4,835

- Status: Has not posted in a long time



Affiliate 2: @brackxtt

- 18,000 followers (fast growing)

- Videos posted for us: 44 | Lives: 3

- Total brand GMV: $15,599

- Platform-wide GMV (last 30 days): $54,530

- Content quality score: 91/100

- Status: Requested a new sample over a month ago. Never posted after receiving it.



**Affiliate 

- 36,000 followers (fast growing)

- Videos posted for us: 158

- Total brand GMV: $7,543 (~$47 per video)

- Platform-wide GMV (last 30 days): $84,830

- Content quality score: 95/100

- Average video views: 735

- Status: Posts consistently but barely converts



For each affiliate, answer:



1. What's actually going on here? Give us your honest read on the situation.

2. What would you do next? Be specific — not "follow up," but what you'd actually do and why.

3. Write the exact message you'd send them right now.



---



**Task 2: Find Us 5 Affiliates**



Go to TikTok Shop's creator marketplace or use Cruva and find 5 creators you would actually recruit for DracoSlides right now.



For each one, give us:

1. Their TikTok handle

2. Follower count and average views

3. One sentence on why you think they're a fit



---



Paste everything directly in your application. No cover letter needed. Just these two tasks.

title: B2B Printing Services - Cold Caller / Appointment Setter
description:
About the Role



The Print Company is a Toronto-based commercial printing company helping multi-location organizations across Canada with all their printing needs - from branded merchandise to strategic print planning. We're looking for a full-time cold caller / appointment setter to help us connect with decision-makers ahead of our year-end campaign.



This is a relationship-first outbound role - not a high-pressure sales position. Your job is to confidently open professional conversations with decision-makers, introduce our services, identify potential fit, and book short discovery calls with our team. We value genuine, professional conversations over aggressive tactics or call volume for its own sake.



What You'll Do



- Make outbound calls to Directors+ decision-makers at multi-location organizations across Canada

- Use a provided call script and talking points, adapting naturally in conversation

- Introduce The Print Company's printing services and capabilities

- Log every call and contact outcome accurately

- Book qualified appointments for our team's discovery calls

- Follow a structured follow-up cadence for prospects who aren't ready yet

- Report regularly on calls made, conversations had, and appointments booked



What We're Looking For



- Excellent spoken English - clear, natural conversational fluency; this is a phone-first role

- Prior experience in cold-calling or appointment-setting, ideally B2B

- Comfortable speaking with business decision-makers and able to build rapport quickly

- Organized - comfortable logging calls and keeping records accurate and up to date

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet space to make calls

- Able to work full-time hours overlapping with Eastern Time (Canada) business hours



What We Offer



- Stable, full-time remote role

- Clear instructions and structured workflows

- Long-term opportunity with a growing print company

- Professional, respectful working environment



How to Apply



Please include:



1. A short introduction, resume, and relevant files

2. A short voice recording introducing yourself (this helps us assess spoken English fluency, since this is a phone-first role)

3. Your relevant cold-calling or B2B outreach experience

4. How many calls you can realistically make in a day

5. What your ideal workflow and tech stack look like

6. Your expected monthly salary

7. Confirmation of availability for EST hours

description:
We’re hiring an experienced Digital Marketing Specialist to manage a small portfolio of client accounts across Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, and website management.



You’ll work closely with our Account Manager and take responsibility for the day-to-day management, execution, and optimization of client campaigns and websites.



Responsibilities

Create, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns

Set up, manage, and improve Meta/Facebook Ads campaigns

Track campaign budgets, performance, conversions, and ROAS

Conduct keyword and competitor research using Semrush

Manage ongoing SEO improvements and optimization

Find opportunities to increase website traffic, leads, and conversions

Make website updates, changes, and improvements when required

Work with websites built on WordPress, Shopify, Wix, and similar platforms

Manage assigned tasks and ensure projects stay on schedule

Identify and communicate issues or decisions that need attention early

Prepare monthly campaign and performance reports

Provide clear explanations of results, changes made, and recommended next steps

Collaborate with the Account Manager on priorities, strategy, and execution

What We’re Looking For



You should have practical, hands-on experience with:



Google Ads

Meta Ads

SEO

Semrush or similar SEO and research tools

WordPress

Shopify

Wix

Website editing and general website management

Keyword and competitor research

Campaign optimization

Performance monitoring and reporting

Project and task management systems



We’re looking for someone who is confident working across multiple areas of digital marketing, including paid advertising, SEO, website management, and campaign performance, rather than someone focused on only one specialty.



This is NOT a sales position. Your primary focus will be managing client work and delivering measurable results.



You should be comfortable taking ownership of your responsibilities, following established strategies, solving problems independently, making recommendations, and completing tasks without needing constant reminders or follow-ups.



Most communication will be handled asynchronously through chat and task comments, with short check-in calls scheduled when necessary.



IMPORTANT: PORTFOLIO REQUIRED



A portfolio is required when submitting your application.



Please provide real examples of projects or campaigns you have personally worked on, particularly involving Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, WordPress, Shopify, Wix, or other website-related projects.

How many years of experience do you have in digital marketing?

Have you managed multiple client accounts at the same time?

Which SEO, analytics, and reporting tools do you currently use?

Please provide a link to your portfolio.

We currently are small editing team, and now we're adding one more experienced editor.

-Shorts,

-Meta ad creatives,

-B2B/dealer videos,

-Interviews with Customers,

-VSL videos,

-Explanations videos,

-Product videos, 

-Assembly videos



and everything that will help company to grow!



What we need from you:

title: Growth & Outbound Operations Specialist (LinkedIn) — Part-Time
description:
Growth & Outbound Operations Specialist (LinkedIn) — Part-Time, Remote



Caldera Revenue Advisory | Premium Retention Analytics for Shopify DTC Brands



---



Why This Role Exists



Caldera Revenue Advisory (CRA) helps £1M–£10M Shopify DTC brands find the six-figure revenue leaking out of their customer base — the churn, the ghost customers, the cohorts quietly decaying that founders never see in their headline growth numbers.



Our approach is built on the kind of enterprise-grade data analysis you’d expect from a $1B+ retailer. Before founding CRA, our Founder analyzed customer data at scale for AS Watson Group, the world’s largest health & beauty retailer, and now applies that same rigor to ambitious, founder-led e-commerce brands.



We have a proven analytical product, a repeatable outreach framework, and real client results. What we need now is an operator who can own the outbound engine that fills our pipeline. Someone who executes daily, tracks everything, and treats a KPI target like a personal scoreboard.



This is not a “post and forget” VA job. You will work directly with the Founder on work that visibly moves revenue. If you want to master a real outbound skill set, be trusted with real ownership, and grow alongside a business from its early stage — read on.



---



Core Responsibilities



1. ICP Engagement & Outbound Comment Campaigns



- Monitor a defined list of target accounts daily — Shopify DTC Founders, E-commerce Directors, and CMOs.

- Post thoughtful, high-value, non-spammy comments on their content using our brand voice and comment framework, designed to drive profile views and connection requests (not empty engagement).

- Track which comments generate connection requests or profile visits, so we know what’s working.



2. Outbound Messaging & Lead Execution



- Send tailored opener messages to newly accepted connections, following our strict DM SOP (structure, tone, sequencing).

- Manage structured follow-up sequences for non-responders, on schedule, without being chased.

- Flag any reply that shows genuine interest immediately, speed matters here.



3. Pipeline Tracking & KPI Ownership



- Log and update daily metrics: connection acceptance rate, reply rate, and follow-up status.

- Own our Target KPI of a 25% reply rate — you are expected to notice when numbers slip and flag it, not just record it.

- Keep the CRM / pipeline tracker 100% accurate, every single day — no backfilling once a week.



---



Who You Are



Non-negotiables:

- C1 or near-native written English — flawless grammar, natural tone, and the ability to sound like a sharp human, not a template. This will be checked closely.

- Proven experience with LinkedIn outbound, lead generation, or social media management — ideally for a Western agency or consultancy serving DTC e-commerce or B2B clients.

- High proficiency in Google Sheets/Excel for daily metrics tracking.

- Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet dedicated workspace, and genuinely high attention to detail.



You’ll thrive here if you:

- Take pride in following a system precisely rather than “improving” it without asking.

- Treat a KPI target as something you’re accountable for, not just a number to report.

- Want a long-term role with more ownership as the business grows.

- Communicate proactively when something’s off, blocked, or not working.



---



Compensation & Working Hours



- Rate: $5.00/hour

- Hours: Part-time to start (1 hrs/day) Transitioning to more hours as Caldera scales

- Start: ASAP

- Type: Long-term, with room to grow into a broader operations role as Caldera scales



---



How to Apply — Read Carefully



We receive a high volume of copy-paste applications. This step exists to filter for people who actually read this job post. Applications that skip it will not be reviewed, regardless of experience.



1. Complete the screening form here: 

2. In the subject line of your application (or the form’s identifying field), include the keyword: `REVENUE`



Generic applications, or ones missing the keyword, will be filtered out automatically. If you follow these instructions precisely, you’ve already shown us the attention to detail this role requires. That’s exactly what we’re looking for.

title: Pre-Sales Quoting and Solutions
description:
Virtuas is a Certified B Corp on a mission to make the world a better place through technology. We strive to meet the highest standards of integrity and transparency while offering innovative technology-driven solutions to our clients.



This is a "backend" role with no customer-facing responsibilities. It is a role that interacts with our internal teams to configure ideal technology solutions for our clients, and to leverage the CRM tools to issue quotes and proposals so that they can be sent out by our sales team.



RESPONSIBILITIES



•  Distributor and Manufacturer Liaison: Develop relationships and knowledge about our vendors' and distributors' IT services and products.

• Quote Generation: Work with sales team to gather requirements and then use technical and product knowledge to prepare quotes and proposals for clients, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery.

• Order Management: Provide clean handoff to purchasing team after approvals, as it relates to quoting and procurement of IT hardware and software, as well as to consulting team for project services.

• Sales Support: Collaborate with the technical teams to build out configurations and solutions for customers.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND ATTRIBUTES



We're an IT company, so your technical skills must be sharp. You should know the Microsoft 365 ecosystem: Teams, Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.



You must be EXTREMELY detail-oriented, because there is financial risk if mistakes are made on a quote. If you apply, please put "magnifying-lens" in your message subject to show your attention to detail.



• Ability to type minimum of 50 wpm.

 and perform an internet speed test. Post your results for both upload speed and download speed.

title: BIM Coordinator – Fire Alarm & Low Voltage Systems
description:
ABOUT US

Industrial Electronic Systems, Inc. (IES) is a U.S.-based fire alarm and life safety company serving commercial clients across Northern California. We design, install, and integrate fire alarm and low voltage systems for real construction projects — hospitals, office buildings, warehouses, and more.

We're a small, technical team and we take our work seriously. When you work with IES, your drawings go straight into active construction projects.



THE ENGAGEMENT

We're looking for a full-time independent contractor to provide Remote BIM Coordination support to our U.S. engineering team on an ongoing basis. The core of this contract is BIM coordination and clash detection — you'll be working inside live Revit models, identifying and resolving clashes between fire alarm/low voltage systems and other trades (mechanical, structural, electrical).

This is a hands-on technical contract. Deliverables go directly into active U.S. commercial construction projects.



SCOPE OF WORK

BIM Coordination (Primary Focus)



Run clash detection between MEP, fire alarm, and structural models

Resolve clashes and coordinate solutions with the IES engineering team

Maintain and update Revit models for fire alarm and low voltage systems

Produce coordination drawings and clash reports for project teams



CAD Drafting & Documentation



Draft 2D construction drawings in AutoCAD — device layouts, riser diagrams, wiring details, and submittal sets

Set up sheets, title blocks, viewports, layers, and XREFs to IES standards

Update drawings based on field markups and design changes



Design Support



Assist with NFPA-compliant fire alarm device layout (spacing, coverage, strobe placement)

Support design of access control, intrusion, and structured cabling systems

Review architectural and electrical drawings to catch coordination issues early



Research & Problem Solving



Research NFPA 72, NEC, and local AHJ code requirements

Flag missing information in plans before they turn into RFIs

Document findings clearly and communicate impacts to the IES engineering team

title: SEO Specialist / SEO Manager
description:
*************Only candidates who submit an introduction video will be considered.***************



Kitchen & Bath Authority has been serving the home improvement industry for over 23 years. As we continue to grow our digital presence, we are looking for a results-driven SEO Specialist / SEO Manager with hands-on experience in modern search, backlink acquisition, content strategy, and AI-driven optimization.



This is a full-time position with some scheduling flexibility. Core availability and reliable communication are expected during agreed-upon working hours, but we are open to accommodating your time zone on certain days of the week.



This role is ideal for someone who can both execute SEO initiatives independently and take ownership of projects, priorities, and potentially other team members or external partners as our digital team continues to grow.



What You'll Do



• Manage and improve on-page SEO across product, category, and content pages, including title tags, meta descriptions, heading structure, internal linking, schema markup, and content optimization



• Develop and execute backlink acquisition strategies through outreach, editorial placements, guest posting, partnerships, and digital PR



• Optimize content and site structure for emerging AI-powered search experiences, including AI Overviews (AIO), generative search surfaces, and image/search optimization opportunities



• Conduct keyword research and competitive analysis across our kitchen, bath, lighting, and home improvement product categories



• Plan, assign, review, and optimize SEO-focused blog and landing-page content; AI writing tools are welcome, but strong human editing, fact-checking, and optimization are required



• Identify technical SEO issues and work with developers or internal team members to prioritize and implement improvements



• Monitor rankings, organic traffic, conversions, backlink growth, and other key SEO KPIs using GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, SEMrush, and related tools



• Prepare clear monthly performance reports and translate SEO data into actionable recommendations



• Take ownership of SEO priorities, timelines, and deliverables while helping coordinate writers, developers, freelancers, agencies, or other digital team members when necessary



• Help establish SEO processes, documentation, quality standards, and best practices as the department grows



Requirements



• Minimum 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably in e-commerce



• Demonstrated ability to manage SEO projects from strategy through execution and reporting



• Some managerial, team-lead, project-management, or vendor-management experience preferred



• Must submit at least 2 case studies or documented examples of past SEO success showing where you started, what actions you took, and the measurable results



• Proven backlink acquisition experience with a clear and repeatable outreach process



• Working knowledge of AI-powered search optimization, structured data, and emerging search experiences



• Proficiency with Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs and/or SEMrush, and technical SEO auditing tools



• Strong understanding of on-page SEO, internal linking, keyword strategy, content optimization, and technical SEO fundamentals



• Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, meet deadlines, and clearly communicate results and recommendations



• Strong written and verbal English communication skills



Nice to Have



• Experience in home improvement, kitchen and bath, lighting, furniture, or home décor e-commerce



• Experience managing writers, SEO contractors, outreach specialists, or other digital marketing team members



• Basic HTML/CSS knowledge



• Experience with large e-commerce catalogs and product/category-page optimization



Compensation & Benefits



• Full-time position



• Paid Time Off (PTO)



• Paid U.S. holidays



• Scheduling flexibility with agreed-upon core availability



• Potential flexibility to accommodate your local time zone on certain days of the week



• Opportunity to take on greater ownership and managerial responsibility as the digital team grows



To Apply



Please send:



• Your resume



• At least 2 SEO case studies or documented examples of measurable SEO results



• A brief introduction video telling us about yourself, your SEO experience, and why you believe you would be a strong fit for this role



Only candidates who submit an introduction video will be considered.



Bonus points if you also include a Loom walkthrough of a site audit, SEO project, backlink campaign, or ranking win. Candidates who provide a strong walkthrough will receive priority consideration.



We are looking for someone who can do more than follow an SEO checklist. We want someone who can identify opportunities, take ownership, execute effectively, measure results, and help lead our SEO efforts as we continue to grow.

Your primary responsibility will be to contact new and existing homeowner leads, qualify their bathroom remodeling needs, handle initial objections, and book qualified in-home consultation appointments for our sales team.



We generate leads through
, Instagram, our website, advertising campaigns, referrals, and other marketing sources. Many of the people you will contact have already expressed interest in remodeling their bathroom.



Your job is to turn that interest into a qualified appointment that actually takes place.



WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING



Your daily responsibilities will include:



* Contacting new inbound leads quickly by phone and text

* Calling homeowners who submit
 and Instagram lead forms

* Calling website inquiries

* Following up with leads who do not initially respond

* Qualifying homeowners before scheduling appointments

* Learning what the homeowner wants to accomplish with their bathroom

* Determining whether they are interested in a shower replacement, bathtub replacement, tub-to-shower conversion, or larger bathroom renovation

* Confirming the homeowner is within our service area

* Determining the homeowner’s approximate project timeframe

* Asking appropriate qualification questions while keeping the conversation friendly and natural

* Explaining our free in-home consultation and what homeowners can expect

* Building value and excitement around the consultation

* Handling common objections professionally

* Asking for the appointment and confidently moving the homeowner toward scheduling

* Scheduling appointments directly into our calendar/CRM

* Confirming all homeowners/decision-makers involved with the project can be present for the consultation

* Sending appointment confirmations

* Calling and texting customers before appointments to reduce cancellations and no-shows

* Rescheduling canceled appointments

* Following up consistently with leads until a clear disposition is reached

* Re-engaging older leads that never scheduled

* Maintaining accurate notes, statuses, and follow-up tasks in our CRM

* Keeping our sales representatives’ calendars filled with qualified appointments



THIS IS A SALES POSITION



We want to be very clear about what we’re looking for.



We do not want someone who simply answers the phone and schedules whichever time a customer requests.



We want an inside-sales professional who knows how to convert leads into appointments.



You must be comfortable:



* Speaking with U.S. homeowners every day

* Making a high volume of outbound calls

* Responding quickly to new inbound leads

* Asking qualification questions

* Building rapport quickly

* Controlling a phone conversation professionally

* Handling objections

* Following a proven script/process

* Sounding natural instead of reading word-for-word from a script

* Asking confidently for the appointment

* Following up multiple times

* Hearing “no” without becoming discouraged

* Turning “maybe later” into an appointment when appropriate

* Being held accountable for measurable results



You should be friendly, professional, persistent, competitive, and results-driven.



COMMON OBJECTIONS YOU WILL NEED TO HANDLE



You should be comfortable responding naturally to homeowners who say things such as:



* “I’m just looking for a price.”

* “How much does it cost?”

* “I’m getting several estimates.”

* “I need to talk to my spouse.”

* “Just send me some information.”

* “I’m not ready yet.”

* “I’ll call you back.”

* “I’m just researching.”

* “I don’t know when I want to do it.”



Your goal is not to pressure homeowners. Your goal is to understand their needs, explain the value of the consultation, answer basic questions, and confidently ask for the appointment.



EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Previous experience with U.S. customers is strongly preferred.



Ideal candidates will have experience in one or more of the following:



* Appointment setting

* Inside sales

* Phone sales

* Outbound calling

* Inbound lead conversion

* Lead qualification

* Telemarketing

* Home improvement

* Bathroom remodeling

* Roofing

* Windows and doors

* HVAC

* Solar

* Kitchen remodeling

* Flooring

* Construction

* Other high-ticket U.S. home services



Previous U.S. home-improvement or home-services appointment-setting experience is a major plus.



We especially value candidates who have experience converting
, Instagram, website, or other inbound internet leads into appointments.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



You should have:



* Excellent spoken and written English

* Clear, confident, easy-to-understand phone communication

* Professional phone presence

* Strong listening skills

* Confidence speaking with U.S. homeowners

* Previous appointment-setting, telemarketing, inside-sales, or phone-sales experience

* Strong objection-handling skills

* Ability to follow scripts, systems, and processes

* Ability to sound conversational rather than robotic

* Strong organizational skills

* Accurate CRM/data-entry habits

* Excellent follow-up skills

* Reliable attendance

* Strong work ethic

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to accept coaching and feedback

* Stable high-speed internet

* Reliable computer

* Quality headset

* Quiet and professional work environment

* Backup internet and/or power solution strongly preferred



WORKING HOURS



This is a full-time position — minimum of 40 hours per week.



You MUST be available to work during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) because you will be communicating directly with homeowners in the United States.



Typical Schedule:



Monday–Friday during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



Some Saturday and Sunday availability WILL be REQUIRED depending on lead volume and appointment demand.



Reliability is extremely important.



We invest heavily in generating new homeowner leads, and speed-to-lead matters. When someone submits an inquiry, we want them contacted as quickly as possible.



This is intended to be a long-term, dedicated position. We are looking for someone who wants to become part of our team and grow with the company.



CRM & SOFTWARE



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* GoHighLevel / HighLevel

* LeadConnector

* CRM systems

* Online scheduling systems

* Phone dialers

* SMS/texting platforms

*
 lead management



If you have strong appointment-setting experience but haven’t used our exact software, we can train you on our systems.



COMPENSATION



Starting Base Pay: $6–$8 USD per hour depending on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated ability.



In addition to your hourly pay, you will have the opportunity to earn performance-based bonuses.



PERFORMANCE INCENTIVES



* $10 bonus for each properly qualified appointment that successfully sits/completes

* Additional $25 bonus when your appointment results in a completed sale

* Additional performance bonuses may be available for consistently exceeding company goals



For example:



A properly qualified appointment that takes place:



+$10 bonus



If that same appointment results in a sale:



+$25 additional bonus



That means an appointment that sits and sells can earn you $35 in bonuses, in addition to your regular hourly pay.



We intentionally reward quality appointments, not simply the number of appointments placed on the calendar.



HOW PERFORMANCE WILL BE MEASURED



This is a performance-driven position.



We will track metrics including:



* Speed-to-lead

* Number of outbound calls

* Number of leads contacted

* Contact rate

* Appointments booked

* Qualification rate

* Appointment booking rate

* Appointment confirmation rate

* Appointment show/sit rate

* Cancellation and no-show rate

* Sales resulting from your appointments

* Follow-up activity

* CRM accuracy



Quality matters just as much as quantity.



Putting an unqualified homeowner on the calendar simply to increase your appointment count does not help you or the company.



We want homeowners who understand why we are coming to their home, have a legitimate bathroom remodeling project, have been properly qualified, and are expecting our consultation.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



A successful person in this position does not call a new lead once and give up.



If a new lead doesn’t answer, you follow our contact process.



You call again.



You send a text.



You follow up.



You try different appropriate times.



You keep detailed notes.



You work older leads when new leads are caught up.



You confirm upcoming appointments.



You work canceled appointments.



You re-engage homeowners who previously said they weren’t ready.



You consistently look for opportunities throughout our lead database.



Your goal is simple:



Keep our sales representatives in front of qualified homeowners who are genuinely interested in remodeling their bathrooms.



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for someone who wants a long-term opportunity, not a temporary freelance project.



Strong performance, reliability, and consistently producing quality appointments can lead to:



* Increased hourly compensation

* Additional performance bonuses

* Increased responsibility

* Leadership opportunities as our inside-sales team grows



We want to build a strong appointment-setting operation and would like the right person to grow with us.



HOW TO APPLY



Please read this carefully.



At the very beginning of your application, write:



GOLD STANDARD



If those words are not at the beginning of your application, we will assume you did not read the entire posting.



Please answer ALL of the following:



1. Describe your previous appointment-setting and inside-sales experience.



2. Have you previously called U.S. customers? If yes, for what type of company?



3. Have you worked for a U.S. home-improvement or home-services company? If yes, tell us the industry and what your responsibilities were.



4. How many outbound calls are you comfortable making during a typical workday?



5. What CRM systems have you previously used?



6. Have you used GoHighLevel or LeadConnector before?



7. Tell us how you would respond to this homeowner:



“I’m interested in remodeling my shower, but I’m really just looking for a price right now.”



8. A new
 lead comes in and you call them immediately, but they don’t answer. What would you do next?



9. Are you available to work approximately 40 hours per week during U.S. Eastern Time hours?



10. Are you comfortable with performance metrics and being held accountable for appointment quality and results?



VOICE RECORDING REQUIRED



Please provide a short voice recording introducing yourself.



In your recording, tell us:



* Your name

* Your previous appointment-setting/sales experience

* Your experience speaking with U.S. customers

* Why you believe you would be successful in this position



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



We are specifically evaluating your English fluency, communication skills, confidence, professionalism, and ability to communicate naturally with U.S. homeowners.



FINAL NOTE



We are looking for someone who is:



Confident. Persistent. Dependable. Organized. Coachable. Competitive. Results-driven.



If you’re looking for a basic administrative VA position, this probably isn’t the right opportunity.



If you enjoy speaking with customers, know how to handle objections, aren’t afraid to pick up the phone, understand that follow-up creates opportunities, and want your performance to directly increase your earnings, we want to hear from you.



We are looking for the right person to become a long-term part of the Gold Standard Bathrooms team.

title: # Chargeback & Dispute Manager – E-commerce
description:
We are looking for an experienced **Chargeback & Dispute Manager** to join our growing e-commerce team.



Your main responsibility will be managing, investigating, and responding to chargebacks and payment disputes. We are looking for someone who understands how to build strong dispute cases, collect the right evidence, and maximize our chargeback win rate.



### Responsibilities



* Review and investigate incoming chargebacks

* Prepare and submit chargeback responses

* Gather strong supporting evidence for each case

* Write clear and convincing rebuttal statements

* Review order, payment, customer, tracking, and delivery information

* Handle fraudulent/unauthorized transaction disputes

* Handle product not received and product not as described disputes

* Monitor dispute deadlines and make sure every case is submitted on time

* Keep accurate records of all disputes and outcomes

* Analyze why chargebacks are happening and identify patterns

* Suggest ways to reduce our overall chargeback rate

* Provide weekly reporting on disputes, wins, losses, and win rate



### Requirements



* Previous experience handling chargebacks for an e-commerce business

* Strong understanding of chargeback evidence and representment

* Experience with payment processors and/or platforms such as Stripe, Shopify Payments, PayPal, Whop, or similar

* Excellent written English

* Strong attention to detail

* Able to work independently and meet strict deadlines

* Comfortable working with spreadsheets and order data



### Important



We are specifically looking for someone with **real chargeback/dispute experience**. This is not a general customer service position.



When applying, please include:



1. Your previous experience handling chargebacks

2. Which payment processors/platforms you have worked with

3. Approximately how many disputes you have handled

4. Your typical chargeback win rate, if known

5. An example of how you would approach a “Fraudulent / Unauthorized Transaction” chargeback

6. Your expected hourly or monthly salary



Please start your application with the word **DISPUTE** so we know you have read the full job description.



We are looking for someone reliable who can potentially work with us long-term.

title: Experienced B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter – Excellent English Required
description:
Steady Answer provides AI receptionist solutions to home-service contractors across the United States, including HVAC companies, plumbers, roofers, electricians, restoration companies, and pool-service businesses.



We are looking for an experienced B2B cold caller and appointment setter. Your primary responsibility will be calling home-service business owners, introducing our service, identifying potential interest, and scheduling qualified 15-minute discovery calls.



Responsibilities:



* Make outbound cold calls to U.S. home-service contractors

* Speak with business owners and decision-makers

* Follow our script while sounding natural and conversational

* Ask qualifying questions and handle common objections

* Schedule qualified discovery calls

* Record accurate notes and call outcomes in our CRM

* Complete follow-up calls when appropriate

* Participate in call reviews, coaching, and script improvement



Requirements:



* Exceptional spoken English is extremely important

* Clear, natural, near-native English with a neutral North American accent

* Previous B2B cold-calling, appointment-setting, SDR, or outbound-sales experience

* Comfortable speaking with American business owners

* Confident and personable—not robotic or overly scripted

* Strong listening skills and ability to respond naturally

* Reliable internet, computer, professional headset, and quiet workspace

* Available during U.S. business hours

* Comfortable having calls recorded for training and quality assurance



Experience calling home-service contractors is strongly preferred. Experience with SaaS, AI, CRM, marketing, answering services, or lead-generation campaigns is also valuable.



This is initially a part-time position with the opportunity to increase hours and become a long-term member of our team based on performance.



HOW TO APPLY:



Please provide:



1. A summary of your cold-calling and appointment-setting experience.

2. Details of any experience calling home-service contractors or American business owners.

3. Your previous results, including appointments booked or show rates, if available.

4. The CRMs and dialers you have used.

5. Your availability during U.S. Eastern Time.

6. A 60–90-second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you are a good fit.

7. A brief mock cold-call recording in which you call an HVAC business owner and introduce an AI receptionist that helps prevent missed calls and lost jobs.



Applications without both recordings will not be considered.



Begin your application with the words “STEADY ANSWER” so we know you read the complete posting.



Shortlisted applicants will participate in a video interview and live cold-call role-play. Finalists may be offered a short paid trial before we select someone for the ongoing position.

title: Long-Form YouTube Video Editor – Travel & Lifestyle
description:
READ BEFORE APPLYING — DIRECT LONG-FORM VIDEO LINKS ARE REQUIRED



We are established travel and lifestyle content creators with nearly 1 million combined subscribers and followers across multiple platforms. We are hiring a full-time long-form YouTube editor for our creator-led travel, RV, van-life, outdoor, and adventure channel.



Our finished videos are generally 20–45 minutes long. We need an experienced editor who can turn several hours of raw footage into a compelling, story-driven YouTube video—not simply arrange clips in chronological order.



This position is focused on long-form YouTube content, not Shorts, Reels, podcasts, gaming videos, or corporate content.



ABOUT THE EDITING STYLE



A strong style reference for this position is Trent the Traveler.



Before applying, watch several of his long-form YouTube videos and become familiar with his storytelling, pacing, dialogue editing, music selection, sound design, scenic sequences, humor, and emotional timing.



We need an editor who can:



• Find the strongest story within several hours of raw footage

• Create compelling openings that immediately build curiosity

• Structure each video with a clear beginning, middle, and end

• Edit natural conversations without making them feel rushed

• Remove repetitive, unnecessary, or weak footage

• Use music, sound effects, B-roll, and scenic footage effectively

• Build anticipation and maintain viewer interest

• Know when an edit should move quickly and when a 
nt should breathe

• Turn everyday travel experiences into entertaining long-form stories



ENGLISH FLUENCY IS REQUIRED



You must be highly fluent in spoken and written English.



Our videos include natural conversations, humor, sarcasm, reactions, emotional 
nts, and storylines that develop throughout the footage. You must understand the dialogue, tone, and context well enough to make strong decisions about pacing, cuts, music, and emotional timing.



THE ROLE



You will edit complete 20–45 minute YouTube videos from raw footage through final delivery.



You must be able to:



• Review several hours of raw footage and identify the strongest story

• Create a compelling opening and clear beginning, middle, and end

• Edit natural dialogue while preserving humor, emotion, and pacing

• Remove repetitive, unnecessary, or weak footage

• Use music, sound design, B-roll, scenic footage, and travel montages effectively

• Clean and mix audio and perform basic color correction

• Add text, maps, captions, and graphics when needed

• Follow editing notes, complete revisions accurately, and apply feedback consistently

• Meet deadlines, work independently, and communicate clearly

• Send a brief end-of-day
 summarizing your progress and any questions



You must have proven experience editing long-form, creator-led travel, lifestyle, RV, van-life, outdoor, or adventure YouTube videos.



You must also have strong storytelling instincts, excellent attention to detail, reliable high-speed internet, a dependable editing computer, and availability for approximately 40 hours per week.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with:



I READ THE LONG-FORM VIDEO LINK REQUIREMENTS



Then include the following:



1. YOUR INFORMATION



• Full name

•
 address

• Current city and country

• Editing software and computer you use

• Expected hourly rate

• Weekly availability

• Normal working hours in Philippine Time

• Earliest available start date

• Whether you currently have another full-time job or major ongoing clients



2. YOUR TOP THREE LONG-FORM VIDEO EDITS



Provide EXACTLY THREE direct, clickable links to individual, published YouTube videos that you personally edited.



All three videos must:



• Be at least 15 minutes long

• Be creator-led travel, lifestyle, RV, van-life, outdoor, or adventure videos

• Link directly to the actual published video

• Clearly demonstrate your long-form storytelling and editing ability



At least one must be a travel, RV, or van-life vlog with storytelling, pacing, and production quality similar to Trent the Traveler’s long-form videos.



For each video, include:



• The direct YouTube link

• The channel name

• The video runtime

• Whether you edited the entire video

• What you personally edited if anyone else was involved



DO NOT SEND:



• Portfolio websites

• Demo reels

• YouTube channel homepages

• Playlists

• Google Drive or Dropbox folders

• Short-form videos

• Links that require us to search for your work



We will only review the three direct video links you submit.



Applications without exactly three qualifying direct video links will not be reviewed.



3. RELEVANT EXPERIENCE



In one short paragraph, describe your experience editing long-form travel, lifestyle, RV, van-life, outdoor, or adventure YouTube videos.



4. EDITING PROCESS



In one short paragraph, explain how you turn several hours of raw travel footage into one compelling 20–45 minute YouTube story.



5. INTERNET SPEED



Provide your Speedtest.net results:



• Download speed

• Upload speed

• Ping



Include a screenshot or public result link.



Qualified finalists may be asked to complete a short paid editing test using footage provided by us.



COMPENSATION AND HOURS



• $5–$8 USD per hour, depending on experience and editing ability

• Approximately 40 hours per week

• Full-time, long-term opportunity for the right editor
